paper.title: Twin: Playing an Unknown Game with a Test-Time Digital Twin
paper.abstract: We present a Test-time World-model Inference (Twin) system, in which a frontier coding agent writes an executable world model for completing continual learning tasks, such as ARC-AGI-3 games. Traditional approaches hand-engineer such models, one custom design per task. Each game hides its rules and goal, and our system constructs them from simulation and interaction alone. Its inductive prior over grid games is strong enough to recover the true transitions of the game and the goal on nearly all

summary.core_problem: 在规则和获胜条件均未知的交互式网格世界任务（如ARC-AGI-3）中，智能体如何通过少量交互高效构建环境模型并完成任务，替代传统的逐任务人工定制世界模型的方案。
summary.importance: 测试时动态构建可执行世界模型的范式，提示基座模型的代码能力与推理能力可以在推理阶段补全环境知识，无需将所有规则预训练进模型权重。目标推断（而非环境动力学建模）是未知世界学习的核心瓶颈，这一结论对智能体预训练的目标设计有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Twin系统，包含四个组成部分：将问题形式化为回合制MDP、三个核心例程（校验/探索/规划）、带一致性检查的执行器、目标发现模块。核心机制是用代码智能体在测试时编写Python形式的可执行世界模型（即twin），要求模型必须复现所有已观测到的状态转移才被信任；预测与实际结果的不匹配作为反例用于修复世界模型。目标推断阶段在已验证的twin中搜索候选目标谓词，通过关卡完成反馈验证或排除假设。
summary.experiments: 在ARC-AGI-3基准上，Twin通关183个关卡中的179个、25个游戏中的23个；在通关的179个关卡里，158个的动作消耗少于首次接触该游戏的人类。动作效率得分达到93.3%，而直接使用基座模型仅为7.8%，普通代码智能体框架为61.1%；移除校验-探索-规划循环后，同一智能体仅能通关148关。首次提出的目标假设在179个通关关卡中有156个是正确的。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读先看引言部分的核心动机和ARC-AGI-3上的性能对比数据，再看Twin方法章节的四模块流程。重点理解「世界模型必须复现全部历史转移才可信」的校验机制，以及目标推断的假设验证设计。预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: How an agent can efficiently build an environment model and complete tasks in interactive grid-world benchmarks such as ARC-AGI-3, where both transition rules and win conditions are hidden, replacing the traditional paradigm of hand-engineering custom world models for each task.
summary_en.importance: The test-time executable world model paradigm shows that a base model's coding and reasoning capabilities can fill in environmental knowledge dynamically at inference time, without requiring all rules to be encoded into model weights during pretraining. The finding that goal inference — not environment dynamics modeling — is the core bottleneck of unknown-world learning directly informs objective design for agent pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Twin system has four components: problem formulation as an episodic MDP, three core routines (validate / explore / plan), a consistency-checked executor, and a goal discovery module. A coding agent writes a Python-executable world model (the twin) at test time. The model is only trusted after it reproduces every previously observed state transition; mismatches between predictions and actual results serve as counterexamples to repair the model. For goal inference, the agent searches the validated twin for candidate goal predicates, then uses level completion feedback to verify or eliminate hypotheses.
summary_en.experiments: On the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark, Twin clears 179 of 183 levels and 23 of 25 games. On 158 of the 179 cleared levels, it uses fewer actions than a human playing the game for the first time. It reaches an action-efficiency score of 93.3%, compared to 7.8% for the base model used directly and 61.1% for a standard coding harness. Removing the validate-explore-plan loop reduces performance to 148 cleared levels. The first proposed goal hypothesis is correct on 156 of 179 cleared levels.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, start with the introduction for core motivation and head-to-head performance numbers on ARC-AGI-3, then move to the Twin Method section for the four-module pipeline. Focus on the validation mechanism (world model must replay all historical transitions before being trusted) and the hypothesis-testing design for goal inference. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 展示了 Test-time compute 结合程序合成在 ARC 任务上的强大能力，对理解如何利用代码生成作为世界模型进行复杂推理有启发，值得关注其验证和修复机制。
recommendation.en: Demonstrates the powerful capability of test-time compute combined with program synthesis on ARC tasks; inspiring for understanding how to use code generation as a world model for complex reasoning, worth noting its validation and repair mechanisms.

paper.title: Not All Tokens Are Equal: Inflation-Aware Routing for Agentic LLM Systems
paper.abstract: When a language model fails to answer a query on the first attempt, an agentic system retries, consuming additional tokens each time. This retry overhead creates a gap between what a model's per-token price implies and what a full workflow actually costs. We call this gap \emph{token inflation} and define it as the ratio of true workflow cost to single-call cost. Systems like FrugalGPT route based on the latter, which can underestimate real cost by more than $2\times$ on difficult tasks. We addr

summary.core_problem: 解决 Agent 工作流中多次重试导致真实 token 成本高于单次调用报价，而现有路由器低估复杂任务成本的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是 Agent 系统成本建模和路由策略改进。它提出 token inflation 这个可测量概念，把模型选择从“单次调用价格”推进到“完成任务的期望成本”。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 InflationAgent 四阶段路由器：先按模型层级和任务类型测量 token inflation，再用本地推理得到的 CoT Branching Entropy（CBE）预测高膨胀任务，最后用 Semantic Exchange Rate（SER）按预期准确率除以预测真实成本来选模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告，在多跳问答上 7B 模型的 token inflation 最高达到 4.25 倍；按单次调用成本路由会在困难任务上低估真实成本超过 2 倍。CBE 对高 inflation 的预测 AUROC 为 0.887。具体数据集、模型列表和端到端节省幅度未在摘要中完整给出。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the gap between per-call token price and true workflow cost in agentic systems, where retries can substantially inflate token usage.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is cost modeling and routing for agent workflows. It introduces token inflation as a measurable quantity and shifts model routing from single-call pricing to expected task-completion cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: InflationAgent uses a four-stage router: it measures token inflation across model tiers and task types, predicts high-inflation cases with CoT Branching Entropy computed from local inference, and selects models using Semantic Exchange Rate, defined as expected accuracy divided by predicted true cost.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports token inflation up to 4.25x for a 7B model on multi-hop QA, and notes that single-call-cost routing can underestimate real cost by more than 2x on hard tasks. CoT Branching Entropy predicts high inflation with AUROC 0.887. The abstract does not fully specify datasets, model inventory, or end-to-end savings.

recommendation.zh: 作为 test-time compute 路由备忘即可；CBE 的 AUROC 值值得看，SER 是否泛化要等更干净任务。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a test-time compute routing note; the CBE AUROC is worth checking, but SER needs cleaner generalization tests.

paper.title: GEM: A Generative Embedding Model Bridging Reasoning and Retrieval
paper.abstract: Modern LLMs excel at reasoning and instruction following, enabling users to express complex and diverse information needs. However, conventional retrievers largely rely on surface-level matching between queries and documents, resulting in a growing gap between how users express their needs and how retrievers interpret them. In this paper, we present GEM, a generative embedding model that augments retrieval through its own knowledge by explicitly reasoning about user intent and relevance criteria

summary.core_problem: GEM 解决的是 dense retriever 对复杂自然语言需求理解不足的问题。用户现在会用带推理、约束和偏好的方式表达检索需求，但传统 embedding 模型主要编码表层语义相似度，难以显式理解用户意图和相关性标准。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的启发在于，它把生成式语言建模和表示学习放进同一个训练目标，而不是把 LLM reasoning 和 retriever 做成两个模型的流水线。它关心的问题接近“同一个 decoder-only backbone 能否同时保留生成能力和产出高质量 embedding”。这对未来统一模型接口有参考意义：模型可以先生成可解释的中间推理，再把这个推理压入向量空间，用于检索、记忆访问或工具路由。它不是通用 LLM 预训练配方，但在生成-表示联合训练上有方法价值。
summary.technical_approach: GEM 采用 generate-then-encode 范式。给定查询 q，系统先用一个 meta-instruction 组成 prompt p，引导模型生成关于用户意图和相关性标准的 reasoning response r。随后模型对 p 与 r 的拼接内容进行编码，并通过附加 embedding token 输出检索向量。训练上，它同时使用 contrastive loss 和 causal language modeling loss：前者让 embedding 能区分正负文档，后者避免模型在变成 bi-encoder 后遗忘生成能力。数据构造是关键。对每个查询，先采样多个候选 reasoning，再用 LLM relevance classifier 检查原始正例文档在该 reasoning 下是否仍然相关，过滤掉误解查询的推理。之后构造与 reasoning 一致的正例，以及主题相近但在细节上与 reasoning 冲突的 hard negative，迫使模型不能只靠关键词或主题相似度完成检索。
summary.experiments: 论文在 reasoning-intensive retrieval 和 instruction-following retrieval 任务上评估 GEM。已给出的内容显示，GEM 的自生成 reasoning 能提升检索效果，并且通过测试时 prompting 增加推理计算还能继续带来增益。全文片段没有提供具体数据集名称、模型规模、batch size、训练数据量、NDCG/Recall 数字或消融表，因此只能确认实验方向，不能确认提升幅度。最值得看的消融应包括：无 reasoning 的普通 embedding、外部 LLM 生成 reasoning 的 pipeline、只用 contrastive loss、不加 causal LM loss、不使用 reasoning-aligned hard negatives，以及不同采样数量 K 对数据质量的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读偏精读，预计 30–40 分钟。重点看 Generative Embedding Model 的整体结构、embedding token 的使用方式、联合损失函数，以及 Figure 2 的 reasoning 数据生成流程。实验部分优先看 reasoning-intensive retrieval 与 instruction-following retrieval 的主表，再看 joint training 和 hard negative 构造的消融。对预训练研究员而言，最值得深挖的是 contrastive objective 与 causal LM objective 是否真的兼容，以及这种 generate-then-encode 接口能否扩展到长上下文记忆、RAG query rewriting 或 tool routing。

summary_en.core_problem: GEM addresses a mismatch between modern user queries and conventional dense retrieval. Users increasingly express information needs through instructions, constraints, and implicit reasoning, while most embedding models still rely on lexical or shallow semantic similarity.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant because it trains a single model to both generate reasoning and produce retrieval embeddings. Instead of using an external LLM to rewrite or explain the query before passing it to a separate retriever, GEM asks the retriever itself to reason and then encode that reasoning. This is useful for foundation-model research on unified generation-and-representation training. It is not a general LLM pretraining recipe, but it gives a concrete design for preserving causal generation while learning a contrastive embedding space.
summary_en.technical_approach: GEM uses a generate-then-encode interface. Given a query, it prepends a meta-instruction that asks the model to reason about user intent and relevance criteria. The model generates a response, then encodes the concatenation of prompt and response, with an appended embedding token used as the retrieval representation. Training combines a contrastive retrieval objective with a causal language modeling objective, so the model learns document discrimination without losing its generative behavior. The data pipeline is central: for each query, multiple candidate reasoning traces are sampled; an LLM-based relevance classifier checks whether the original positive document remains relevant under each trace; invalid reasoning is filtered out. The remaining reasoning is used to build positives aligned with the inferred intent and hard negatives that share topics but subtly violate the reasoning, reducing dependence on surface matching.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates GEM on reasoning-intensive retrieval and instruction-following retrieval. The supplied content indicates that self-generated reasoning improves retrieval and that test-time prompting can further improve performance by spending more compute on reasoning. The available text does not provide model sizes, training scale, dataset names, or metric values such as NDCG or recall, so the magnitude of gains cannot be assessed from the provided material. The most informative ablations would compare against plain embedding without reasoning, external-LLM reasoning pipelines, contrastive-only training, removal of the causal LM loss, removal of reasoning-aligned hard negatives, and different numbers of sampled reasoning candidates.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim with some attention to the method, about 30–40 minutes. Read the model interface, the embedding-token design, the joint loss, and the reasoning-conditioned data synthesis pipeline. In the experiments, focus on the main retrieval tables for reasoning-intensive and instruction-following settings, then inspect ablations on joint training and hard negative construction. For pretraining researchers, the key question is whether causal LM loss and contrastive embedding loss remain compatible at scale, and whether the same generate-then-encode pattern can support memory retrieval, RAG query planning, or tool routing.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是“先生成再嵌入”这个接口设计，不一定能直接迁到大规模 pretrain，但它提醒你检索表征未必该被 next-token 目标单独决定；先看方法图和主表即可。
recommendation.en: The interesting part is the generate-then-embed interface: it may not transfer cleanly to large-scale pretraining, but it challenges the prior that retrieval representations should be shaped only by standard LM objectives; read the method figure and main table.

paper.title: Beyond the Best Guess: Improving LLM Solution Coverage with Evolution Strategies
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in discovery domains such as math and science. The usual approach is to present the problem to the model and use its answer as the proposed solution. However, beyond this best guess, discovery can be enhanced by increasing test-time compute. In a process called pass@k, the model is allowed to explore the solution space and generate diverse candidate solutions. Unfortunately, the standard approach to post-training LLMs through Reinforcement L

summary.core_problem: 当前基于可验证奖励的RL后训练方法会导致LLM输出分布坍缩，概率质量过度集中在少数高奖励解上，虽然提升了pass@1单点正确率，但损失了解空间覆盖能力，当k较大时pass@k性能甚至低于未经过RL训练的基座模型，无法充分发挥test-time scaling下多采样探索的潜力。
summary.importance: 该工作明确指出了当前RL后训练目标的核心权衡：单点正确率优化与解空间多样性的矛盾。对于需要靠test-time compute扩展、通过多采样覆盖解空间的科学发现、数学、代码类任务，现有GRPO/PPO类RL方法的优化方向和目标错配，进化策略（ES）作为参数空间的无梯度优化方法，是一个可行的替代方向，为后训练目标设计、预训练-后训练衔接阶段的训练信号选择提供了新的实证参考。
summary.technical_approach: 研究首先从优化机制层面拆解RL和ES的本质差异：RL在token动作空间做策略梯度更新，直接抬升高奖励输出序列的对数概率，天然驱动输出分布向高奖励模态锐化；ES在模型参数空间做基于种群的无梯度优化，通过对参数加随机扰动生成模型种群，根据种群的平均奖励更新参数，优化压力指向对扰动鲁棒的参数区域，不会刻意锐化单一输出模态，天然保留更宽的输出分布支持。研究覆盖多个模型族、多参数规模，系统对比两类后训练方法的分布特性、pass@k表现。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖1.5B到32B参数规模的多个模型族，在匹配训练计算预算的条件下得到三个核心结论：1）ES训练的模型在所有测试设置下pass@k均优于同规模RL训练模型，且k值越大优势越明显；2）ES训练后模型的输出分布与基座模型的KL散度显著低于RL训练模型，保留了更多低概率但正确的解路径，没有出现明显的分布坍缩；3）在数学推理基准上，搭配test-time scaling的多采样策略，ES模型的最终解题性能超过同计算预算的RL模型。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议重点关注引言部分对RL分布坍缩问题的刻画、ES与RL的优化机制对比章节，以及核心实验中pass@k随k值变化的对比结果，不需要深究ES的具体工程实现细节，预计阅读时间30分钟；从事后训练算法、test-time scaling、推理增强研究的读者可进一步阅读输出分布分析的消融实验部分。

summary_en.core_problem: Current RL post-training with verifiable rewards causes LLM output distribution collapse, concentrating probability mass on a small set of high-reward solutions. While this improves pass@1 (single-shot accuracy), it reduces solution space coverage, often leading to worse pass@k performance than the base model for larger k, and prevents models from fully leveraging test-time scaling via diverse sampling.
summary_en.importance: This work identifies a core tradeoff in existing RL post-training pipelines: the tension between optimizing single-sample accuracy and preserving solution diversity. For domains that rely on test-time compute scaling (mathematical discovery, coding, open scientific problem solving) where performance depends on finding at least one correct solution across many samples, policy gradient methods like PPO/GRPO are misaligned with the end objective. Evolution strategies (ES), a gradient-free optimization method operating in parameter space, provides a viable alternative, adding empirical evidence for better post-training objective design and pretrain-posttrain interface design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work first isolates the fundamental mechanistic difference between RL and ES: RL performs policy gradient updates in the token action space, directly increasing log probability of high-reward sequences and inherently sharpening the output distribution toward high-reward modes; ES performs population-based gradient-free optimization directly in weight space, generating a population of models via random parameter perturbations, updating parameters based on mean population reward, and steering parameters toward regions robust to perturbation without explicitly sharpening a single output mode, naturally preserving broad support over the solution space. The study systematically compares distributional properties and pass@k performance across model families and parameter scales.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments span multiple model families from 1.5B to 32B parameters under matched training compute budgets, with three core findings: 1) ES-trained models outperform RL-trained models of the same size on pass@k across all tested settings, with larger gaps as k increases; 2) ES-trained models have significantly lower KL divergence from the base model distribution than RL-trained models, retaining more low-probability but correct solution paths with no observable distribution collapse; 3) On mathematical reasoning benchmarks, ES-trained models paired with test-time sampling outperform RL-trained models trained with the same compute budget.
summary_en.reading_guide: Suitable for skimming. Focus on the characterization of RL distribution collapse in the introduction, the mechanistic comparison between ES and RL optimization, and the core pass@k scaling results. There is no need to dive into low-level ES implementation details for most readers, estimated reading time 30 minutes. Researchers working on post-training algorithms, test-time scaling, or reasoning augmentation can refer to the ablation section on output distribution analysis for more details.

recommendation.zh: 对RLHF导致模型输出多样性坍塌（mode collapse）的有力反思，证明了进化策略（ES）在提升test-time scaling（pass@k）潜力上的优势，值得关注其对比实验。
recommendation.en: A strong reflection on mode collapse caused by RLHF, demonstrating the advantage of Evolution Strategies (ES) in unlocking test-time scaling (pass@k) potential; the comparative experiments are worth attention.

paper.title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro GA Release
paper.abstract: News DeepSeek-V4-Pro GA Release 2026/08/13 On this page DeepSeek-V4-Pro GA Release We’re launching DeepSeek-V4-Pro today! 🚀 🔷 Major Agent upgrades with strong production gains! 🔷 Flexible reasoning effort for V4-Pro & V4-Flash: low for simple tasks, high for daily Agent workflows, max for complex tasks. 🔷 Native OpenAI Responses API support, optimized for Codex with one-click setup. V4 Pro is now available on app/web. Try it via “Expert Mode”. V4 Pro is also available via API. Model names remain

summary.core_problem: 这是一条 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 的正式发布公告，主要解决产品可用性问题：向网页端和 API 用户开放 V4-Pro，并强化 Agent 工作流、推理强度调节和 Codex 接入体验。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接技术价值很低。公告没有披露模型架构、训练数据、训练流程、参数规模或评测结果。唯一值得注意的信号是 V4-Pro 将 Agent 能力作为主要升级方向，并提供 low/high/max 三档推理强度，这间接反映了生产环境中按任务复杂度分配推理算力的需求，但没有给出实现机制。
summary.technical_approach: 没有技术方案细节。已公开的变化包括：V4-Pro 与 V4-Flash 支持可调节推理强度；low 用于简单任务，high 用于日常 Agent 工作流，max 用于复杂任务；原生支持 OpenAI Responses API；针对 Codex 做了接入优化；网页端可通过 Expert Mode 使用；API 模型名保持不变；同时引入峰时和非峰时定价，非峰时价格低 50%。
summary.experiments: 没有实验。公告只声称有“strong production gains”，但没有给出 benchmark、消融实验、参数量、训练数据规模、延迟、吞吐或任务成功率等任何可验证数字。
summary.reading_guide: 这不是研究论文，全文只有几段产品说明，阅读时间约 1 到 2 分钟。若关注 DeepSeek 的产品节奏、API 定价或 Agent 服务形态，可以浏览；若关注基座预训练技术，可以跳过，因为没有可复用的方法、数据或训练细节。
summary.authors_note: DeepSeek。公告未列出具体作者。

summary_en.core_problem: This is a general-availability announcement for DeepSeek-V4-Pro. It addresses product availability and usability: opening V4-Pro on web and API, improving agent workflows, adding adjustable reasoning effort, and simplifying Codex integration.
summary_en.importance: The direct technical value for pretraining research is minimal. The post discloses no architecture, training data, training recipe, parameter count, or evaluation results. The only useful signal is that V4-Pro positions agent capabilities as a major upgrade and offers low/high/max reasoning effort, suggesting production demand for allocating inference compute by task complexity, but the mechanism is not described.
summary_en.technical_approach: No technical approach is provided. The announced changes are: flexible reasoning effort for V4-Pro and V4-Flash, with low for simple tasks, high for daily agent workflows, and max for complex tasks; native OpenAI Responses API support; Codex-optimized setup; web access through Expert Mode; unchanged API model names; and peak/off-peak pricing with off-peak rates 50% lower.
summary_en.experiments: There are no experiments. The announcement claims “strong production gains” but provides no benchmarks, ablations, parameter counts, training data sizes, latency, throughput, or task success rates.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a short product announcement rather than a research paper, readable in one or two minutes. It is worth skimming only for tracking DeepSeek’s release cadence, API pricing, or agent serving direction. For base-model pretraining research, it can be skipped because it contains no reusable methods, data details, or training insights.
summary_en.authors_note: DeepSeek. No individual authors are listed.

recommendation.zh: DeepSeek V4-Pro 正式发布，重点关注其引入的 'flexible reasoning effort' 机制，这印证了 test-time compute scaling 正成为基座模型的标配能力。
recommendation.en: DeepSeek V4-Pro GA release highlights the 'flexible reasoning effort' mechanism, confirming that test-time compute scaling is becoming a standard feature for foundation models.

paper.title: SCOPE-Router: Cost-Aware Open-Set VLM Routing for Execution-Oriented Tasks
paper.abstract: Model routing aims to select the most suitable model from a candidate pool for each query, balancing quality and cost. Existing VLM routing research is limited to traditional VQA evaluation, lacks systematic calibration optimization for open-set scenarios, and employs training objectives that dilute multi-positive signals via softmax normalization without incorporating cost. We address these limitations with three contributions: (1)VLM-ExecRouterBench, the first execution-oriented VLM routing be

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 执行型任务中的模型路由问题：如何在开放模型集合里按查询选择质量和成本最合适的模型。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理侧系统方法和评测资产。它把 VLM routing 从传统 VQA 扩展到 Code、Agentic、Search 等执行型任务，并显式纳入价格差异和开放集模型加入问题；对预训练研究的间接价值在于观察 test-time compute 与模型组合的成本-质量边界。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VLM-ExecRouterBench，包含 11 个候选 VLM，价格跨度接近两个数量级；提出 SCOPE-Router，一个双塔 router，将查询与模型行为 profile 匹配。模型 profile 由混合校准构造，结合 random、diagnostic、diversity sampling，使新模型可通过校准加入而不必重训 router。训练目标上提出 CRM+RCCR，用独立 pairwise scoring 和连续相关性目标编码成本偏好，避免 softmax 在多正例场景下稀释信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明 benchmark 覆盖 Code、Agentic、Search 三类执行任务和 11 个候选模型，但未给出具体数据规模、模型列表、成本-质量曲线或相对 baseline 的定量提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies VLM model routing for execution-oriented tasks: selecting the best quality-cost model for each query in an open model pool.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-side system method plus an evaluation asset. It moves VLM routing beyond standard VQA into code, agentic, and search tasks, while explicitly modeling pricing and open-set model addition. For pretraining researchers, the useful signal is about test-time compute allocation and quality-cost frontiers across model pools.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work introduces VLM-ExecRouterBench with 11 candidate VLMs spanning nearly two orders of magnitude in price. SCOPE-Router is a dual-tower router that matches queries against model behavior profiles. These profiles are built through hybrid calibration using random, diagnostic, and diversity sampling, allowing new models to be added without retraining the router. The CRM+RCCR objective uses independent pairwise scoring and continuous relevance targets to encode cost preferences, avoiding softmax dilution in multi-positive settings.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states coverage of code, agentic, and search domains with 11 candidate models, but does not provide dataset size, model names, routing baselines, or quantitative quality-cost gains.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文；只看 benchmark 设计和成本目标，能给 test-time compute 分配提供弱信号。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; skim the benchmark design and cost-aware objective as weak evidence for test-time compute allocation.

paper.title: Optimal Stopping of Self-Refining Foundation Models
paper.abstract: Foundation models can improve their outputs through a self-refinement process driven by external feedback. In this process, the model is embedded in an iterative loop where it generates outputs, receives feedback from verifiers, and refines its responses through in-context learning. Following a novel approach, we formalize this process as an optimal stopping problem where the number of refinement iterations is decided based on expected improvement relative to cost. We derive optimal stopping pol

summary.core_problem: 解决 foundation model 自我修正时迭代次数如何停止的问题：继续 refine 可能提高答案质量，但也会增加推理成本。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理时计算分配方法；它不改变预训练目标，但对 verifier loop、self-refinement、test-time compute 的成本控制有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 把 self-refinement 建模为 optimal stopping problem，根据预期质量增益与边际成本决定是否继续迭代；推导最优停止策略，并用 stochastic approximation 高效计算。
summary.experiments: 在 coding benchmark 上评估 foundation model 的自我修正流程；摘要称该停止策略相比既有停止策略显著更具成本效率，但未给出模型规模、benchmark 名称和具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when to stop iterative self-refinement in foundation models, balancing possible quality gains against inference-time cost.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an inference-time compute allocation method. It does not affect pretraining objectives directly, but it is relevant to verifier loops, self-refinement, and cost-aware test-time computation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formulate self-refinement as an optimal stopping problem, deciding whether to continue based on expected improvement relative to marginal cost. They derive stopping policies and compute them efficiently through stochastic approximation.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on a coding benchmark for foundation models. The abstract reports significantly better cost-efficiency than prior stopping policies, but does not provide model sizes, benchmark names, or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 看公式化和实验设置即可；这是 test-time compute 的干净小模型，不是会改变预训练 recipe 的结果。
recommendation.en: Skim the formulation and setup; it is a clean small model for test-time compute, not a result that should change pretraining recipes.

paper.title: InSight-doc: Agentic Visual Perception for Long-Document Understanding
paper.abstract: Long-document understanding often requires reasoning over many visually rich pages, making inference costly and prone to context rot. In this work, we propose InSight-doc, an agentic visual perception framework that treats visual resolution as an adaptive reasoning-time resource. InSight-doc starts from low resolution and selectively zooms into high-resolution regions for finer evidence, without relying on any external retriever. To train such an agent, we construct an active-perception corpus o

summary.core_problem: 长文档视觉理解需要在高分辨率多页上推理，全分辨率输入既昂贵又易导致context rot，而外部检索方案依赖额外索引。
summary.importance: 把视觉分辨率视作推理时可自适应分配的资源，用SFT+RL训练主动感知Agent，在长文档上同时降延迟和幻觉，属于多模态推理时计算分配方向的小案例。
summary.technical_approach: Agent从低分辨率开始，按策略选择性放大高分辨率区域取证；构造17.9K条SFT（含region-level zoom轨迹）+19.2K条hard RL样例，以SFT+RL训练8B模型，不依赖外部检索器。
summary.experiments: InSight-doc-8B在文档VQA基准上比基线高4.3–16.4 accuracy；长文档上幻觉降低40%+，推理延迟降低41%–68%且保持精度领先。
summary.authors_note: HKUST团队。

summary_en.core_problem: Long visual-document understanding requires high-resolution multi-page reasoning, but full-resolution inputs are expensive, induce context rot, and retrieval-based approaches rely on external indexes.
summary_en.importance: Frames visual resolution as an adaptive inference-time resource and trains an active-perception agent via SFT+RL, reducing latency and hallucination on long documents; a small data point for inference-time compute allocation in multimodal settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: The agent starts at low resolution and selectively zooms into regions; an active-perception corpus of 17.9K SFT examples with zoom trajectories plus 19.2K hard RL examples trains an 8B model with no external retriever.
summary_en.experiments: InSight-doc-8B outperforms baselines by 4.3–16.4 accuracy points on document VQA; on long documents, hallucination drops >40% and latency 41%–68% while retaining accuracy gains.
summary_en.authors_note: HKUST team.

recommendation.zh: 视觉文档的test-time compute分配小实验，RL训练zoom策略的工程实现可看一眼，但对通用预训练无直接动作。
recommendation.en: A small visual-document test-time-compute case; glance at the zoom-policy SFT+RL pipeline, but no direct action for general pretrain.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: When Chain-of-Thought Helps and When It Hurts: An Empirical Investigation of the Serial-Depth Bottleneck in LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: It is widely assumed that chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting universally improves LLM reasoning. We investigate this through the conceptual framework of the H_dp bandwidth bound (Chen et al., 2024): although the formal bound binds only asymptotically (at astronomically large prompt lengths), it identifies a real architectural bottleneck -- serial computation exceeding a transformer's single-pass capacity must be externalised, which is what CoT does. Our central finding is a within-benchmark serial

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文检验 CoT 何时有用、何时无用或有害。作者把问题放在 transformer 单次前向传播的串行深度瓶颈下：如果任务需要多步依赖计算，直接回答会把全部计算压进一次 forward；CoT 则把中间状态写到输出序列中，相当于给模型额外的串行计算通道。
summary.importance: 对预训练和推理能力研究的价值在于，它把 CoT 收益从“提示技巧”转成可检验的任务结构假设。论文强调 Chen et al. 2024 的 Hdp bound 在实际上下文长度下并不直接生效，所需 n* 大到物理上不可实现；但这个理论仍提供了一个有用变量：任务的串行深度。对基座模型研究来说，这有助于区分两类能力缺口：一类是模型已具备局部运算能力，但单次前向的计算深度不够，需要 scratchpad；另一类是知识、检索或浅层分类任务，CoT 不一定带来收益。论文不是预训练方法，但对设计 reasoning eval、训练 CoT 数据和解释测试时计算收益有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先回顾 Chen et al. 2024 的多方自回归通信模型，其中 Hdp=attention heads × head dimension × numerical precision，用来描述单次 forward 可承载的信息带宽。原始定理给出的是渐近下界：当 Hdp 小于某个随 prompt length 和层数变化的阈值时，decoder-only transformer 无法求解 L-sequential function composition。本文没有把该定理当作数值预测器，因为对 Qwen-7B、Qwen-32B 等模型，非平凡阈值对应的 prompt length 约为 10^(10^34.4) 到 10^(10^77.8)，远超真实 benchmark。作者将其作为概念框架，把 GSM8K、MATH、MMLU、ARC、HumanEval 等 benchmark 映射到粗粒度计算复杂度类别，并预注册假设：高串行深度任务应从 CoT 获益；低深度任务应基本不受影响，甚至可能因额外 token 引入噪声而变差。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen-2.5-7B、Qwen-2.5-32B 和 Llama-3.1-8B，在五个常见 benchmark 上比较 direct answer 与 CoT。主要发现是 benchmark 内部存在 serial-depth gradient：无 CoT 准确率随题目串行深度增加而单调下降，而 CoT 条件下对深度相对不敏感。正向假设得到支持：GSM8K 和 MATH 这类多步数学任务上，CoT 在三个模型上都能恢复一部分性能。负向假设没有完全成立：在正确答案抽取修正后，MMLU 和 ARC 上 CoT 大体中性，六个模型-任务组合的变化范围为 0.0 到 +4.6 个百分点。明显负例主要是 HumanEval 上 Qwen-7B 的 CoT 下降 28.7 个百分点，但 HumanEval 被作者归为 L 类任务，而不是低深度 TC0 类任务。论文也强调，答案抽取错误会显著污染 CoT 评估结论，因此评测协议本身是一个关键变量。
summary.reading_guide: 建议用 20 分钟泛读。先看 Introduction 和 Background 中对 Hdp bound 的处理，重点是作者承认理论边界在实际长度下不直接约束模型，这一点让后续实验更可信。然后看 benchmark 到复杂度类别的映射表，以及 direct-answer/CoT 的主结果表。最值得细看的是 within-benchmark serial-depth gradient 的分析，因为它比“某个 benchmark 平均提升多少”更接近机制解释。附录 B 的答案抽取修正也建议扫读，CoT 评估常被 parser 和格式问题干扰，这部分对做 reasoning eval 很实用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks when chain-of-thought helps and when it hurts. It frames the issue as a serial-depth bottleneck in decoder-only transformers: direct answering forces all computation into one forward pass, while CoT externalizes intermediate states into the output stream and gives the model additional sequential computation steps.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining and reasoning research is that it turns the effect of CoT from a prompt-level observation into a task-structure hypothesis. The paper is careful about the theory: the Hdp bound from Chen et al. 2024 is asymptotic and does not numerically bind at realistic context lengths. For the tested models, the non-vacuous prompt lengths are around 10^(10^34.4) to 10^(10^77.8), far beyond practical settings. Still, the bound identifies a useful variable: serial depth. This helps separate cases where the model has the local operations but lacks enough single-pass sequential depth, from cases where the task is mainly knowledge recall, shallow classification, or pattern matching. The paper is not a pretraining method paper, but it is useful for reasoning evaluation design, CoT data construction, and interpreting test-time compute gains.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use the multi-party autoregressive communication framework of Chen et al. 2024 as a conceptual guide. In that framework, Hdp equals the number of attention heads times head dimension times numerical precision, and represents the bandwidth available to a single forward pass. The original theorem gives an asymptotic lower bound for L-sequential function composition, but this paper does not treat it as a direct quantitative predictor. Instead, it maps five common NLP benchmarks into coarse computational-depth classes: GSM8K and MATH as multi-step sequential composition, and MMLU, ARC, and HumanEval as lower or different depth regimes. The pre-registered hypothesis is two-sided: high-depth tasks should benefit from CoT because intermediate computation must be externalized; low-depth tasks should be insensitive to CoT or may be harmed by extra noisy tokens.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare direct-answer prompting and CoT prompting on Qwen-2.5-7B, Qwen-2.5-32B, and Llama-3.1-8B across five benchmarks. The central empirical result is a within-benchmark serial-depth gradient: no-CoT accuracy decreases monotonically as per-item serial depth increases, while CoT accuracy is roughly depth-invariant. The positive hypothesis is supported on GSM8K and MATH across all three models, where CoT recovers performance on multi-step problems. The negative hypothesis is not strongly supported after correcting answer extraction: on MMLU and ARC, CoT is roughly neutral, with changes ranging from 0.0 to +4.6 percentage points across six model-task cells. The main surviving negative case is HumanEval with Qwen-7B, where CoT drops performance by 28.7 percentage points; the authors classify HumanEval as an L-class benchmark rather than a low-depth TC0 case. The paper also shows that answer extraction details can materially change CoT conclusions, which is an important evaluation caveat.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20-minute skim is appropriate. Start with the Introduction and Background sections to see how the paper uses the Hdp bound without overclaiming its practical numerical relevance. Then read the benchmark-to-complexity mapping and the main direct-answer versus CoT result tables. The most useful part is the within-benchmark serial-depth analysis, because it is more informative than average benchmark gains. Appendix B on answer extraction is also worth reading, especially for anyone building reasoning evaluations, since parser and formatting failures can distort measured CoT effects.

recommendation.zh: 这篇把 CoT 收益压到 serial depth 上，判断干净；优先看任务分层和 no-CoT 退化曲线。
recommendation.en: The useful part is the clean mapping from CoT gains to serial depth; read the task stratification and the no-CoT degradation curves.

paper.title: Predicting Task Difficulty Without Rollouts
paper.abstract: Task difficulty dictates an agent's likelihood of success, and estimating it without rollouts means forecasting this directly from a task description before executing costly simulations in stateful environments. Reliable estimates would therefore allow environment designers to calibrate evaluation benchmarks and construct progressive training curricula. This becomes increasingly important as agents move into long-horizon domains, where empirical trial-and-error is a severe computational bottlene

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是一个评测与训练管线里的前置问题：在不做 rollouts、不运行完整 agent 交互的前提下，仅根据任务描述和少量静态元信息，能否预估一个 agent 任务有多难。作者关心的不是单个模型的 uncertainty 校准，而是跨 benchmark、跨 agent 配置地定义“任务难度”这一潜变量，并检验这种 ex ante 预测能否替代昂贵的实测试跑。问题之所以重要，是因为长时程 agent benchmark 的验证成本越来越高，很多任务一次评测就要消耗大量环境交互和模型调用；如果难度不能预估，benchmark 构造、课程学习和数据筛选都会变得很低效。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的关联不是直接改进 base model，而是提供了一个和数据课程、评测设计、合成任务筛选都相关的工具视角。第一，它把 task difficulty 从“经验上觉得难”变成了可估计、可排序的量，这对构造 curriculum、挑选训练样本、控制 benchmark 覆盖度有现实意义。第二，论文提醒人们不要用 response-level AUC 这类看起来很高的指标误判难度预测能力，因为它可能只是在区分成功/失败样本，而没有真正学到 task-level 难度排序。第三，作者公开了一个跨 17 个 agent benchmark 的结果库，并用 IRT 建 difficulty target，这对后续做 agent scaling、benchmark contamination 分析、任务去重和难度分层采样都有参考价值。它更像一篇评测方法与数据资产论文，而不是预训练算法论文。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两步。第一步，从已有 agent-task 成败记录中估计每个任务的 latent difficulty。作者把每次 trial 视作 Bernoulli 观测，构造一个部分观测的 agent×task 二值响应矩阵，然后用 1PL IRT（Rasch model）拟合每个 agent 的能力参数 θ_a 和每个任务的难度参数 β_t。这样定义难度有一个好处：它不是某个单一模型的通过率，而是在共享标尺上相对于多种 agent 能力共同估出来的，因此更适合跨 benchmark 比较。

第二步，用 rollout 前可获得的特征去预测 β_t。特征包括任务文本描述、环境与动作空间描述、元数据，以及作者特别强调的 entropy 等不需要完整交互即可得到的信号。论文还系统讨论了评估协议：如果用 response AUC，模型可能在样本级别上看起来预测得不错，但 task-level rank correlation 仍然很弱，因此作者主张用 Spearman ρ 这类排序指标来评估“是否真的学到了难度”。此外，论文做了 residual diagnostics：把预测难度与 IRT 估计难度的残差拿出来分析。正残差大的任务，往往是比文本表面看起来更难，原因可能是环境不可行、verifier 有问题、接口设计不合理；负残差大的任务，则可能因为训练数据熟悉、模板化、捷径存在而显得异常容易。这个诊断视角比单纯做一个回归器更有用。
summary.experiments:
数据规模是这篇论文最扎实的部分。主分析子集包含 17 个 benchmark、5230 个任务、497 个 agent 配置，这些配置来自 216 个模型和 90 个 scaffold；总语料库包含 415,470 条 agent-task outcome。任务类型覆盖 coding/SWE、function calling、web navigation、computer use、terminal、math、ML、cybersecurity 和 general-purpose suites，时间跨度从 2010 到 2026。每个 agent-task 对平均约 1.2 次 trial。

结果上，作者给出的核心数字是：在 K-fold 评估下，组合特征的 task difficulty 预测达到 Spearman ρ=0.399，且相对 baseline 的提升有统计显著性（p<0.001）；在 out-of-distribution 设置下，ρ=0.225。单一特征族里，entropy 最强。论文还指出 response AUC 可能偏乐观，即便 task difficulty 排序学得不好，AUC 仍然可以很高，因此 rank-based 指标更可信。更有信息量的是残差分析案例：一些任务被模型预测为不难，但真实 IRT 难度很高，最后发现是环境不可完成或 evaluator 失灵；另一些任务文本上看似复杂，实际却因数据熟悉或 shortcut 而容易。这说明 difficulty predictor 不只是一个打分器，还能帮助发现 benchmark 设计缺陷。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看数据与目标定义，也就是 17 个 benchmark 如何统一成 agent×task 响应矩阵，以及为什么作者选 1PL IRT 而不是直接用平均成功率。这里决定了整篇论文是否站得住。然后看评估部分，重点理解作者为什么批评 response AUC，并把 task-level rank correlation 作为主指标。接着看 feature ablation，尤其是 entropy 为什么在单特征里表现最好，以及组合特征带来了什么增益。最后看 residual diagnostics 的案例分析，这部分最接近实际使用场景：它告诉你难度预测器能否帮助发现坏任务、脏 verifier 和 shortcut。预计 25–35 分钟可以读完主线；如果只想抓结论，看 §3 的 IRT 建模、§4/§5 的主结果和残差分析即可。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a front-end problem in agent evaluation and training pipelines: can task difficulty be predicted before any rollout, using only task descriptions and static metadata, instead of running expensive agent-environment interactions? The target is not model-specific uncertainty calibration, but a benchmark-level notion of latent task difficulty that transfers across agent configurations and benchmark families. This matters because long-horizon agent benchmarks are becoming costly to validate, and without ex ante difficulty estimates it is hard to build calibrated evaluations, progressive curricula, or efficient task filters.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is indirect but real. Difficulty estimation can support curriculum construction, synthetic task selection, benchmark curation, and contamination analysis. The paper makes three useful points. First, it turns task difficulty from an informal intuition into an estimable latent variable that can be ranked across tasks. Second, it shows that response-level AUC can be misleadingly optimistic: a predictor may separate easy and hard responses without learning the actual ordering of task difficulty. Third, it releases a large multi-benchmark corpus and uses IRT-derived difficulty targets, which should be useful for future work on agent scaling, benchmark design, and difficulty-aware sampling. This is best viewed as an evaluation-method and data-asset paper rather than a pretraining-method paper.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The pipeline has two stages. First, the authors estimate latent task difficulty from observed agent-task outcomes. Each trial is treated as a Bernoulli observation, forming a partially observed binary response matrix over agents and tasks. They fit a one-parameter logistic IRT model, or Rasch model, with one scalar ability parameter θ_a per agent configuration and one scalar difficulty parameter β_t per task. This is preferable to raw pass rate because difficulty is inferred relative to a population of agents on a shared scale, making it more suitable for cross-benchmark comparison.

Second, they train predictors of β_t using only pre-rollout features. These include textual task descriptions, environment and action-space descriptions, metadata, and uncertainty-related signals such as entropy that can be obtained without full interaction. A major methodological contribution is the evaluation protocol. The paper argues that response AUC can look strong even when task-level difficulty estimates are poor, so it emphasizes rank-based metrics such as Spearman correlation for judging whether the predictor actually learns difficulty ordering. The residual analysis is also important: discrepancies between predicted and observed IRT difficulty are used diagnostically. Large positive residuals often indicate hidden hardness factors such as infeasible environments or broken evaluators, while large negative residuals may reveal familiarity, templating, or shortcuts.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical foundation is substantial. The main analysis subset contains 5,230 tasks from 17 benchmarks, evaluated by 497 agent configurations built from 216 models and 90 scaffolds. The full corpus includes 415,470 agent-task outcomes. Domains span coding and SWE, function calling, web navigation, computer use, terminal tasks, math, ML, cybersecurity, and general-purpose suites. Task dates range from 2010 to 2026, and each agent-task pair has about 1.2 trials on average.

The headline numbers are straightforward. Under K-fold evaluation, the combined feature set reaches Spearman ρ = 0.399, significantly better than the baseline at p < 0.001. Under out-of-distribution evaluation, it reaches ρ = 0.225. Among single feature families, entropy performs best. The paper also shows that response AUC can remain high even when task-level difficulty ranking is weak, which supports the claim that rank-based evaluation is the more faithful metric. The residual case studies are especially useful: some tasks predicted to be moderate turn out to be much harder because the environment is infeasible or the verifier is faulty, while others that look difficult in text are actually easy due to familiarity or shortcuts. That makes the predictor useful not only for scoring tasks, but also for debugging benchmarks.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the target construction: how 17 heterogeneous benchmarks are unified into an agent-by-task response matrix, and why the authors use 1PL IRT instead of average success rate. That is the conceptual backbone. Then read the evaluation section carefully, especially the argument against relying on response AUC and the shift toward task-level rank correlation. After that, inspect the feature ablations, with special attention to why entropy is the strongest single feature family and what the combined features add. Finish with the residual diagnostics, since that is where the method becomes practically useful for benchmark design and task filtering. Around 25 to 35 minutes should be enough for the main thread. If time is short, focus on the IRT setup in Section 3 and the main results plus residual analysis in Sections 4 and 5.

recommendation.zh: 无rollout任务难度预测的实用结论，token熵信号可直接用于数据课程与推理计算分配，看§3特征分析即可
recommendation.en: Practical findings on rollout-free task difficulty prediction, the token entropy signal is directly usable for data curriculum and inference compute allocation, just read §3 feature analysis.

paper.title: Scrouting: Cost-Aware Routing of Coding Agents by Scouting the Repository First
paper.abstract: Frontier language models can resolve repository-level software issues, but each attempt is expensive, and existing routers select a model from the issue text alone. We present SuperScout, which routes after scouting the repository: a 7B searcher, SuperScout-7B, first explores the repository and produces a structured handoff whose reproduction claims are sandbox-verified, with false claims stripped before delivery. The searcher's hidden states, together with the task text, then feed a resume-base

summary.core_problem: 仓库级代码修复任务中，现有路由机制仅根据 issue 文本在调用模型前做决策，既无法利用代码仓库本身的结构信息，也无法在保持最强模型解题率的前提下显著降低单任务成本；同时已有研究默认路由目标是提升准确率，但真实场景下不同模型的解题集合高度嵌套，准确率提升几乎没有空间。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在系统层：第一，证明了在多模型部署场景下，「先做轻量检索/探查再路由」的两阶段架构可以把昂贵大模型的能力前置摊薄，用一个极小的 7B 搜索模型承担信息收集工作，路由决策质量显著高于纯文本路由；第二，提出了「等解题率下的单位解题成本」这一部署导向指标，以及「盲混合基线」作为路由系统的最低有效门槛，避免了只看准确率或只看成本的片面评估；第三，搜索器隐藏状态作为路由特征、以及基于简历的 N 路可扩展路由池设计，对后续 agent 系统的模型编排和推理预算分配有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 整体架构叫 Scrouting（Scout + Routing），分三步：1）用一个 7B 规模的搜索模型 SuperScout-7B 先遍历仓库，输出结构化交接包——包括涉及的文件列表、诊断说明、候选复现测试；2）所有交接内容进入沙箱验证，不成立的声明被剔除，避免错误信息污染下游；3）路由阶段同时使用原始任务文本和搜索器的隐藏状态作为特征，采用「简历式」N 路路由池：每个候选修复模型对应一份历史表现简历，路由时做匹配打分，新增修复模型不需要重新训练路由模块。和已有方法的核心区别：路由发生在仓库探查之后，而不是之前；路由目标是成本控制而非准确率提升；引入了沙箱验证的交接包作为中间表示，而不是直接传递原始文本。
summary.experiments: 核心实验在 SWE-bench Pro 的完整 Python 子集（266 个任务）上，按官方封顶预算协议评测：SuperScout 解题 159/266，略高于最强单模型的 158/266，单位解题总成本 0.230 美元，仅为最强单模型 1.274 美元的约 1/5；搜索器本身的全部 GPU 开销仅 1.13 美元，占比可忽略。前置审计实验在三个 SWE 基准上重放已发表的逐任务结果：不同模型解题集合的包含度在 0.773–0.941 之间，即使只比较前沿模型之间也在 0.90–0.93，说明解题集高度嵌套；所有测试过的学习型路由（k-NN、逻辑回归、MLP、聚类、语言规则）都没有稳定超过始终调用最强模型的策略。配对校准实验在 100 个新任务上显示：交接包的作用是重新分配解题能力——提升三个较便宜修复模型的表现，略微削弱最强模型；搜索器隐藏状态对成本路由有增益，而交接包文本本身没有。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看三部分：1）第 3 节的路由前置审计和解题集嵌套度分析，这是整篇工作的动机基础，附录 A 的完整审计表可以快速扫一眼确认结论稳定性；2）第 4–5 节的 Scrouting 架构和沙箱验证流程，理解交接包的结构和过滤机制；3）第 6 节的盲混合基线定义和第 7 节的主结果，重点把握「等解题率下的单位成本」这个指标的构造逻辑。值得深挖的点：搜索器隐藏状态作为路由特征的可迁移性，以及沙箱验证的开销在更大规模任务上的伸缩性。

summary_en.core_problem: In repository-level code repair, existing routers make decisions solely from issue text before any model touches the codebase, so they cannot exploit repository structure and fail to materially reduce per-task cost while preserving the strongest model's solve rate. Prior routing work also targets accuracy gains, but real-world solve sets across models are heavily nested, leaving almost no headroom for accuracy-oriented routing.
summary_en.importance: The main implications for pretraining research sit at the system layer. First, a two-stage "lightweight scouting then routing" architecture is shown to amortize the cost of expensive frontier models: a tiny 7B search model handles information gathering, and routing quality substantially improves over text-only routers. Second, it introduces a deployment-oriented metric — total cost per solve at matched solve rate — together with a blind-mixing baseline as the minimum bar for any useful routing system, avoiding one-sided evaluation on either accuracy or cost alone. Third, using the searcher's hidden states as routing features, plus a résumé-style N-way router pool that supports adding fixers without retraining, offers direct design cues for model orchestration and inference budget allocation in agent systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The full pipeline is called Scrouting (Scout + Routing) and runs in three steps. (1) A 7B search model, SuperScout-7B, first explores the repository and produces a structured handoff: implicated files, diagnostic notes, and a candidate reproduction test. (2) Every claim in the handoff goes through sandbox verification, and unverified claims are stripped before downstream consumption. (3) Routing uses both the original task text and the searcher's hidden states as features, with a résumé-based N-way pool: each candidate fixer is associated with a résumé of historical performance, and routing scores against it, so adding a new fixer requires no retraining. Key differences from prior work: routing happens after repository scouting, not before; the objective is cost control rather than accuracy; and a verified structured handoff serves as the intermediate representation instead of raw text.
summary_en.experiments: The main evaluation runs on the full Python slice of SWE-bench Pro (266 tasks) under the official capped-budget protocol. SuperScout resolves 159/266 tasks, slightly above the best single fixer's 158/266, at a total cost per solve of $0.230 versus $1.274 for the strongest model — roughly a 5x reduction. The searcher's total GPU cost across the evaluation is only $1.13, negligible in the overall budget. A pre-hoc audit replays published per-task outcomes on three SWE benchmarks: solve-set containment ranges from 0.773 to 0.941 across model pairs, and 0.90–0.93 even among frontier-only pools, confirming heavy nesting. None of the learned routers tested (k-NN, logistic, MLP, clustering, language-rule baselines) reliably beats always calling the strongest model. A paired calibration study on 100 fresh tasks shows the handoff redistributes rather than adds solving ability: it lifts the three cheaper fixers while slightly hurting the strongest, and hidden-state features improve cost-aware routing, whereas the handoff text alone does not.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, estimated 25–35 minutes. Focus on three parts. (1) Section 3's pre-routing audit and solve-set nesting analysis, which is the real motivational foundation of the work; Appendix A's full audit tables can be scanned quickly to confirm robustness. (2) Sections 4–5 on the Scrouting architecture and sandbox verification gate, to understand the handoff structure and filtering mechanism. (3) Section 6's definition of the blind-mixing baseline and Section 7's main results, especially the construction logic of "cost per solve at matched solve rate". Points worth deeper follow-up: transferability of searcher hidden states as routing features, and how sandbox verification overhead scales to much larger task volumes.

recommendation.zh: 路由前先做 sandbox 验证的 handoff 是干净设计；对 test-time 路由有借鉴，看 §3 和成本表即可。
recommendation.en: The sandbox-verified handoff before routing is a clean design; useful for test-time routing. Read §3 and the cost table.

paper.title: EASy: Towards Efficient LLM-Based Agentic System
paper.abstract: Agentic systems have emerged as a promising paradigm for solving complex tasks by coordinating specialized LLM-based agents. However, most existing systems primarily optimize task success while giving limited consideration to execution efficiency under practical constraints such as executor capability and computational cost. Existing router-based methods have limited ability to reason over rich, evolving task contexts, multi-step dependencies, and intermediate execution feedback, and often gener

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是异构 LLM agent 系统里的一个老问题：如何让 orchestrator 不只追求任务成功率，还能在真实约束下同时考虑执行器能力、调用成本、延迟和中间反馈，学会做动态、分阶段、可泛化的调度决策。现有 router 往往是轻量分类器或打分器，适合单步分发，不擅长处理长程依赖、任务分解、并行执行和执行后再规划；固定工作流则更难适应任务过程中不断变化的上下文。EASy 把这个问题表述成一个可训练的 sequential decision problem：给定一组能力和成本不同的 executors，由 LLM orchestrator 在 milestone 级别做分解、规划、分配和重规划，并用强化学习直接优化性能与效率的折中。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身，它不是直接的 pretrain recipe 论文；但对 pretrain↔posttrain 接口有现实意义。第一，它把“模型能力”与“系统级成本”放进同一个训练目标里，这和近来 RLVR、test-time compute allocation、mixture routing 的研究方向是连着的。第二，它说明如果要让 LLM 学会资源感知决策，仅靠静态 prompt 或外部 router 不够，训练信号需要覆盖中间状态、分支策略和不完整轨迹。第三，它提供了一种把 executor profile 显式写入上下文、再通过 RL 学习泛化到未见执行器的做法，这对未来的 model routing、tool routing、MoE-style external expert selection 都有参考价值。贡献量级更像系统训练范式上的扎实推进，而不是改变基座建模范式。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心有三层。第一层是 milestone-plan-act 工作流。orchestrator 先把复杂任务拆成若干 milestones，而不是直接细到原子步骤。这样做有两个目的：一是减少低层执行噪声，让策略学习看到更稳定的状态转移；二是给并行执行留空间，因为 milestone 内部可以构建 dependency-aware execution graph，把互不依赖的步骤并发交给不同 executors。第二层是显式 executor profiling。每个 executor 都带有能力描述和成本信息，orchestrator 在决策时不仅看任务内容，也看“谁更强、谁更贵、谁适合当前子任务”。这和传统 router 只基于 query embedding 或历史统计做分发不同，EASy 让调度模型直接在语言上下文里推理 executor 的 profile，因此更容易适应 executor 集合变化。第三层是 end-to-end RL 训练。作者采用 tree-structured rollout，从一个初始轨迹出发，对 milestone 节点或 plan 节点展开替代分支，得到在相近上下文下的多种策略样本。奖励由三部分组成：任务正确性、执行效率、轨迹完整性。前两项对应效果与成本，后一项用于避免策略通过提前终止或局部完成来投机。奖励还做了 node-level 和 query-level normalization，目的是让不同分支、不同任务之间的学习信号可比，降低高方差。和普通单轨迹 RL 相比，这种树状展开更像在局部决策点上做 counterfactual exploration，监督密度更高，也更适合多步 orchestration。
summary.experiments: 全文给出的实验覆盖三类任务：数学推理、具身决策、deep research。摘要明确声称 EASy 在 performance-efficiency trade-off 上稳定优于现有 agentic baselines，且消融显示 milestone-plan-act、tree rollout、reward design 和对未见 executors 的泛化能力都各自有明显贡献。就论文定位看，关键结果不是单纯最高成功率，而是在相同或更低成本下取得更高任务完成度，或者在相同成功率下显著降低 executor 开销。作者还特别强调了 generalization to unseen executors，这一点比很多只在固定 executor pool 上调 prompt 的系统更有方法价值。当前给出的全文片段没有包含完整表格数字、模型规模、训练步数和具体成本降幅，因此无法安全填写精确数值；但从实验设计可以确认，论文重点看的是 Pareto front，而不是单点 accuracy。读的时候应特别留意：1）效率指标如何定义，是否统一折算为 token cost / latency / API cost；2）tree rollout 的分支深度和扩展策略；3）reward normalization 是否显著改善训练稳定性；4）未见 executor 泛化实验到底是 profile 改写、能力替换，还是新增 executor。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先抓三处。第一看方法总览图和 milestone-plan-act 的例子，理解它为什么不做 step-level 全细粒度规划。第二看 RL 训练部分，重点是 tree-structured rollout 如何选节点扩展、奖励三项各自怎么定义、normalization 怎么做。第三看主结果图，确认作者比较的是成功率、成本和两者折中，而不是只报一个 aggregate score。预计 25–35 分钟能抓住主线。如果只想判断是否值得深读，优先看 introduction、method overview、reward design、generalization/ablation 四部分。需要带着一点保留：这类 agent orchestration 论文常见问题是 benchmark 依赖较强、成本模型容易任务特定、以及 RL 收益是否来自更强的 search budget 而非更好的 policy。读实验时要主动检查这些点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a practical orchestration problem in heterogeneous LLM agent systems: how to train an orchestrator that does not optimize only task success, but also reasons over executor capability, cost, latency, intermediate feedback, and changing task context. Existing routers are usually lightweight predictors for one-shot dispatch. They are weak at multi-step dependencies, adaptive replanning, and generalization to unseen executors. EASy formulates orchestration as a trainable sequential decision problem where an LLM orchestrator decomposes a task into milestones, plans dependency-aware execution, assigns executors, and updates decisions based on intermediate outcomes, while reinforcement learning directly optimizes the performance-efficiency trade-off.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it matters for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. First, it puts model capability and system cost into one training objective, which is closely related to current work on RLVR, compute allocation, and routing under resource constraints. Second, it shows that resource-aware decision making is hard to get from prompting or static routers alone; the training signal needs to cover intermediate states, alternative branches, and incomplete trajectories. Third, the explicit use of executor profiles inside the context, combined with RL for generalization to unseen executors, is relevant to future model routing, tool routing, and even external-expert selection in MoE-like systems. The contribution is best read as a solid systems-and-training advance rather than a new base modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three main components. First is the milestone-plan-act workflow. Instead of planning at the finest step granularity from the start, the orchestrator first decomposes a complex query into milestones. This reduces low-level execution noise and gives the policy a more stable state abstraction. Within each milestone, it builds a dependency-aware execution graph and can run independent steps in parallel across executors. Second is explicit executor profiling. Each executor comes with textual descriptions of capability and cost, so the orchestrator reasons jointly over task requirements and executor profiles rather than routing by query features alone. This differs from standard learned routers that often rely on shallow signals and fixed executor sets. Third is end-to-end RL with tree-structured rollout. Starting from an initial trajectory, the system expands selected milestone or plan nodes into alternative branches, producing multiple strategies under comparable contexts. Rewards combine task correctness, execution efficiency, and trajectory completeness. The completeness term is important because otherwise the policy may exploit partial execution or early stopping. Rewards are normalized at both node and query levels to make signals more comparable across branches and tasks and to reduce variance. Compared with standard single-trajectory RL, this branch-based exploration gives denser supervision around local decision points and is better aligned with multi-step orchestration.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover three task families: mathematical reasoning, embodied decision making, and deep research. The main claim is consistent improvement on the performance-efficiency frontier over prior agentic baselines. The key result is not simply higher success rate, but better task completion at the same or lower cost, or lower executor cost at comparable performance. The paper also emphasizes generalization to unseen executors, which is more informative than evaluations on a fixed executor pool. The provided full-content excerpt does not include the final tables with exact numbers, model sizes, training steps, or cost reductions, so it would be unsafe to invent precise metrics. Still, the experimental structure makes clear what to inspect: how efficiency is measured, whether cost is token-based or latency-based, how deep the rollout tree goes, whether reward normalization stabilizes training, and what “unseen executor” means operationally—new profiles, swapped capabilities, or newly introduced executors.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick pass, focus on three parts. First, read the method overview and the milestone-plan-act example to understand why the paper avoids fully atomic planning. Second, read the RL section carefully, especially node expansion in tree rollout, the three reward components, and the normalization scheme. Third, inspect the main result figures to verify that the comparison is really about the Pareto trade-off between performance and cost, not a single blended score. A 25–35 minute skim should be enough to capture the main ideas. If deciding whether it deserves deeper reading, prioritize the introduction, method overview, reward design, and the generalization/ablation sections. Keep a healthy skepticism on three common failure modes in this line of work: benchmark-specific cost models, gains that come from larger search budget rather than a better policy, and weak transfer outside the curated executor pool.

recommendation.zh: 只看 RL reward 和 unseen-executor 实验；若成本记账干净，它可作为 agentic test-time compute 分配的弱基线。
recommendation.en: Read the RL reward and unseen-executor experiments; if the cost accounting is clean, it is a useful weak baseline for agentic test-time compute allocation.

paper.title: Diagnosing Search Behavior and Failure Modes in Long-Horizon Search Agents
paper.abstract: Deep search agents answer difficult information-seeking questions by iteratively issuing search queries to gather supporting evidence, but it remains unclear whether and how greater search effort leads to better answers. We study these questions through a trajectory-level diagnosis of long-horizon search agents. Using human-annotated document-level relevance judgments, we evaluate the evidence retrieved at each search step and separate two stages of agent behavior: what evidence an agent retriev

summary.core_problem: 长程搜索智能体通常用最终答案准确率来评价，但轨迹本身是黑箱：更多搜索步数、更长上下文和更多工具调用并不一定对应更好的答案，也无法区分错误是因为没找到证据，还是找到了证据却没有正确使用。
summary.importance: 对训练和改进 deep research / search agent 有直接诊断价值。它把 agent 失败拆成 retrieval gap 和 utilization gap，说明不同能力档位的 agent 需要不同修复方向：弱 agent 主要问题在查询生成和证据召回，强 agent 的瓶颈转向验证和答案归一化。对预训练研究者的启发是，长程能力不能只靠最终指标或搜索预算衡量，轨迹级信号应成为训练和评测的一部分。
summary.technical_approach: 构建轨迹级诊断框架，在 BrowseComp-Plus 上使用人工标注的文档级相关性判断，逐 step 评估 agent 检索到的证据。框架将行为分成两端：检索端看 agent 找到了哪些 gold evidence，利用端看这些证据是否被正确转化为答案。错误被分为 retrieval gap（必要证据从未被检索到）和 utilization gap（相关证据已在上下文中但答案仍错）。分析还覆盖搜索量、上下文消耗、cumulative gold-evidence recall、episode 级证据到达时间、重复查询和查询策略。六个 agent 在统一 ReAct 框架、工具和检索器下比较，包括 mid-scale 的 Tongyi DeepResearch、Qwen3.5-35B-A3B、gpt-oss-120b，以及 frontier-scale 的 Kimi K2.6、GLM 5.1、DeepSeek V4 Pro，并在 BrowseComp open-web 设置上验证主要结论。
summary.experiments: 关键结果有五点。第一，搜索步数和上下文花费不预测准确率，较准的 agent 往往也更便宜。第二，cumulative gold-evidence recall 与最终准确率强相关：同一问题上，找到关键证据的 agent 通常答对，没找到的几乎答错。第三，错误可稳定分成 retrieval gap 和 utilization gap；准确率相近的 agent 可能位于这一划分的两端，因此修复方式不能只看 leaderboard。第四，证据通常在轨迹早期出现，之后大量 episode 不增加新证据；错误轨迹会在没有找到剩余证据的情况下继续搜索，形成 wasted tail。第五，强 agent 的特征不是搜得更多，而是查询更干净，冗余重查更少；查询风格本身不是决定因素，关键是查询是否落到证据上。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看五个 findings 的组织逻辑，再重点看 outcome attribution、failure-mode taxonomy 和 trajectory mechanism 三部分。图表上应关注搜索 effort 与准确率的散点关系、gold-evidence recall 与准确率的关系、retrieval/utilization gap 的分解，以及证据到达时间随 episode 的分布。对做 agent 训练或 RL 的人，值得进一步思考如何把 retrieval recall、证据到达效率和 verification 信号做成 reward 或训练目标；对做系统的人，可关注 snippet-stream 管理、低价值页面访问过滤和上下文污染问题。预计阅读时间 30–40 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon search agents are usually evaluated by final answer accuracy, leaving the trajectory opaque: more search steps, larger context, and heavier tool use do not necessarily yield better answers, and final metrics cannot distinguish failures caused by missing evidence from failures caused by misusing evidence that was already retrieved.
summary_en.importance: The work gives a useful trajectory-level diagnosis for training and improving deep research agents. It separates retrieval gaps from utilization gaps and shows that agents at different capability levels need different fixes: weaker agents are limited mainly by query direction and evidence recall, while stronger agents are closer to an oracle-reader ceiling and need better verification and answer normalization. For foundation-model researchers, the main implication is that long-horizon ability should not be measured only by final scores or search budgets; trajectory-level signals should inform both evaluation and training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces a diagnostic framework grounded in human-annotated document-level relevance judgments on BrowseComp-Plus. At each search step, it evaluates what evidence the agent retrieves and how effectively that evidence is used. Errors are decomposed into retrieval gaps, where necessary evidence is never found, and utilization gaps, where relevant evidence is retrieved but the answer remains wrong. The analysis tracks search volume, context spend, cumulative gold-evidence recall, episode-level evidence arrival, repeated queries, and query strategy. Six agents are compared under the same ReAct framework, tools, and retriever: Tongyi DeepResearch, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, and gpt-oss-120b at mid-scale, and Kimi K2.6, GLM 5.1, and DeepSeek V4 Pro at frontier scale. The main conclusions are also validated on BrowseComp with open-web search.
summary_en.experiments: There are five central findings. First, search volume and context spend do not predict accuracy; more accurate agents are often cheaper. Second, cumulative gold-evidence recall tracks accuracy closely: on the same question, agents that retrieve the decisive evidence usually answer correctly, while agents that miss it almost never do. Third, failures split into retrieval gaps and utilization gaps, and agents with similar accuracy can have opposite balances, so fixes should be diagnosis-specific rather than leaderboard-specific. Fourth, evidence usually arrives early, after which many episodes add no new evidence; incorrect trajectories keep searching without recovering missing evidence, producing a wasted tail. Fifth, stronger agents search more cleanly rather than more; redundant re-querying is rare in successful runs and marks failure, while the broad query style matters less than whether queries actually land on evidence.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the five findings and then focus on outcome attribution, failure-mode taxonomy, and trajectory mechanism. The most useful figures are likely the scatter plots of search effort versus accuracy, the relationship between cumulative gold-evidence recall and accuracy, the retrieval/utilization error decomposition, and the episode-level evidence arrival curves. Readers working on agent training or RL can consider how retrieval recall, evidence arrival efficiency, and verification could become rewards or training signals. Readers working on systems can focus on snippet-stream management, gating low-value page opens, and context pollution. Estimated reading time: 30–40 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读失败分解和 effort-quality 曲线即可；它给 test-time search scaling 泼冷水，setup 比常见 agent demo 干净。
recommendation.en: Read the failure decomposition and effort-quality curves; it is a cleaner warning against naive test-time search scaling than typical agent demos.

paper.title: MetaRoute-Bench: Evaluating Meta-Decision Policies for Agentic Workflow Routing
paper.abstract: Agentic systems must repeatedly decide whether to answer directly, decompose a task, invoke a tool, execute code, delegate to a specialist, verify an intermediate result, or recover from failure. These meta-decisions affect not only task success but also operating cost and latency, yet they are often embedded inside an orchestration framework and evaluated only through aggregate task accuracy. We present MetaRoute-Bench, an open, inspectable framework for comparing meta-decision policies under a

summary.core_problem: 现有Agent系统的元决策（即选择直接回答、任务拆解、工具调用、代码执行、专家委托、结果验证、故障恢复等高层路由选择）策略通常内嵌在编排框架中，仅通过整体任务准确率评估，缺乏可独立检验的框架来隔离策略并衡量其在成功率、运行成本、延迟之间的权衡。
summary.importance: 将Agent的路由策略层从基础模型能力中单独剥离评测，指出了当前Agent评测仅关注最终准确率的盲区。该框架为后续Agent预训练研究（如专门训练路由策略、将元决策能力内化到基座模型）提供了标准化的诊断工具，也明确了Agent的实际运行表现同时取决于基础模型质量与上层路由策略设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MetaRoute-Bench离线模拟评测框架，解耦为任务配置生成、路由策略、带种子的离线执行器、结构化轨迹导出、聚合/配对评测五个独立接口。构造了覆盖数据分析、研究、文档处理三类工作负载的180个合成任务配置，包含8种路由策略与30组配对随机种子，确保所有策略在相同任务与种子下评测。轨迹完整记录动作、失败、重试、成本、延迟等全链路信息，而非仅保留最终正确性；评测指标分别统计成功率、归一化成本、延迟，另设综合效用指标用于排序。
summary.experiments: 累计采集43200条轨迹，提出的任务感知组合式自适应策略（根据任务难度阈值选择最多3个操作，按拆解前置、验证后置的顺序排列，支持一次失败重试）成功率达79.4%，较单次路由基线高2.7个百分点；消融实验量化了组合策略、验证、拆解、恢复机制的单独贡献，同时验证了不必要的操作会引入可观测的额外开销。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看引言中对现有Agent评测盲区的分析，再看框架部分的四个设计要求与模块划分逻辑，最后看实验中不同策略的对比结果与消融结论。预计阅读时间25~35分钟，合成任务的具体生成细节可跳过，核心价值在评测框架的设计思路与元决策的拆解维度。

summary_en.core_problem: Meta-decision routing policies in agentic systems (high-level routing choices including direct answering, task decomposition, tool invocation, code execution, specialist delegation, result verification, failure recovery) are typically embedded in orchestration frameworks and evaluated only via aggregate task accuracy, with no independently inspectable framework to isolate policies and measure their tradeoffs between success rate, operating cost, and latency.
summary_en.importance: The work isolates the routing policy layer from base model capabilities, revealing a blind spot in current agent evaluation. The framework provides a standardized diagnostic tool for future agent pre-training research, such as training dedicated routing policies or internalizing meta-decision capabilities into foundation models, and clarifies that agent operational performance depends on both base model quality and upper-layer routing policy design.
summary_en.technical_approach: MetaRoute-Bench is an offline simulated evaluation framework decoupled into five independent interfaces: deterministic task profile generator, routing policies, seeded offline executor, structured trace exporter, and aggregate/paired evaluator. It includes 180 synthetic task profiles across three workload families (data analysis, research, document processing), 8 routing policies, and 30 paired random seeds to ensure consistent task and seed parity across all policies. Traces record full action, failure, retry, cost, and latency information instead of only final correctness; evaluation metrics separately report success rate, normalized cost, latency, with an additional composite utility score for ranking.
summary_en.experiments: A total of 43,200 traces are collected. The proposed task-aware compositional adaptive policy, which selects up to 3 operations above difficulty-dependent thresholds, orders decomposition first and verification last, and supports one failure retry, achieves a 79.4% success rate, 2.7 percentage points higher than the one-shot routing baseline. Ablations quantify the individual contributions of composition, verification, decomposition, and recovery mechanisms, and confirm that unnecessary operations introduce measurable overhead.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the analysis of existing agent evaluation gaps in the introduction first, then review the four design requirements and module decomposition logic in the framework section, and focus on cross-policy comparison results and ablation conclusions in experiments. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes. Detailed synthetic task generation details can be skipped, as the core value lies in the evaluation framework's design logic and meta-decision decomposition dimensions.

recommendation.zh: 读任务生成和 paired-seed 设计；合成任务限制外推，但它把 agent 路由从黑盒框架里拆了出来。
recommendation.en: Read the task-generation and paired-seed design; synthetic tasks limit extrapolation, but the benchmark cleanly exposes agent routing decisions.

paper.title: Cognitive Demand Steering for Adaptive Meta-Reasoning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Recent meta-reasoning frameworks improve LLM reasoning by wrapping chain-of-thought generation in an iterative control loop, allowing more effective backtracking, termination of reasoning loops, and injection of promising reasoning patterns, among other strategy adjustments. Despite promising results, methods often rely on backward-looking reward functions, utilize coarse search actions, or require additional reasoning controller training requiring many-shot supervision. We introduce Cognitive D

summary.core_problem: 现有动作中心的元推理框架依赖离散动作集、固定模式切换、回溯式奖励，或需要额外多样本监督训练控制器，无法同时响应复杂任务的多重交互认知需求，也难以基于剩余任务难度自适应分配计算资源。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有三点：一是多维认知需求画像可作为预训练数据认知难度分级的参考维度，用于数据课程设计；二是剩余需求追踪的思路可为推理增强预训练（如内部思维链的RL训练）提供新的监督信号设计方向；三是无训练自适应推理框架的设计逻辑，可与预训练阶段的推理能力塑造形成互补。
summary.technical_approach: 提出认知需求引导（CDS）框架，属于无需训练的元推理方法，核心是将自适应推理重构为需求追踪问题。具体步骤：1）为输入任务生成16维认知需求画像，维度基于已有认知量表定义，覆盖语言理解、相关信息识别、逻辑推理、定量推理、多领域知识检索等能力；2）推理过程中迭代评估部分解在各维度的完成度，计算剩余认知需求（需求差）作为控制器核心状态，替代传统离散动作集；3）结合自写验证测试、不确定性估计、推理健康检查得到的风险等级，驱动早停决策、动作规划、自适应验证目标生成（如边界用例检查、结果反向验证），还支持组合注入多种行为模式引导推理，而非每次仅选择单一粗粒度模式。
summary.experiments: 当前提供的全文片段未包含完整实验章节，仅提及在LiveCodeBench-Hard等复杂推理任务上验证方法效果，核心对比维度为推理准确率与计算开销的权衡。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注方法章节中认知需求维度的定义、剩余需求评估机制，以及引言部分对现有元推理框架缺陷的分类梳理，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing action-centric meta-reasoning frameworks rely on discrete action sets, fixed mode switches, backward-looking reward functions, or additional controller training with extensive supervision. They cannot address multiple interacting cognitive demands of complex tasks, nor allocate compute adaptively based on remaining task difficulty.
summary_en.importance: The work offers three relevant insights for pretraining research: first, multi-dimensional cognitive demand profiles can inform cognitive difficulty grading of pretraining data for curriculum design; second, residual demand tracking provides a new direction for supervision signal design in reasoning-enhanced pretraining (e.g., RL training for internal chain-of-thought); third, the training-free adaptive reasoning design can complement reasoning capability shaping during pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Cognitive Demand Steering (CDS) is a training-free meta-reasoning framework that reframes adaptive reasoning as demand tracking. It first generates a 16-dimensional cognitive demand profile for each task, with dimensions grounded in established cognitive scales covering verbal comprehension, relevant information identification, logical reasoning, quantitative reasoning, and multi-domain knowledge retrieval. During inference, it iteratively evaluates completion of each dimension for partial solutions, and computes residual cognitive demand as the core controller state instead of traditional discrete action sets. Combined with risk levels derived from self-written validation tests, uncertainty estimation, and reasoning health checks, the demand gap drives early stopping, action planning, and adaptive verification target generation (e.g., edge case checking, inverse verification). It also supports compositional injection of multiple behavior modes instead of selecting a single coarse mode per step.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full text fragment does not include the complete experimental section. The work is reported to be validated on complex reasoning tasks such as LiveCodeBench-Hard, with core comparison dimensions of reasoning accuracy and compute cost tradeoff.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the definition of cognitive demand dimensions and residual demand assessment mechanism in the method section, as well as the classification of limitations of existing meta-reasoning frameworks in the introduction. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: DeepMind提出的免训练元推理框架，核心是将传统的后顾性reward转变为前瞻性的'剩余推理需求'评估，对test-time scaling和复杂推理控制有启发。
recommendation.en: A training-free meta-reasoning framework from DeepMind, whose core is shifting from traditional backward-looking rewards to forward-looking 'residual reasoning demand' assessment, inspiring test-time scaling and complex reasoning control.

paper.title: Distilling Reasoning Traces into Advisory Prompts for Software Engineering Tasks
paper.abstract: Language models are widely used for generating and otherwise processing code (e.g., identifying code hallucinations, possible inputs, or predicting outputs); however, LLMs can make mistakes, which can be serious. One key issue is that models are trained on (still) largely human-written, and thus imperfect, code; it's not easy to find sufficiently large code corpora that are entirely free of bugs. Thus, other inference-time ways of reducing LLM errors, without additional training, are desirable.

summary.core_problem: 研究能否把 reasoning mode 产生的错误分析和反思压缩成 advisory prompts，从而在软件工程任务上减少错误而不总是支付推理开销。
summary.importance: 贡献是代码任务中的 inference-time prompting 策略，试图把昂贵 reasoning traces 转化为可复用的轻量提示。它对后训练和推理时计算分配有轻微信号，但不是预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 方法模拟人类学习编程错误的过程：先识别 LLM 在代码相关任务中的错误，再使用 reasoning/thinking mode 反思导致错误的认知失误，抽取通用规则或 lesson，最后把这些规则作为 advisory prompts 注入后续非 reasoning 推理。整体更像提示蒸馏，而不是参数蒸馏或 SFT。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到面向代码生成、代码幻觉识别、输入推断、输出预测等软件工程任务，目标是在不开启完整 reasoning 的情况下改善表现；未给出具体模型、数据集、baseline 数值、成本下降比例或统计显著性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether reasoning-mode traces can be compressed into advisory prompts that reduce errors on software-engineering tasks without always paying the cost of reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time prompting strategy for code tasks. It turns expensive reasoning traces into reusable lightweight guidance. It is mildly relevant to post-training and test-time compute allocation, but it is not a pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method mimics how programming students learn from mistakes: identify model errors, use reasoning mode to reflect on the cognitive lapses behind them, infer general rules or lessons, and inject those lessons as advisory prompts during later non-reasoning inference. This is closer to prompt distillation than parameter distillation or SFT.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract discusses software-engineering tasks such as code generation, code-hallucination identification, input inference, and output prediction. It aims to improve performance without full reasoning mode, but does not provide model names, dataset sizes, baseline numbers, cost reductions, or significance tests in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 作为 reasoning trace 压缩成提示的弱信号保留；若正文没有成本-质量曲线，就不值得细读。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a weak signal on compressing reasoning traces into prompts; without a cost-quality curve, it is not worth a close read.

paper.title: SVR: Self-Verifying Refinement via Joint Verdict-Confidence Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Test-Time Compute
paper.abstract: Scaling test-time computation can improve language-model reasoning, but uniform budgets waste computation on easy inputs, while verifier-guided refinement relies on external feedback. We introduce Self-Verifying Refinement (SVR), an oracle-free multi-turn reinforcement learning framework that learns to use self-verification as a compute-control policy. At each turn, the model produces a solution together with a discrete correctness verdict and a confidence score; it retains the current answer on

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是多轮推理 refinement 中的计算分配问题：模型什么时候应该保留当前答案，什么时候应该继续修改。关键约束是推理时不能依赖外部 verifier、执行器或真实正确性信号，只能用模型自己生成的判断和置信度来控制停止。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 reasoning post-train 和 test-time compute 设计有参考价值。它把 self-verification 从一个事后解释信号，变成了控制推理预算的策略信号。这个角度值得注意，因为后续预训练或中训练如果要培养可控推理能力，不能只看最终答案正确率，还要看模型能否识别当前状态是否值得继续计算。论文也提醒一个实际问题：置信度校准错误会直接变成计算分配错误。低估会浪费 refinement，高估会提前停止在错误答案上。
summary.technical_approach: SVR 让模型在每一轮同时输出三类内容：解答、离散 verdict，以及一个表示当前答案正确概率的 confidence。verdict 包括 Correct、Incorrect、Unsure。推理时，如果 verdict 是 Correct 且 confidence 超过阈值，就停止并返回当前答案；否则把原题、上一轮解答和模型自己的 self-verification 一起放入下一轮 prompt，继续 refinement。训练使用固定 horizon 轨迹，不在训练阶段直接优化实际 token 用量。奖励来自真实正确性，但真实标签只用于构造 reward，不进入 refinement prompt，也不在推理时使用。优化目标基于 GRPO，把每轮的解题得分、self-verification 得分和格式得分合成 trajectory return。一个细节是：中间轮参与 return 计算并作为后续上下文，但不是独立优化样本；被监督的是最终 completion tokens。confidence 部分使用类似 Brier score 的校准目标，并额外惩罚高置信错误，鼓励模型识别错误状态和可停止的正确状态。和固定预算 refinement 相比，SVR 的差别不在于多生成几轮，而在于把“是否继续”变成了模型内部策略。和外部 verifier 方法相比，它把部署时的信息边界收紧到模型自身输出。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen3.5-2B，在 7 个数学推理 benchmark 上评估，覆盖算术搜索、小学数学应用题、竞赛数学和多步推理。SVR 的 All-7 macro-average accuracy 为 0.563，平均推理轮数为 2.99。相对最强 non-oracle 多轮 baseline 提升 7.5 个百分点；在完整系统比较中，比论文评估的 fixed-budget oracle-guided reference 高 4.4 个百分点。固定预算 sweep 显示，同一个训练后 policy 如果强制所有样本在同一轮停止，没有任何一个共享停止轮能匹配自适应 SVR，说明收益主要来自按样本保留答案，而不是简单增加 refinement 轮数。论文还报告 SVR 在总准确率上接近 10-sample GRPO majority voting，但 token 消耗大约只有一半。这个结果支持 self-verification 作为内部 compute-control signal 的可行性，但也要注意实验集中在数学推理和 2B 规模模型，结论还不能直接外推到更大模型、代码执行类任务或开放式任务。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction、方法部分的 Joint Verdict–Confidence RL、推理时 stopping rule，以及 Table 1 / Figure 1 附近的主结果。重点看两个问题：第一，reward 如何同时约束答案正确性、verdict 和 confidence；第二，固定 horizon 训练为什么仍能在推理时产生计算节省。消融部分如果完整可见，应优先看 confidence 阈值、verdict 类型、去掉校准项、固定停止轮 sweep。预计阅读 20–30 分钟即可把主要设计和局限看清。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets adaptive refinement for reasoning models: when should a model keep its current answer, and when should it spend another refinement turn? The key constraint is that inference cannot rely on an external verifier, executor, or correctness oracle. The stopping decision must be driven by signals produced by the policy itself.
summary_en.importance: This is more relevant to reasoning post-training and inference-time compute than to base pretraining directly. Its useful contribution is to treat self-verification as a control signal, not merely as a post-hoc uncertainty statement. That distinction matters because confidence calibration errors become compute-allocation errors: underconfidence wastes refinement on already-correct answers, while overconfidence can terminate incorrect trajectories too early. For pretraining researchers interested in trainable reasoning behavior, the paper points to a concrete interface between answer quality, calibration, and compute control.
summary_en.technical_approach: SVR makes the model emit, at every turn, a solution, a discrete verdict, and a confidence estimate. The verdict is one of Correct, Incorrect, or Unsure. At inference, the trajectory stops only when the verdict is Correct and the confidence exceeds a threshold; otherwise, the next prompt includes the original problem, the previous solution, and the model’s own self-verification. Correctness labels are used during training to build rewards, but they are never inserted into refinement prompts and are not available to the inference controller. Training uses fixed-horizon trajectories with a GRPO-style objective.
