The ablation compares an individual baseline, a homogeneous framework, redundant homogeneous solvers, and a heterogeneous framework. The abstract indicates an analysis of framework structure versus model diversity, but does not expose model sizes, training data, or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看消融表即可；这是常见多 Agent 编排，若异质性收益清楚，可作为 test-time scaling 的边角证据。
recommendation.en: Skim only the ablation table; this is standard multi-agent orchestration, useful mainly if the diversity effect is clean enough to inform test-time scaling.

paper.title: Cost-Effective Agent Harnesses for Abstract Reasoning and Generalization on ARC-AGI-1
paper.abstract: Recent progress on ARC-AGI-1 from disclosed architectures has come broadly from two regimes: heavy test-time compute over frontier models (evolutionary search, exhaustive sampling, extended chain-of-thought), or benchmark-specific training in which small models are fine-tuned on ARC data, often with task-specialized architectures. We study a third regime: an open-weight model in non-thinking mode (DeepSeek V3.2) under a strict budget, with no ARC-specific fine-tuning. We study what is recoverabl

summary.core_problem: 研究在不做 ARC 专项微调、限制预算、使用开源权重模型的条件下，agent 编排能在 ARC-AGI-1 上恢复多少抽象推理能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent harness 方法分析。它把 ARC 上常见的两类路线——重测试时计算和 benchmark-specific training——之外的第三条路线单独拿出来测，重点不是模型能力本身，而是编排层如何组织模式发现和程序合成。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Explorer-Definer Pipeline，将 pattern discovery 与 executable transformation synthesis 拆成两阶段 agent 流水线；再提出 Reflective Orchestrator，在训练样例验证失败时自主探索新的变换假设。方法是对现有 LLM 的推理编排改造，不涉及预训练或模型参数更新。
summary.experiments: 使用 DeepSeek V3.2 非 thinking 模式，在严格预算下评测 ARC-AGI-1 public 400 任务；不做 ARC-specific fine-tuning。摘要未给出完整分数和对比表，只说明目标是用 harness 架构隔离可恢复能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how much ARC-AGI-1 abstract reasoning can be recovered by agent orchestration alone, using an open-weight model under a strict budget and without ARC-specific fine-tuning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-harness study. It isolates a third regime beyond heavy test-time compute and benchmark-specific training, focusing on how orchestration structures pattern discovery and program synthesis.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces an Explorer-Definer Pipeline that separates pattern discovery from executable transformation synthesis, followed by a Reflective Orchestrator that explores new transformation hypotheses when previous ones fail on training pairs. This is an inference-time orchestration method, not a pretraining or fine-tuning recipe.
summary_en.experiments: The setup uses DeepSeek V3.2 in non-thinking mode on the ARC-AGI-1 public 400 tasks, with a strict compute budget and no ARC fine-tuning. The abstract does not provide complete scores or ablation tables.

recommendation.zh: 可作为低预算 agent 编排案例备查；预训练研究员只需看 pipeline 设计，别把 ARC 分数当模型能力结论。
recommendation.en: Useful as a low-budget agent orchestration case study; read the pipeline design, but do not treat ARC scores as clean evidence about model capability.

paper.title: Decision Protocols in Multi-Agent Large Language Model Conversations
paper.abstract: Improving the task performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) is essential, yet scaling these models faces significant challenges such as diminishing returns and high costs. Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) offer a promising solution by distributing tasks among specialized agents to improve the overall task performance. This can reduce training costs at the expense of increased test time due to the discussion and decision-making process. The decision protocol is a critical component of MAS because it

summary.core_problem: 研究多 LLM agent 对话中的最终决策协议如何影响任务表现，包括投票、共识和 judge 机制。
summary.importance: 贡献是对 multi-agent LLM 决策协议的系统比较，属于 agent test-time compute 与协作机制分析；它不是预训练方法，但对理解多模型推理时的计算分配和聚合策略有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出或整理 MALLM 框架，用统一框架模拟多 agent 对话，并比较 voting、consensus、judge decision 等协议在多类会话任务中的效果。方法重点不是训练新模型，而是改变推理时协作与答案汇聚方式。
summary.experiments: 摘要称覆盖从知识类任务到其他会话任务的多样数据集，并系统评估不同协议；未提供可确认的模型规模、具体 benchmark 名称、提升幅度或统计显著性结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 GippLab, Georg August University of Göttingen。

summary_en.core_problem: The thesis studies how final-decision protocols in multi-agent LLM conversations affect task performance, comparing voting, consensus, and judge-based mechanisms.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a systematic comparison of decision protocols for multi-agent LLMs. It is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to test-time compute allocation and aggregation behavior in multi-model reasoning systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work introduces or consolidates the MALLM framework to simulate multi-agent discussions under a unified setup, evaluating voting, consensus, and judge decision mechanisms across conversational task solving. The main lever is inference-time collaboration rather than model training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract says the study evaluates a diverse set of tasks, ranging from knowledge-oriented tasks to other conversational settings, but it does not provide concrete model sizes, benchmark names, effect sizes, or statistical details.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is affiliated with GippLab, Georg August University of Göttingen.

recommendation.zh: 可看实验表判断 voting/judge 的相对收益；方法本身偏框架比较，不会改变对训练侧的判断。
recommendation.en: Worth checking the result tables for voting-versus-judge behavior; the method is mostly protocol comparison, not a training-side insight.

paper.title: LLM-as-a-Verifier: A General-Purpose Verification Framework
paper.abstract: Scaling pre-training, post-training, and test-time compute have become the central paradigms for improving the capabilities of LLMs. In this work, we identify verification, the ability to determine the correctness of a solution, as a new scaling axis. To unlock this and demonstrate its effectiveness, we introduce LLM-as-a-Verifier, a general-purpose verification framework that provides fine-grained feedback for agentic tasks without requiring additional training. Unlike standard LM judges that p

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM验证方法存在两类核心局限：一是基于提示的离散打分器将连续判断压缩为粗粒度离散分数，导致大量平局、区分度不足；二是训练得到的奖励模型受训练数据约束，跨领域泛化能力差。同时，验证能力本身没有像生成能力那样形成清晰的可扩展范式，制约了Agent系统与RL后训练的进一步提升。
summary.importance: 提出了验证能力的三条可扩展轴，为后训练阶段的奖励信号设计、Agent轨迹评估、RL样本效率提升提供了一套无需额外训练的通用方案。对预训练研究的启发在于：LLM内部logits分布本身携带细粒度质量信号，可被直接利用，不必依赖额外训练奖励模型或离散打分prompt。
summary.technical_approach: 核心思路是不要求LLM生成离散分数，而是直接读取打分token的logits分布，计算期望得到连续、细粒度的验证分数。在此基础上沿三个维度扩展验证能力：1）增加提取的logits token数量，降低平局率、提升正负样本分离度；2）重复多次评估取平均，降低方差；3）将评估准则拆分为多个子维度，降低单一prompt的偏差。进一步提出基于偏好概率的低成本排序算法，用于从多个候选解中选出最优解。该框架还可对整条交互轨迹打分，并作为密集奖励信号接入RL训练。
summary.experiments: 在多个领域取得强结果：Terminal-Bench V2 86.5%，SWE-Bench Verified 78.2%，RoboRewardBench轨迹偏好准确率87.4%，MedAgentBench 73.3%。机器人任务上与现有奖励模型Robometer、TOPReward、RoboReward对比，值序相关系数VOC均值达0.966。作为RL奖励信号时，机器人LIBERO基准上样本效率比稀疏奖励基线高约1.8倍，MATH推理基准上用GRPO微调Qwen3-8B时样本效率高约1.1倍。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3节方法部分，理解logits期望打分的数学形式与三条扩展轴的设计动机；第4节看离散打分基线的对比实验与平局率分析；第5节关注RL样本效率部分，理解密集信号如何转化为训练增益。附录中的prompt模板与logits提取细节值得参考。预计阅读时间40-60分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Current LLM verification suffers from two bottlenecks: prompt-based discrete judges collapse continuous judgments into coarse scores, causing massive ties and poor discrimination; learned reward models are bounded by training data and generalize poorly across domains. Unlike generation, verification has not developed a clear scaling paradigm, limiting further gains in agent systems and RL post-training.
summary_en.importance: It identifies three scalable axes for verification and provides a training-free general solution for reward signal design, agent trajectory evaluation, and RL sample efficiency improvement. A key implication for pretraining research is that LLM internal logit distributions already carry fine-grained quality signals, which can be exploited without training separate reward models or engineering discrete-score prompts.
summary_en.technical_approach: Instead of asking LLMs to emit discrete scores, the framework reads the full logit distribution over scoring tokens and computes the expectation to obtain continuous, fine-grained verification scores. Verification is then scaled along three dimensions: (1) increasing the number of logit tokens extracted to reduce tie rate and improve separation; (2) repeated evaluations to reduce variance; (3) criterion decomposition to reduce single-prompt bias. A cost-efficient ranking algorithm based on pairwise preference probabilities is further introduced to select the best candidate from a pool. The framework can score full interaction trajectories and serve as a dense reward signal for RL.
summary_en.experiments: Strong results across domains: Terminal-Bench V2 86.5%, SWE-Bench Verified 78.2%, RoboRewardBench trajectory preference accuracy 87.4%, MedAgentBench 73.3%. On robotic tasks it achieves a mean Value-Order Correlation (VOC) of 0.966, outperforming Robometer, TOPReward, and RoboReward. As an RL reward signal, it yields ~1.8x higher sample efficiency than sparse reward baselines on LIBERO, and ~1.1x higher sample efficiency on MATH when fine-tuning Qwen3-8B with GRPO.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the mathematical formulation of logit-expectation scoring and the motivation behind the three scaling axes; Section 4 for comparisons against discrete judge baselines and tie-rate analysis; Section 5 for RL sample efficiency results and how dense signals translate into training gains. Prompt templates and logit extraction details in the appendix are worth checking. Estimated reading time: 40-60 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不必全读，抓住 logits-expectation verifier；若做 RLVR 数据筛选，先看评分粒度和重复评估实验。
recommendation.en: No need to read end to end; extract the logits-expectation verifier idea, especially the granularity and repeated-evaluation results for RLVR data filtering.

paper.title: Don't Wait to Reply: Towards Responsive yet Thoughtful Dialogue through Proactive Thinking
paper.abstract: Thinking has emerged as a critical capability for Large Language Models (LLMs) tackling complex tasks. However, its reactive nature, where reasoning is passively triggered only upon receiving a user response, inevitably introduces latency that compromises conversational fluidity. This stands in sharp contrast to human dialogue, where speakers proactively anticipate and plan future content during natural pauses to ensure seamless interaction. To bridge this gap, we propose Proactive Thinking, a f

summary.core_problem: 对话式 LLM 的“思考”通常是被动触发的，导致响应延迟；如何在实时对话流中兼顾低延迟与思考质量。
summary.importance: 贡献更偏推理时/系统范式：把“空闲时间预计算”引入对话推理流程，并构造 time-aware 的评测环境；对预训练本身不是直接改动，但对 test-time compute 分配与交互式 agent 形态有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Proactive Thinking：在用户下一轮输入到来前，模型利用对话停顿主动预测未来状态并预生成潜在回复要素；给出 training-free baseline，通过 speculative continual thinking 在效率与质量间做权衡，并在时间约束环境中评估。
summary.experiments: 将三个不同复杂度 benchmark 改造成 time-aware 环境以模拟实时对话；摘要未给出具体模型/指标提升数值与延迟曲线细节。
summary.authors_note: 清华大学；AIR（清华智源/产业研究相关机构）

summary_en.core_problem: LLM dialogue reasoning is typically reactive, adding latency; how to keep conversations responsive while preserving thoughtful reasoning under real-time constraints.
summary_en.importance: More of an inference-time/system paradigm than pretraining: it reallocates test-time compute into idle periods and introduces time-aware evaluation setups, which can inform interactive agent design and compute scheduling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proactive Thinking: during conversational downtime, the model anticipates future states and pre-computes candidate response elements. A training-free baseline uses speculative continual thinking to trade off quality vs efficiency, evaluated in time-constrained dialogue environments.
summary_en.experiments: Adapts three benchmarks into time-aware environments simulating real-time flow; the abstract does not provide model sizes, exact metrics, or latency/quality curves.
summary_en.authors_note: Tsinghua University; Institute for AI Industry Research (AIR)

recommendation.zh: 把它当“对话场景的 test-time compute 调度”读：只看时间约束设定与延迟-质量权衡；对预训练没直接动作，结论主要取决于评测是否贴近真实。
recommendation.en: Read it as test-time compute scheduling for dialogue: focus on the time-aware setup and latency–quality trade-off; it doesn’t change pretraining, and conclusions hinge on how realistic the evaluation is.

institutions: Institute for AI Industry Research (AIR), Tsinghua University

paper.title: DecompRL: Solving Harder Problems by Learning Modular Code Generation
paper.abstract: How can Large Language Models (LLMs) solve problems they currently cannot? Repeated sampling scales test-time compute but GPU cost grows linearly with attempts, while reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards improves single-attempt accuracy at the expense of sample diversity. Both strategies ultimately fail when the base policy has near-zero probability of producing a correct solution: no amount of sampling or gradient signal can overcome a search space that is simply too large. We ta

summary.core_problem: 论文处理的是可验证代码生成里的冷启动探索问题：当基础模型几乎不会一次性写出正确完整程序时，单纯扩大 pass@k 采样成本线性增长，常规 RL 又容易提升 pass@1 但压缩多样性，二者都很难进入有奖励信号的区域。DecompRL 的目标是把完整程序搜索改写为模块搜索，通过问题分解降低单个生成单元的难度。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对基座研究有两点启发。第一，它把稀疏奖励下的探索问题显式改写为结构化生成问题，而不是只靠更大的采样预算或更强的 reward optimizer。第二，它适合产出难题上的正确轨迹，可用于后续蒸馏、SFT 或 RL 数据构造，缓解 hard task 上没有正样本的问题。贡献更偏 post-train 与数据生成接口，量级属于有方法启发的 skim，而不是基座训练 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把代码生成从整体程序的自回归采样，改成两阶段层级生成。模型先生成分解 D，D 由若干函数签名和 docstring 形式的自然语言规格组成；再为每个子函数独立生成实现 I_i，即建模为 π(D) 和 π(I_i | D)。关键假设是：给定分解计划后，各子函数实现可以近似条件独立。这个假设会牺牲单个完整样本的精确协同，但换来可重组性。若一个问题被拆成 n 个函数，每个函数采样 k 个实现，GPU 只需生成 n×k 个模块，却能在 CPU 上组合出 k^n 个完整候选程序，并用单元测试或私有测试验证。RL 部分使用 policy gradient，把完整组合的 0/1 验证奖励回传到分解策略和实现策略。论文强调它不是替代标准 RL：当初始策略已有较高成功率时，常规 RL 更省样本；DecompRL 更适合基础策略成功率接近零、但任务具有可组合结构且验证便宜的场景。主要取舍在于分解质量、模块接口设计、条件独立假设带来的接口不一致，以及组合爆炸后的 CPU 验证成本。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕 competitive programming 这类可验证代码任务展开，奖励定义为程序通过所有隐藏测试。论文给出的核心实验证据是：在高难度题上，标准整程序 pass@k 采样和常规 RL 难以找到正确解时，模块化采样加重组能发现正确组合；RL 训练进一步学习到更适合重组的分解和实现策略。可见全文片段没有给出完整的参数量、训练数据规模、题目集合大小、pass@k 提升幅度或消融数字，因此不宜补造具体数值。值得关注的消融应包括：只做 prompted decomposition 与 DecompRL 训练的差异；固定分解只训练实现策略与联合训练分解/实现策略的差异；模块数 n、每模块采样数 k 对成功率和验证成本的影响；以及重组收益是否来自真实模块互补，而不是简单增加总 token 预算。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 20–30 分钟。先看 Introduction，抓住作者对 pass@k、常规 RL 和冷启动失败模式的区分。再看 Method 的层级分解公式和 k^n 重组机制，这是核心。Section 4.1–4.3 值得重点扫，分别对应探索、多样性/重组效用、稀疏奖励发现。附录里的 prompt 模板和完整 trajectory 示例也有价值，因为这类方法的效果很依赖分解格式和接口约束。若只关心预训练，可重点读其如何把验证信号转成可蒸馏的正确轨迹，以及这种结构化搜索是否能反哺代码预训练或中训练数据构造。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets cold-start exploration in verifiable code generation. When the base policy has near-zero probability of producing a correct full program, scaling pass@k is expensive and often ineffective, while standard RL tends to improve pass@1 at the cost of sample diversity. DecompRL reframes the search space by decomposing a hard program into smaller, independently implementable modules.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining recipe, but it is relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface. It shows how sparse-reward exploration can be improved by changing the factorization of generation, rather than only increasing sampling or optimizing the same monolithic policy. The main value for foundation-model work is data generation: the method can discover correct trajectories on hard problems, which can then be distilled into SFT or RL pipelines. Its contribution is method-level and useful to skim, especially for code and verifiable reasoning training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method replaces monolithic autoregressive program generation with hierarchical generation. A decomposition policy first emits D, represented as function signatures plus natural-language docstrings. An implementation policy then samples implementations I_i for each function, modeled as π(D) and π(I_i | D). The key modeling assumption is conditional independence of module implementations given the decomposition. This can reduce coordination quality for any single sample, but it enables recombination. For n modules and k samples per module, the model spends GPU inference on only n×k module generations, while CPU-side validation can test up to k^n complete programs. The RL objective uses policy-gradient-style updates from binary verifier rewards on complete trajectories. The method is positioned as an exploration tool rather than a replacement for standard RL: standard RL is more sample-efficient when the initial policy already solves a nontrivial fraction of problems; DecompRL is meant for harder settings where the initial solve rate is nearly zero and verification is cheap.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments focus on competitive programming, with reward defined by passing hidden tests. The reported qualitative finding is that modular generation plus recombination can discover correct solutions on problems where monolithic high-pass@k sampling and standard RL struggle, and RL further improves the model’s ability to produce decompositions and module implementations that are useful under recombination. The provided full-content excerpt does not expose concrete parameter counts, dataset sizes, compute budgets, or numeric gains, so precise numbers should not be inferred. The important experimental axes to inspect are prompted decomposition versus trained DecompRL, training only implementations versus jointly training decomposition and implementation policies, the effect of module count n and per-module sample count k, and whether gains come from genuine module complementarity rather than merely increased total token budget.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most pretraining researchers. Read the Introduction to understand the failure mode of pass@k and standard RL under near-zero base success. Then read the Method section around hierarchical factorization and the k^n recombination argument. Sections 4.1–4.3 are the most relevant empirical parts, covering exploration, recombination utility, and sparse-reward discovery. The appendix prompts and full trajectory examples are worth checking because the method depends heavily on decomposition format and interface constraints. For pretraining-oriented use, focus on whether the discovered verified programs can become high-quality training data for code models.

recommendation.zh: FAIR团队的RL训练新思路，模块化组合带来的指数级解覆盖值得做RLVR的同学参考，跳过代码生成领域特有的工程细节即可。
recommendation.en: This FAIR RL approach enables exponential solution coverage via modular decomposition; useful for RLVR practitioners, skip code-gen specific engineering details.

paper.title: Diverse Evidence, Better Forecasts: Multi-Agent Deliberation Under Information Asymmetry
paper.abstract: Multi-agent systems are increasingly used for forecasting future events, as deliberation among multiple LLMs is believed to improve reasoning and calibration. Yet existing approaches overlook a critical design choice: what information each agent receives. When all agents are given identical evidence, deliberation collapses into herding rather than genuine belief revision, leaving multi-agent systems little better than a single agent. We identify this as a fundamental gap and propose designed inf

summary.core_problem: 现有多agent预测系统默认给所有agent分配完全相同的输入证据，导致审议过程退化为羊群效应，无法带来相对单agent的性能提升
summary.importance: 机制创新，识别了多agent审议中被忽略的信息分配设计维度，从理论上证明异构信息输入的必要性
summary.technical_approach: 提出信息不对称设计框架InfoDelphi，将证据拆分为共享公共子集和不相交私有子集分配给不同agent，结合相关性感知证据路由、基于原理的迭代审议、置信度加权聚合实现多agent预测
summary.experiments: 在PolyGym基准（375个二元预测问题）上，InfoDelphi的预测准确率、校准度显著优于同信息输入的多agent基线和单agent基线

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multi-agent forecasting systems feed identical evidence to all agents, turning deliberation into herding behavior with no gain over single-agent performance
summary_en.importance: Mechanism innovation that identifies the overlooked information allocation design dimension in multi-agent deliberation, with theoretical proof for the necessity of heterogeneous information inputs
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes InfoDelphi, a framework with designed information asymmetry: evidence is split into shared public subsets and disjoint private subsets per agent, combined with relevance-aware routing, rationale-based iterative deliberation, and confidence-weighted aggregation
summary_en.experiments: On PolyGym, a benchmark of 375 binary forecasting questions, InfoDelphi outperforms identical-evidence multi-agent baselines and single-agent baselines on both accuracy and calibration

recommendation.zh: 点破多agent审议喂同质化证据只会导致羊群效应的常见误区，信息异构才是增益来源，看§3理论分析和消融就够
recommendation.en: Exposes the common pitfall of homogeneous evidence feeding in multi-agent deliberation causing herding; read §3 theory and ablations for the core insight

paper.title: Message Passing Enables Efficient Reasoning
paper.abstract: While inference-time scaling has improved the reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs), the need to generate long chains-of-thought (CoTs) is a computational bottleneck. Thus, in contrast to sequential scaling methods like CoT, recent parallel scaling techniques instead use fork and join (FJ) primitives to divide work across multiple LLM threads. However, in the fork-join paradigm, threads are typically transient and do not communicate pointwise with one another which limits scalabili

summary.core_problem: 在推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）里，fork-join 这类并行 CoT 往往把线程当一次性“短工”，线程之间缺少细粒度通信，导致重复推理、同步开销高、可扩展性差。论文要解决的是：在不改动底层 LLM、尽量复用现有 batched inference/KV-cache 引擎的前提下，让多线程推理具备类似 MPI 的点对点消息传递能力，从而用更短的总生成量和更低的协调成本完成同等或更强的推理。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身的直接贡献不大（不涉及训练目标、数据或优化），但对“推理形态如何反哺预训练/中训”有现实启发：1）把多智能体/多线程推理抽象成可学习的控制语言（spawn/send/recv/stop），为后续用合成轨迹做 mid-train 或 tool-use/agent pretrain 提供了更规整的监督接口；2）把并行推理的瓶颈从“算力”转到“通信与状态组织”，提示后续若要训练原生支持并行协作的模型，可能需要在预训练阶段显式建模线程状态与消息；3）工程上给出一种在 vLLM/SGLang 这类 batched serving 上叠加“微型调度器”的实现路径，属于可落地的推理系统抽象。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Message Passing Language Models (MPLMs)：
- 把一次推理拆成多个并发“线程”（每个线程有独立 prompt/context 和 ID），并通过 batched inference 并行解码。
- 让模型在输出中生成带标签的控制指令字符串，由外部控制器解释执行，形成类似 MPI 的原语：
  1）spawn：创建若干新线程，并把给定 prompt 拼接进各自上下文；
  2）send：向指定线程集合发送一段文本消息；
  3）recv：阻塞等待来自指定线程集合的消息（同步点）；
  4）stop：终止线程。
- 推理引擎层面：不改 token sampling 与 KV-cache 管理，只在其上加一个轻量 controller，负责线程生命周期、消息队列、阻塞/唤醒、以及把“收到的消息”注入线程上下文。
- 与传统 fork-join 的关键差异：FJ 通常只在 join 时汇总，线程间缺少点对点、过程中的信息交换；MPLM 允许在推理过程中多次 send/recv，减少重复探索与无效分支，并把同步粒度从“阶段级”降到“消息级”。
- 取舍：通信载体是文本消息（进入上下文），实现简单、可复用现有 LLM；但也意味着消息会占用上下文窗口，并引入提示注入/格式鲁棒性问题。论文的抽象更偏“可执行提示语言 + 调度器”，而不是训练一个原生并行架构。
summary.experiments:
给出的全文片段主要覆盖框架与实现逻辑（preliminaries、指令设计、推理控制层），未包含完整实验表格与具体数值细节（例如在何种推理基准上、相对 CoT/FJ 的 token 降幅、wall-clock/吞吐提升、线程数扩展曲线、以及消融：无消息传递/不同同步策略/不同消息长度等）。如果全文后半部分包含这些结果，建议重点核对：
- 计算成本指标是否同时报告“总生成 token 数”“并行步数”“实际 wall-clock”；
- 是否在固定预算下比较准确率/成功率；
- 是否展示随着线程数增加的收益递减点，以及 recv 阻塞导致的尾部延迟（straggler）问题；
- 指令解析失败、格式漂移、以及消息注入导致的上下文膨胀对性能的影响。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
1）先看 3.1 Execution Control Directives：四个原语的语义边界（尤其是 recv 的阻塞语义）决定了它和普通多轮对话/工具调用的差别。
2）再看 3.2 Inference Logic：controller 如何在不改 vLLM/SGLang 的情况下实现“协同并行解码”，以及消息如何进入上下文、如何调度 batch。
3）如果后文有实验，优先找：与 fork-join 的对照、线程数扩展曲线、以及消融（去掉 send/recv 退化成 FJ）。
阅读时带着两个问题：A）这种“文本消息=共享状态”的方式在长上下文下是否会被上下文成本吞噬？B）如果要把它变成可训练能力，哪些轨迹（spawn/send/recv）最适合作为合成数据？

summary_en.core_problem: Inference-time scaling for reasoning often relies on parallel fork-join (FJ) patterns, but FJ threads are typically ephemeral and only merge at coarse join points. This limits scalability due to duplicated work and high coordination overhead. The paper targets a practical question: how to enable fine-grained, point-to-point communication among concurrent LLM “threads” while reusing existing batched inference engines and KV-cache implementations, so that parallel reasoning becomes more efficient than long sequential CoT.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper (no new objective/data/optimizer), but it matters as an interface between inference-time reasoning and future training recipes: (1) it turns multi-thread reasoning into an explicit, learnable control language (spawn/send/recv/stop), which is a clean substrate for trajectory synthesis and mid-training; (2) it reframes scaling limits around communication/state management rather than raw compute, hinting that pretraining for native parallel coordination may require explicit modeling of thread state and messages; (3) it provides an implementable systems abstraction on top of vLLM/SGLang-style batched serving, which is relevant if you care about how agentic traces are actually produced at scale.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Message Passing Language Models (MPLMs) are implemented as a runtime framework rather than a new model:
- A single user query spawns multiple concurrent LLM threads, each with its own prompt/context and textual ID, decoded in parallel via batched inference.
- The model emits tagged substrings that the runtime interprets as execution directives, analogous to MPI primitives:
  - <spawn[...]> ... </spawn>: create new threads with given IDs and seed prompts.
  - <send[...]> ... </send>: send a text message to specified threads.
  - <recv[...]>: block until messages arrive from specified threads.
  - <stop>: terminate a thread.
- A lightweight controller sits above the inference engine, handling scheduling, message queues, blocking/unblocking, and injecting received messages into the target thread contexts—without changing token sampling or KV-cache management.
- Key difference vs fork-join: communication is point-to-point and can happen repeatedly during execution, not only at a final join, aiming to reduce redundant exploration and lower synchronization granularity.
- Trade-off: messages are plain text (easy to integrate, model-agnostic) but consume context window and introduce robustness issues (format drift, prompt injection, context bloat).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
1) Read “Execution Control Directives” to understand the exact semantics—recv’s blocking behavior is the crux.
2) Read “Inference Logic” to see how the controller coordinates batched decoding without modifying the underlying engine.
3) If experiments exist, prioritize: MPLM vs fork-join baselines, scaling curves over thread count, and ablations removing send/recv.
Keep two questions in mind: (A) does text-as-state get dominated by context costs at scale? (B) if you wanted to train this behavior, which directive traces are the best supervision targets?

recommendation.zh: 值得看通信与早停消融；它把 test-time scaling 从“多采样”推进到“可训练的并行计算图”。
recommendation.en: Read the communication and preemption ablations; it shifts test-time scaling from more samples toward a trainable parallel computation graph.

paper.title: SWE-Router: Routing in Multi-turn Agentic Software Engineering Tasks
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) embedded in multi-turn agentic harnesses are reshaping software engineering (SWE), but routing every task to a frontier model is wasteful when many issues admit cheap fixes. Existing LLM routers operate on the task description alone, which inherits an information-theoretic Bayes-error floor in agentic settings: a similar issue can hide either a localized typo or a multi-module refactor, and the prompt does not separate the two. We introduce SWE-Router, a value-based

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM路由方法仅基于任务描述做模型选择，在多轮智能体软件工程（SWE）场景中存在贝叶斯误差下限：相同的问题描述可能对应简单拼写错误修复，也可能需要多模块重构，仅靠题目信息无法区分，导致不必要的算力浪费。
summary.importance: 提出时序路由的新思路，将模型选择决策从任务开始前延迟到弱模型探索之后，利用智能体自身生成的中间轨迹信息做路由，可为降低多轮智能体场景的推理成本提供实际参考。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是基于价值的时序路由框架SWE-Router。1. 先用低成本弱模型运行K轮探索，生成包含思考、动作、环境观测的部分轨迹；2. 训练一个附加在预训练LLM上的小分类头作为价值函数，以任务最终成功的二值奖励为监督，预测弱模型能否完成任务；3. 若预测值超过成本调整阈值则继续使用弱模型，否则升级到强模型（升级后强模型从原始问题重新开始，避免被弱模型的错误带偏）。论文还证明了贝叶斯最优性：基于部分轨迹的路由决策不会差于仅基于prompt的决策。
summary.experiments: 在SWEBench-Verified数据集上，相比仅基于prompt的强基线路由方法，在匹配解决率的前提下实现了显著的成本降低。所提供的部分内容未包含具体数值，详细数据需参考完整论文的实验章节。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点看第3章时序路由框架的设计逻辑和第4章的贝叶斯最优性证明，理解核心创新点；实验部分关注成本-性能帕累托曲线的对比结果。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM routers select models solely based on task descriptions, which suffers from a Bayes-error floor in multi-turn agentic software engineering (SWE) settings: identical issue descriptions can correspond to either trivial typo fixes or multi-module refactors, and prompt-only information cannot distinguish the two, leading to unnecessary compute waste.
summary_en.importance: It proposes a new temporal routing paradigm that defers model selection until after exploratory steps by a weak model, leveraging intermediate trajectory signals generated by the agent itself. This provides practical reference for reducing inference costs in multi-turn agentic scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core is SWE-Router, a value-based temporal routing framework. 1) A low-cost weak model first runs K exploratory turns to generate a partial trajectory containing thoughts, actions, and environment observations. 2) A value head (a small classification head attached to a pretrained LLM) is trained with binary task success rewards to predict whether the weak model can eventually solve the task. 3) If the predicted value exceeds a cost-adjusted threshold, the weak model continues; otherwise, the task is escalated to a stronger model (which restarts from the original problem to avoid being biased by the weak model's mistakes). A Bayes-optimality theorem proves that routing conditioned on partial trajectories is never worse than prompt-only routing.
summary_en.experiments: On SWEBench-Verified, SWE-Router achieves substantial cost reductions at matched resolution rates relative to strong prompt-only routing baselines. Detailed numerical results are not available in the provided partial content and should be referenced from the full paper's experiment section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommendation: Focus on Section 3 (design of the temporal routing framework) and Section 4 (Bayes-optimality proof) to grasp the core insight. For experiments, pay attention to the cost-performance Pareto curve comparisons. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读定理和成本-质量曲线；它把 router 从静态 prompt 拉到执行轨迹，适合复用到内部 agent 预算分配实验。
recommendation.en: Read the theorem and cost-quality curves; shifting routing from static prompts to execution traces is worth testing in internal agent budget allocation.

paper.title: Fork-Think with Confidence
paper.abstract: Parallel thinking has enjoyed great success for boosting LLM performance on reasoning tasks without the need for any re-training. However, existing methods follow a think-first-then-decide paradigm, i.e., they first sample multiple reasoning paths, which inevitably leads to overgeneration, then prune or stop unnecessary paths to compensate. In contrast, decide-first-then-think, i.e., first identifying points that are likely to lead to desirable generations, has been underexplored so far. Followi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是推理时并行采样的一个老问题：为了拿到更好的 reasoning trace，现有 parallel thinking 方法通常一开始就并行采很多条路径，再在中途或末尾做剪枝、投票或聚合。这样做的问题不是思路不对，而是算力花得太早、太粗。大量分支其实在前期就已经偏离有效解空间，后面再剪掉只是补救。作者提出的核心问题是：能不能先用一条 seed path 判断“哪里值得分叉”，再只在这些位置展开并行推理，从而减少无效生成，同时保留多样性带来的收益。
summary.importance: 对基座研究本身，它不是预训练方法论文，但对 post-train 之后的 inference-time scaling 有直接启发，尤其适合关注“推理能力到底来自模型本身，还是来自搜索/采样策略”的读者。它的重要性主要有两点。第一，它把 parallel reasoning 的默认范式从 think-first-then-decide 改成 decide-first-then-think，这个视角是清楚的，也有一定普适性。第二，它提示了一个更一般的问题：模型内部的置信度信号能否作为 test-time compute allocation 的依据。这个问题和动态解码、early exit、adaptive compute、甚至训练时的 curriculum/uncertainty 建模都有接口。贡献量级不算改写范式，但属于一个值得继续追的推理时策略点。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 Fork-Think with Confidence，核心流程分三步。第一步，先对问题生成一条 greedy seed path，而不是一开始就采样多条 reasoning trace。第二步，在这条 seed path 上识别适合“分叉”的 token 位置。作者借用了 pivot token 的想法：某些 token 对后续生成轨迹影响很大，如果在这些位置附近改变 continuation，后续 reasoning path 的差异会被放大。具体识别信号来自模型置信度，直觉上是当模型在某个位置不够确定时，这里更可能是后续推理走向分化的关键点。第三步，只在选中的 forking points 上采样多个 continuation，再对这些分支做聚合得到最终答案。

和已有方法相比，差异不在于更复杂的 verifier 或 scorer，而在于把“采样预算”从序列起点后移到更有信息的位置。传统 parallel sampling 在 prompt 之后立刻分叉，优点是简单，缺点是前缀阶段的随机性会制造很多表面不同、实质低效的路径。Fork-Think 先走一条确定性主干，再在局部高不确定位置展开，等于把多样性集中投放到更可能改变结论的步骤上。论文里还强调，这个框架和已有 pruning、aggregation 方法是兼容的，不是替代关系。也就是说，它更像一个前置的 compute allocation 策略。

从机制上看，这个方法成立依赖两个假设：一是 greedy seed path 至少能走到“有代表性”的中间状态；二是 token-level confidence 与后续 reasoning branching value 有相关性。作者的实验基本支持这两个假设，但也意味着它对 seed path 质量有依赖。如果模型一开始就走偏，后续再聪明地分叉也只是围绕错误主干展开。
summary.experiments:
论文在 3 个模型和 3 个 reasoning benchmark 上做了系统评测。摘要和正文给出的主结果是：相较于标准 parallel think，Fork-Think 在保持或提升任务表现的同时，整体 token cost 最多下降约 30%，整体运行时间最多下降约 57%。这个结果说明收益主要来自两部分：一是少生成了无效分支；二是分叉发生得更晚，前缀共享更多，因此真实解码开销下降。

作者还做了几类比较关键的消融。第一类是 forking position 的影响。结论很明确：较晚的分叉点通常比一开始就并行采样效果更好，说明 reasoning 的关键不在“尽早制造多样性”，而在“在合适的位置制造多样性”。第二类是不同 confidence-based 选点策略的比较，用来验证置信度是否真能找到有价值的 pivot。第三类是与不同 aggregation 方式的组合实验，说明 Fork-Think 不是依赖某一种特定投票器才成立。

从阅读价值看，最值得注意的不是单个 benchmark 上的绝对分数，而是 compute-performance 曲线的形状变化：在相近预算下，它能把更多算力放到高价值分支上，因此效率更高。如果正文里给了不同 fork 数、不同 seed decoding 策略、不同温度设置的结果，这些表通常比主表更能说明方法边界。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议控制在 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Figure 1，把 think-first-then-decide 和 decide-first-then-think 的差别吃透；这是整篇最重要的 conceptual move。然后看方法部分里 forking point 的定义与 confidence 计算方式，重点确认作者到底用的是 token probability、entropy、margin，还是某种归一化后的不确定性指标。接着看主实验表，关注 token cost、wall-clock time 和 accuracy 三者是否同时报告。最后看消融，尤其是“later fork is better”那组结果，它决定这篇工作的说服力。

如果只想判断是否值得进一步跟进，优先看三处：方法总览图、fork position 消融、与标准 parallel think 的效率对比。若要深挖，可以继续想两个问题：一，confidence 是否只是一个便宜 proxy，未来能否换成 value-of-branch 估计器；二，这种 decide-first-then-think 能否迁移到 tree search、speculative reasoning 或 verifier-guided decoding。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper revisits a basic inefficiency in parallel reasoning at inference time. Most existing methods follow a think-first-then-decide pattern: sample multiple reasoning traces up front, then prune, stop, or aggregate later. This works, but it spends compute too early and too broadly. Many branches are low-value from the start, so later pruning only recovers part of the waste. The paper asks a cleaner question: can we first identify where branching is likely to matter, and only then expand multiple continuations from those points?
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model research through the test-time compute lens. Its value is less about raw benchmark gains and more about reframing how inference-time scaling should allocate budget. Two aspects matter. First, it proposes a clear alternative to the default parallel sampling recipe: decide-first-then-think. Second, it suggests that model confidence can be used as a signal for adaptive compute allocation. That connects naturally to broader topics such as uncertainty-aware decoding, adaptive computation, verifier-guided search, and even training-time uncertainty modeling. The contribution is moderate in scale, but the framing is useful.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, Fork-Think with Confidence, has three stages. First, instead of sampling many traces immediately, it generates a single greedy seed path. Second, it scans this seed path to identify promising forking points. The intuition comes from pivot tokens: some token positions have disproportionate influence on downstream generation, so branching near them can produce meaningfully different reasoning trajectories. The paper uses model confidence to detect such positions. Low-confidence points are treated as likely decision bottlenecks where alternative continuations may be valuable. Third, the method samples multiple continuations only from those selected points and aggregates them into the final answer.

The main difference from prior work is not a stronger verifier or a more complex scorer. It is a different placement of sampling budget. Standard parallel thinking branches right after the prompt, which is simple but often wasteful: early randomness creates many superficially diverse but low-value traces. Fork-Think keeps the prefix deterministic, then injects diversity later at positions that are more likely to affect the final reasoning outcome. The paper also emphasizes compatibility with existing pruning and aggregation methods, so this should be read as a front-end compute allocation strategy rather than a full replacement for downstream selection.

Mechanistically, the method relies on two assumptions. First, the greedy seed path must reach a reasonably representative intermediate state. Second, token-level confidence must correlate with branching value. The experiments support both to some extent, but they also expose the main limitation: if the seed path is already badly off-track, later branching may only explore variations around a wrong backbone.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper evaluates on three models and three reasoning benchmarks. The headline result reported in the abstract and main text is that, compared with standard parallel thinking, Fork-Think reduces total token cost by up to about 30% and end-to-end runtime by up to about 57%, while maintaining or improving task performance. The runtime gain is plausible because branching happens later, so more prefix computation is shared and fewer low-value continuations are generated.

The ablations are the most informative part. One key study varies the forking position and shows that later branching points often outperform branching at the beginning. This is an important result: the benefit of parallel reasoning does not come from maximizing diversity as early as possible, but from placing diversity where the reasoning trajectory is genuinely unstable. Another set of ablations compares different confidence-based selection rules for identifying fork points. A third set studies compatibility with different aggregation schemes, supporting the claim that Fork-Think is not tied to one specific voting or reranking mechanism.

For a careful reader, the most useful signal is not the absolute benchmark score but the compute-performance tradeoff curve. The method appears to shift budget toward higher-value branches under the same or lower inference cost. If the full paper includes results over different numbers of forks, temperatures, or seed decoding choices, those tables are likely more revealing than the main leaderboard-style summary.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A 20-30 minute skim is enough to extract the main idea. Start with Figure 1, because the conceptual shift from think-first-then-decide to decide-first-then-think is the center of the paper. Then read the method section carefully enough to pin down how confidence is computed: token probability, entropy, margin, or some normalized uncertainty score. After that, inspect the main results table and check whether accuracy, token cost, and wall-clock time are all reported together. Finally, read the ablation on fork position. That section carries much of the paper's actual evidence.

If deciding whether to follow up, focus on three items: the method overview figure, the fork-position ablation, and the efficiency comparison against standard parallel thinking. If reading more deeply, two questions are worth keeping in mind: whether confidence is only a cheap proxy for branch value, and whether the same decide-first-then-think principle can be extended to tree search, speculative reasoning, or verifier-guided decoding.

recommendation.zh: 推理时计算定向分配的简洁有效方法，§3的分叉点识别策略可直接复现到内部推理pipeline，重点看方法和消融实验
recommendation.en: Simple and effective method for targeted test-time compute allocation; §3 forking point identification is directly reproducible for internal reasoning pipelines, focus on method and ablation

paper.title: When Does Learning to Stop Help? A Cost-Aware Study of Early Exits in Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Reasoning models spend different amounts of useful computation across instances, but it remains unclear when a learned stopping rule improves over simple confidence or convergence thresholds. We study this question with LearnStop, a hidden-state-free checkpoint stopper for reasoning language models. At fixed budget checkpoints, LearnStop probes a short answer from the current reasoning prefix and predicts prefix correctness from online features such as answer confidence, entropy, prefix vote sha

summary.core_problem: 研究推理模型中的 early exit 何时真正有用：学习型停止器是否比简单的置信度阈值或收敛阈值更划算。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率与 test-time compute 分配问题。对预训练研究员的价值在于，它提供了一个较干净的结论：停止策略的收益高度任务依赖，不能把 learned stopping 当成普适解。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 LearnStop，一个不读取隐藏状态的 checkpoint stopper。在固定预算检查点上，它从当前 reasoning prefix 生成短答案，并基于在线特征预测当前前缀是否已足够正确。特征包括答案置信度、熵、prefix vote share、答案稳定性和回溯标记密度等。然后在不同任务上比较 learned multi-feature stopping 与标量阈值式退出规则。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 18 个 task-model 组合，任务包括 GSM8K、MATH-500、MMLU-Pro、AIME-90、GPQA，模型涉及 Qwen3 和 DeepSeek-R1 distill 系列。结论是：在自由形式数学上，学习型停止器能改善固定预算前沿，例如 GSM8K + Qwen3-32B 上 post-hoc peak adapt gain 为 +0.157；但收益并不普适，任务间差异明显。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Maine at Presque Isle、Stanford University 和独立研究者。Stanford 参与提高了可见度，但从摘要看更像一篇小而干净的效率分析，而非大规模系统工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when early exit actually helps in reasoning models, and whether a learned stopping rule beats simple confidence or convergence thresholds under cost constraints.
summary_en.importance: This is a test-time efficiency and compute-allocation paper. Its main value for pretraining researchers is a fairly clean conclusion: learned stopping is not a universal win, and its benefit is strongly task-dependent.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose LearnStop, a hidden-state-free checkpoint stopper. At fixed budget checkpoints, it probes a short answer from the current reasoning prefix and predicts whether the prefix is already correct using online features such as answer confidence, entropy, prefix vote share, answer stability, and backtracking-marker density. They compare this learned multi-feature stopper against scalar threshold exits across tasks.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers 18 task-model settings, including GSM8K, MATH-500, MMLU-Pro, AIME-90, and GPQA, with Qwen3 and DeepSeek-R1 distill models. The main finding is that learned stopping helps on free-form math, improving the fixed-budget frontier; for example, on GSM8K with Qwen3-32B, the post-hoc peak adaptive gain reaches +0.157. But the gains are not universal and vary substantially by task.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Maine at Presque Isle, Stanford University, and an independent affiliation. Stanford adds visibility, but from the abstract this looks like a focused, clean efficiency study rather than a large-scale systems paper.

recommendation.zh: 结论比方法更值钱：early exit 不是通用省算力按钮。只看任务分层结果和哪些特征真有增益，别在复杂 stopper 上过度投入。
recommendation.en: The conclusion matters more than the method: early exit is not a universal compute-saving knob. Read the task breakdown and which features actually help before over-investing in fancy stoppers.

institutions: University of Maine at Presque Isle

paper.title: Before Thinking, Learn to Decide: Proactive Routing for Efficient Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large multimodal models have achieved strong reasoning on complex visual tasks, but their inference efficiency is often restricted by long chains of thought. A promising solution is to pair a small draft model with a large target model, enabling cooperative inference employing a routing signal that adaptively routes queries to either the draft or target model based on their difficulties for optimal efficiency and accuracy. Yet, the remaining bottleneck is to establish a reliable query difficulty

summary.core_problem: 在多模态视觉推理中，如何在不依赖“生成完长 CoT 后再看 token 概率”的滞后信号、也不依赖对采样分布敏感的 SFT 特殊 token 方案的前提下，提前判断样本难度并进行 draft/target 模型路由，从而降低推理成本。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏推理效率与路由策略，不是预训练主线。对预训练研究的间接启发在于：它把“难度/可解性”建模成可学习的评分头，并用 RL（GRPO）训练在生成前给出可用信号；这种“前置评分信号”如果迁移到 pretrain/posttrain 接口上，可能用于数据课程、动态采样或训练时的 compute routing（例如 MoE/early-exit 的数据侧信号）。但论文的核心贡献仍在推理阶段系统设计。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 Proactive Routing Paradigm (PRP)：在生成开始前就做路由。
- DRL (Draft Rating Learning)：让 draft 模型在不生成推理链的情况下，直接对输入给出“我能否解”的细粒度评分分布。
- JRL (Joint Rating Learning)：进一步同时预测 target 模型对该样本的适配度/收益，使路由不仅把难题交给大模型，也能把“大模型特别擅长”的样本交给它。
- 训练方法：使用 GRPO 风格的强化学习来学评分（全文应给出 reward 设计与采样细节）。
- 推理策略：基于评分的三阶段路由与排序策略；DRL 侧重置信分布，JRL 侧重 draft/target 的相对能力评估。
summary.experiments:
文中明确给出的数字：在 MathVista 上，JRL 路由达到 2.41× 加速，并且“略微超过更强的 target model”。此外作者在 MathVerse 等数据上展示 token-probability routing 与准确率相关性不成立（Fig.2 a/b），以及特殊 token 路由对正负轨迹采样分布敏感。
由于你提供的全文片段未包含完整实验表，draft/target 的具体模型规格、不同阈值下的 cost-accuracy 曲线、以及在更多基准上的稳定性需要到实验章节核对。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读即可，优先抓三块：
- Sec.2 的失败分析（为什么 token 概率与准确率在多模态长推理下脱钩；为什么特殊 token 路由对数据分布敏感）。
- DRL/JRL 的 reward 与训练细节（评分信号如何定义、如何避免学成“长度/格式”代理）。
- MathVista 的 cost-accuracy 曲线与路由阈值敏感性。预计 30–45 分钟能把方法与主要结论读清楚。

summary_en.core_problem: How to obtain a reliable, early difficulty/solvability signal for multimodal visual reasoning so that queries can be proactively routed between a small draft model and a large target model before generating long chains-of-thought, avoiding both post-hoc token-probability heuristics and SFT-based special-token routing that is sensitive to trajectory sampling.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-efficiency/routing paper rather than pretraining. The pretraining-relevant takeaway is the framing of “instance difficulty / model suitability” as a learnable rating signal trained with RL, produced before generation. Similar signals could potentially inform curriculum sampling, compute-aware training, or data-conditioned routing (e.g., MoE/early-exit) at training time, but that is not the paper’s main focus.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They propose Proactive Routing Paradigm (PRP), making routing decisions at the start of generation.
- Draft Rating Learning (DRL): trains the draft model to output a fine-grained solvability/confidence distribution for an input without generating reasoning steps.
- Joint Rating Learning (JRL): additionally predicts the target model’s suitability/expected benefit, enabling routing based on both models’ strengths rather than only the draft’s uncertainty.
- Training uses a GRPO-style RL procedure (details depend on the full paper: reward definition, sampling, and stabilization).
- Inference uses score-based, multi-stage routing/selection strategies: DRL leverages confidence distributions; JRL leverages joint draft/target capability estimates.
summary_en.experiments:
A concrete number stated: on MathVista, JRL achieves 2.41× speedup while slightly outperforming the stronger target model. They also provide diagnostic evidence (e.g., on MathVerse) that mean token probability is not monotonically correlated with accuracy in multimodal long reasoning, and that special-token routing is sensitive to the distribution of correct/incorrect trajectories.
The excerpt does not include full result tables; you should verify model sizes, routing thresholds, and cost–accuracy trade-off curves in the experiments section.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim with focus:
- The failure analysis section explaining why token-probability routing breaks in multimodal long reasoning and why special-token routing is data-sensitive.
- The DRL/JRL training objective and reward design (to ensure the rating is not a proxy for length/format).
- The MathVista cost–accuracy curves and threshold sensitivity. About 30–45 minutes for a solid pass.

recommendation.zh: 看 cost-accuracy frontier 和失败路由分析；若 solvability 估计干净，可借鉴到推理计算分配。
recommendation.en: Read the cost-accuracy frontier and routing failures; if solvability is estimated cleanly, it informs test-time compute allocation.

paper.title: Finding the Time to Think: Learning Planning Budgets in Real-Time RL
paper.abstract: Deliberating takes time. In real-time settings, that time is not free. Standard reinforcement learning (RL) sidesteps this as the environment waits indefinitely for the agent's decision. Instead, we study real-time RL environments where the environment progresses while waiting for the agent's action. Building on prior real-time formalizations, we introduce variable-delay real-time RL, where the agent chooses how long to deliberate at each decision point since the environment progresses. For the

summary.core_problem: 标准RL默认环境会无限等待agent决策，未考虑实时场景下环境随时间持续推进、思考本身有时间成本的约束，也无法自适应选择状态依赖的最优规划时长。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出可变延迟实时RL框架，通过学习状态依赖的规划预算解决思考成本与决策质量的权衡问题，对test-time计算分配有弱参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 在现有规划器上层训练一个独立的轻量门控策略，输入当前状态直接选择该步的规划时长预算，避免让规划器自行决定规划时长带来的元规划递归开销与决策瘫痪问题。
summary.experiments: 在实时Pac-Man、Tetris、Snake、Speed Hex、Speed Go五个游戏环境中，该门控策略效果优于固定预算、启发式预算baseline，且可迁移到agent与环境分置不同GPU的真实部署场景。
summary.authors_note: 作者团队包含牛津大学教授Jakob Foerster，为多智能体RL领域知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard RL assumes environments wait indefinitely for agent actions, ignoring real-time settings where environments evolve during deliberation and thinking incurs time cost, with no mechanism to select state-adaptive optimal planning budgets.
summary_en.importance: A methods contribution proposing a variable-delay real-time RL framework that learns state-dependent planning budgets to trade off thinking cost and decision quality, providing weak reference value for test-time compute allocation research.
summary_en.technical_approach: A lightweight independent gating policy is trained on top of an existing planner, taking the current state as input to directly select the planning budget for that step, avoiding the meta-reasoning overhead and decision paralysis caused by letting the planner decide its own planning time.
summary_en.experiments: Across five real-time game environments (Pac-Man, Tetris, Snake, Speed Hex, Speed Go), the gating policy outperforms fixed-budget and heuristic baselines, and transfers to deployment setups where the environment and agent run on separate GPUs.
summary_en.authors_note: The team includes University of Oxford professor Jakob Foerster, a leading researcher in multi-agent reinforcement learning.

recommendation.zh: 玩具RL环境下的自适应思考预算研究，与LLM test-time scaling场景差异较大，仅作为计算分配思路备查。
recommendation.en: Adaptive thinking budget research on toy RL environments differs substantially from LLM test-time scaling setups; keep only as a conceptual reference for compute allocation.

paper.title: Agentic System as Compressor: Quantifying System Intelligence in Bits
paper.abstract: Large language models are turning from isolated predictors into agentic systems: they call tools, retrieve evidence, obey environment constraints, use verifiers, and complete tasks through search and multi-turn interaction. We adopts an analytical viewpoint based on "compression is intelligence": under a fixed task distribution, interface, and compute budget, a stronger agentic system lets a target object be reconstructed with fewer bits. We operationalize the measure with arithmetic coding, see

summary.core_problem: 如何用统一的信息论度量来评估“带工具、检索、验证器和环境交互的 agent 系统”整体智能，而不是只测孤立模型的准确率或裸模型的压缩率。
summary.importance: 这篇工作把“compression is intelligence”从单模型 log-loss 扩展到了 agent system 层面，提出了一种可操作的 codelength 指标，用于分解模型、工具、检索、验证器、搜索预算等组件到底贡献了多少“有效不确定性压缩”。对预训练研究的直接启发不在于训练方法，而在于评测思想：当系统能力越来越来自模型外机制时，只看最终成功率会丢失大量信号；用比特数衡量残差不确定性，可以在成功率接近零或组件耦合严重时仍给出细粒度对比。这对研究推理系统、检索增强、verifier 辅助生成、甚至 RL/搜索增强训练的收益归因都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者将 agent 系统形式化为三元组：控制程序 P、模型接口 M、环境/工具接口 E，并在给定资源预算 C 下运行。在此基础上定义系统级压缩任务：编码端和解码端共享同一个系统，编码端只发送足够短的 per-instance 描述，使解码端能在相同接口和预算下重建目标对象。系统越强，需要的残差比特数越少。为让这个定义可执行，作者组合了三种编码机制：arithmetic coding 把模型的条件分布直接转成 NLL/codelength；seed coding 用于确定性或可重放环境，只传随机种子序号，让系统通过采样找到满足约束的输出；当 seed coding 在有限预算内失败时回退到 arithmetic coding，保证所有样本都能编码。进一步，作者定义 marginal bit value，用加入某个组件前后平均码长的减少量来量化组件贡献，从而把工具、检索、verifier、采样预算都纳入统一账本。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖五个受控场景，目的不是刷任务分数，而是验证这套度量能否分辨不同信息源的贡献。Reversed text 检验共享变换是否能被编码进系统而减少每实例码长；chess 用来测量规则环境对合法动作空间的压缩；protein 实验显示当成功率几乎没有区分度时，codelength 仍能分辨模板先验和 verifier feedback 的收益；RAG 用来测外部证据相关性和观测标准如何改变残差比特数；semantic story compression 则测试语义目标和计算预算对码长的影响。论文给出的核心现象是：在这些设置里，agent 组件都能稳定降低 codelength，而且该指标能在 success rate 失去分辨率时继续提供梯度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读理论部分，尤其是 agent 系统定义、观测等价性、arithmetic/seed/fallback 三种编码的分工，以及 marginal bit value 的定义。这是论文最有价值的部分。实验部分不必逐段细读，重点看每个任务想隔离哪类信息源。对预训练研究者来说，值得思考的是：这个框架能否迁移到训练信号分析上，例如衡量 verifier、RL rollout、检索增强究竟为模型压缩目标分布提供了多少额外比特，而不是只看下游分数变化。预计阅读时间 25–35 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate the intelligence of an entire agentic system—including tools, retrieval, verifiers, and environment interaction—with a unified information-theoretic measure, rather than relying only on isolated-model accuracy or bare-model compression rate.
summary_en.importance: The paper extends the 'compression is intelligence' view from single-model log-loss to full agent systems and proposes an operational codelength metric for attributing how much residual uncertainty reduction comes from the model versus tools, retrievers, verifiers, and search/compute budgets. Its main relevance to pretraining is evaluative rather than algorithmic: as system capability increasingly comes from mechanisms outside the base model, end-task success rates become too coarse and can stay near zero even when large differences exist in residual uncertainty reduction. Bit-level accounting provides a finer signal for reasoning systems, retrieval augmentation, verifier-guided generation, and the analysis of RL- or search-based training gains.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors model an agentic system as a triple of control program P, model interface M, and environment/tool interface E, evaluated under a resource budget C. They define system-level compression: given a shared system on both encoder and decoder sides, the encoder transmits only a short per-instance code that allows the decoder, under identical interfaces and budget, to reconstruct the target object. A stronger system requires fewer residual bits. To make this operational, three coding schemes are combined: arithmetic coding converts conditional model distributions into NLL/codelength; seed coding applies to deterministic or replayable environments by transmitting only a random-seed rank until a valid sample is found; and arithmetic coding is used as a fallback when seed coding fails within budget, ensuring lossless encodability for every sample. A marginal bit value metric is then defined as the average codelength reduction attributable to adding a specific component, enabling unified accounting of tools, retrieval, verifiers, and sampling budget.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are designed as controlled probes rather than benchmark sweeps. Reversed text checks whether shared transforms can be absorbed into the system to reduce per-instance codelength. Chess measures how rule-based environments shrink the legal action space. Protein experiments show that codelength can still differentiate gains from template priors and verifier feedback when success rate has almost no resolution. RAG tests how external evidence relevance and observation standards change residual bits. Semantic story compression studies the effect of semantic observers and compute budget. Across these settings, agentic components consistently reduce codelength, and the metric continues to provide measurable gradients even where success rates saturate near zero or one.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the theory sections carefully, especially the agent-system formalism, observational equivalence, the division of labor among arithmetic coding, seed coding, and fallback coding, and the definition of marginal bit value. These are the most useful parts. The experiments do not need a close read in full; focus on which information source each task is intended to isolate. For pretraining researchers, the key question is whether this accounting framework can be transferred to training-signal analysis—for example, quantifying how many bits verifiers, RL rollouts, or retrieval add for compressing the target distribution, instead of only reporting downstream score changes. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 把压缩即智能从单模型推广到多组件agent，视角统一有启发性，但实验都是小规模受控玩具，只看§3的度量定义和§5的框架讨论即可。
recommendation.en: Extends compression-as-intelligence from standalone models to multi-component agents with a unifying framing, but experiments are small-scale and synthetic; read §3 for metric definition and §5 for framework discussion only.

paper.title: Bayesian control for coding agents
paper.abstract: Modern coding agents pair LLM generators with various tools, including cheap diagnostics and expensive verifiers. The tool-use decisions are typically governed by orchestrators that often use fixed rules and ignore uncertainty. We formulate orchestration as cost-sensitive sequential hypothesis testing: a Bayesian controller maintains a belief over candidate correctness and dynamically decides whether to gather more evidence, refine the candidate, verify it, or stop. Across six generators and nin

summary.core_problem: 现有Coding Agent的工具调用编排多采用固定规则，未考虑验证成本与工具输出的不确定性，导致效率低或错误率高
summary.importance: 提出基于贝叶斯控制的Coding Agent编排框架，同时提供可解释的代码正确性置信度分数
summary.technical_approach: 将工具调用决策建模为成本敏感序贯假设检验，维护候选代码正确性的后验信念分布，根据期望成本动态选择下一步动作（生成/运行诊断/形式化验证/停止）
summary.experiments: 在6个生成器、9个代码基准上测试，在验证成本高、批评器不完美的场景下优势最明显，其信念分数对正确性的预测优于token概率、工具成功基线
summary.authors_note: 团队包含MBZUAI知名NLP学者Preslav Nakov、Timothy Baldwin，深耕NLP可靠性与Agent系统方向

summary_en.core_problem: Existing coding agents use fixed rules for tool orchestration, ignoring verification cost and uncertainty, leading to low efficiency or high error rates
summary_en.importance: Proposes a Bayesian control framework for coding agent orchestration, alongside an interpretable code correctness score
summary_en.technical_approach: Formulates orchestration as cost-sensitive sequential hypothesis testing, maintains a posterior belief over candidate correctness, and dynamically selects actions (generate/run diagnostics/verify/stop) based on expected cost
summary_en.experiments: Tests across 6 generators and 9 coding benchmarks, shows largest gains when verification is costly and critics are imperfect; its belief-based correctness score outperforms token-probability and tool-success baselines for uncertainty quantification
summary_en.authors_note: The team includes well-known NLP researchers Preslav Nakov and Timothy Baldwin from MBZUAI, with long-term work on NLP reliability and agent systems

recommendation.zh: 贝叶斯调度思路对test-time计算分配有少量参考，但属于Coding Agent工程改进，和预训练无直接关联，扫方法部分即可
recommendation.en: The Bayesian scheduling idea offers minor insight for test-time compute allocation, but it is a coding agent engineering improvement with no direct relevance to pretraining, skim the method section only

paper.title: Maestro Order: A Model-Agnostic Orchestration Harness
paper.abstract: A single forward pass of a capable model is a fast, fluent, and unreliable problem-solver: it is right often enough to be useful and wrong often enough to be dangerous; in language models, such confident errors are known as hallucinations. We present Maestro Order, a model-agnostic orchestration harness that turns unreliable solvers into reliable problem-solving systems by composing them according to four structural primitives (decompose, ensemble, verify, and recurse) and a budget-aware control

summary.core_problem: 将单次前向传播不可靠的基础模型（存在幻觉）组合为可靠、可预算控制的问题求解系统。
summary.importance: 提出通用模型无关的推理编排框架，属于 test-time compute 分配与可靠性工程方向的系统创新。
summary.technical_approach: 定义 decompose/ensemble/verify/recurse 四个结构原语，加预算感知控制器按单位成本边际可靠性分配算力；将任意模型视为黑盒求解器，叠加在线测量判别力的验证器集成。
summary.experiments: 给出架构与控制器算法、消息/状态 schema、确定性与容错工程设计，以及评测方法论，具体实验结果在摘要中截断。

summary_en.core_problem: Compose unreliable single-pass base models (prone to hallucinations) into reliable, budget-controllable problem-solving systems.
summary_en.importance: A system innovation proposing a generic model-agnostic reasoning orchestration framework in the direction of test-time compute allocation and reliability engineering.
summary_en.technical_approach: Define four structural primitives (decompose, ensemble, verify, recurse) plus a budget-aware controller that allocates compute by marginal reliability per unit cost; treat any model as a black-box solver and layer a verifier ensemble with online discrimination measurement.
summary_en.experiments: Presents architecture, controller algorithm, message/state schemas, determinism and fault-tolerance engineering, and evaluation methodology; concrete benchmark results are truncated in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: test-time 计算分配与验证编排框架，和 pretrain 非直接相关，可看方法架构节作为推理时 scaling 的弱信号参考。
recommendation.en: An orchestration framework for test-time compute allocation and verification, indirectly related to pretraining; skim the architecture section as weak signal for inference-time scaling.

paper.title: DART: Draft-Agreement Routing for Training-Free Adaptive Thinking Budgets in Hybrid Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Hybrid reasoning models can answer directly or spend extra tokens on extended thinking. A practical router should choose between these modes for each query, so easy problems avoid unnecessary reasoning and hard problems receive enough budget to finish the answer. Existing routers move in this direction, but they typically require labeled training data or fix thinking budgets up front, ignoring answer-level evidence from the model itself. We introduce DART, a training-free routing framework that

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 hybrid reasoning model 的推理预算分配问题：简单问题不应总是进入长思考模式，困难问题又需要足够预算完成推理和最终答案。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更偏推理与服务策略，不是预训练方法。它对基座研究的启发在于模型自身生成的短答案一致性可以作为难度和置信度信号。相比训练一个 router，DART 使用 NoThink draft 的一致性做决策，降低了对标注难度数据、模型特定微调和闭源接口权限的依赖。它也提醒评测 reasoning model 时要区分思考 trace 和最终答案的截断问题，否则 always-thinking baseline 可能被生成上限低估。
summary.technical_approach: DART 是一个无训练的两阶段路由框架。第一阶段 SC-Route 对同一问题采样 K 个 NoThink draft，论文主设定使用 K=2。系统先抽取每个 draft 的答案，再用任务相关的 equivalence function 判断是否等价。如果两个 draft 的答案一致，就直接接受 NoThink 答案；如果不一致，则认为该问题需要 Think 模式。第二阶段只作用于 disagreement cases：当模型提供 token log-probability 和可控 thinking budget 时，DART 用 draft entropy 预测查询级预算，把更多 token 分给不确定性更高的问题。这个设计的取舍很明确：Stage 1 只依赖文本输出，适合 API-only 模型；Stage 2 能进一步省 token，但需要更强的接口能力。
summary.experiments: 论文在 Qwen3 8B 到 32B 以及 DeepSeek-V3.2 上评估。作者报告，在主要比较中，DART 的准确率通常可以持平或超过 always-thinking，同时减少 thinking token。数学任务上，DART 在部分设置中相对 always-thinking 最高提升 9.0 个百分点，并减少 15% 到 69% 的 thinking token。代码任务中，在 execution-based equivalence 下，最高提升 22.5 个百分点，并减少 51% 到 63% 的 thinking token。监督 router 诊断实验显示，draft unanimity 比 entropy 或 draft length 更能预测 always-thinking 是否会答对。论文还指出，单次调用中把 reasoning trace 和 final answer 放在同一个生成上限下，会让 always-thinking 因答案未完整输出而被低估，附录 C 专门量化了这一评测伪差。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。优先看方法部分的 Algorithm 1、SC-Route 的 K=2 unanimity 设计、answer extraction 与 equivalence function 的定义。实验部分重点看 token saving 与 accuracy 的 trade-off 表，以及数学和代码任务中 DART 相对 always-thinking 的结果。附录 C 值得快速看，因为它涉及 reasoning model 评测协议：如果思考和答案共享同一个 generation cap，结论可能混入截断效应。若关心 serving，可进一步看 Stage 2 的 entropy-to-budget 映射；若只关心 API 可用方案，Stage 1 已经是主要贡献。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies adaptive inference for hybrid reasoning models: the system should answer easy queries directly, while allocating enough thinking budget to queries that genuinely need extended reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-time routing paper, not a pretraining contribution. Its relevance to foundation-model research is the use of the model’s own short no-think drafts as a difficulty signal. DART avoids labeled difficulty data and model-specific router training, and it works with text-only APIs for its first stage. The paper also makes a useful evaluation point: always-thinking baselines can be underestimated when the reasoning trace and final answer share a tight generation cap.
summary_en.technical_approach: DART has two stages. Stage 1, SC-Route, samples K no-think drafts for the same query, with K=2 as the main setting. It extracts the answer from each draft and checks agreement using a task-specific equivalence function. If the drafts unanimously agree, DART accepts the direct answer. If they disagree, the query is routed to Think mode. Stage 2 applies only to routed queries. When log probabilities and budget controls are available, DART maps draft entropy to a query-specific thinking budget, giving more tokens to higher-uncertainty cases. The design separates a broadly usable text-only routing signal from an optional budget-allocation module that requires richer model access.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates DART on Qwen3 models from 8B to 32B and on DeepSeek-V3.2. In the main reported comparisons, DART often matches or exceeds always-thinking accuracy while using fewer thinking tokens. On math tasks, the best reported point estimate is a 9.0-point accuracy gain with 15% to 69% fewer thinking tokens. On code tasks, using execution-based answer equivalence, the reported gain reaches 22.5 points with 51% to 63% fewer thinking tokens. A supervised-router diagnostic finds that draft unanimity is more predictive than entropy or draft length. The paper also analyzes a truncation artifact in single-call evaluations, where extended reasoning can consume the generation cap before the final answer is emitted.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Read Algorithm 1 and the SC-Route section first, especially the strict unanimity rule, answer extraction, and equivalence checking. Then inspect the main accuracy-versus-token tables for math and code. Appendix C is useful for anyone evaluating reasoning models, because it explains how a shared generation cap can distort always-thinking baselines. For deployment use, focus on the entropy-to-budget mapping in Stage 2. For API-only use, Stage 1 is the central mechanism.

recommendation.zh: 这是干净的 test-time budget heuristic；先看 draft agreement 失败样例，若鲁棒可直接进内部 serving ablation。
recommendation.en: This is a clean test-time budget heuristic; read the draft-disagreement failure cases first, and if robust, it belongs in an internal serving ablation.

paper.title: SPIRAL: Learning to Search and Aggregate
paper.abstract: Language model reasoning can be substantially improved at test time via scaffolds that scale inference compute across different primitives -- sequential reasoning within a trace, independently sampled parallel traces, and aggregation of multiple reasoning traces into a final response. During post-training, however, language models are optimized only for sequential reasoning within a single trace. We introduce Sequential-Parallel-Aggregative Reinforcement Learning (SPIRAL), a framework in which a

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是推理模型训练和测试时 compute 使用方式不一致的问题。现有 RL 主要训练模型生成一条高质量 reasoning trace，但实际部署时常用并行采样、多候选搜索、候选聚合、验证和修订。模型在训练中没有见过这些 compute primitive，因此不会主动分配顺序计算、并行探索和聚合计算。
summary.importance: 这篇论文和预训练的关系不在数据或模型结构，而在 pretrain-posttrain 接口。它把 test-time scaling 中常见的并行采样和聚合纳入 RL 训练目标，试图让模型学会使用推理预算，而不是靠外部 scaffold 手写调度。对基座研究的启发在于：模型能力不只由单条轨迹的 token-level reasoning 决定，还受训练时暴露的 compute topology 影响。若结果成立，后续 reasoning pretrain、RL pretrain 或长思维训练需要考虑把多样化搜索、候选互补性和聚合能力作为训练对象，而不是只奖励单个 final answer。
summary.technical_approach: SPIRAL 即 Sequential-Parallel-Aggregative Reinforcement Learning。它同时训练三类推理计算：单条 trace 内的顺序计算，例如 reasoning tokens 和工具调用；同一 prompt 下多条独立 trace 的并行计算；以及把多条候选 trace 合成为最终答案的聚合计算。聚合 trace 可用标准 RL 算法训练，例如 GRPO，因为它仍然是生成一个最终输出并接受 reward。并行 trace 的训练更难，因为单条 trace 可能本身不正确，却包含对聚合有用的局部思路。论文用 set reinforcement learning 处理这种 credit assignment：把同一 prompt 下采样得到的一组 generations 当成集合，用集合级 reward 对它们联合赋分，并通过低方差 marginal advantage 给每条 trace 分配学习信号。这个设计区别于常规 GRPO：GRPO 优化单条响应的相对优势，SPIRAL 优化一组候选和一个聚合器共同产生最终正确答案的能力。
summary.experiments: 论文在数学推理上微调 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507，并与标准 GRPO 在相同训练 compute 预算下比较。测试时扩展不同维度的 inference compute。给出的结果包括：在 parallel compute scaling 下，pass@k 的 scaling efficiency 最高提升到 11 倍；在同时扩展 parallel 和 aggregative compute 时，测试集性能最高高出 15%。这些数字说明改进主要来自更有效地使用多样本和聚合，而不只是单条 chain-of-thought 变强。实验最需要关注的是等训练预算是否严格、parallel sample 数和 aggregator 调用数如何计费、以及提升是否集中在需要搜索的题目而非普通算术题。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 到 45 分钟。先看 introduction 中对 sequential、parallel、aggregative compute 三类瓶颈的定义。然后看 set RL preliminaries 和 SPIRAL objective，重点理解集合级 reward 为什么不能退化成单样本 reward，以及 marginal advantage 如何给并行 trace 做 credit assignment。实验部分优先看训练 compute 对齐、test-time compute scaling 曲线、pass@k scaling efficiency 的定义，以及 GRPO 对照。若时间有限，可以跳过一般 RL 背景，集中读算法目标和 ablation。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a mismatch between how reasoning models are trained and how they are used at inference time. Standard RL trains a model to produce one strong reasoning trace. In deployment, however, practitioners often use parallel sampling, search over multiple candidates, aggregation, verification, and revision. The model is not trained to coordinate these compute primitives, so additional inference compute is often wasted on redundant traces or weak aggregation.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to the pretrain-posttrain interface rather than to tokenizer, data mixture, or architecture. It treats test-time scaling behavior as a trainable object. The key implication is that reasoning ability depends not only on the quality of a single chain of thought, but also on whether the model has learned the topology of inference compute: sequential thinking, parallel exploration, and cross-trace aggregation. This is a useful direction for RL pretraining and reasoning-oriented mid-training, especially if future training recipes aim to optimize models for the way they will actually be served.
summary_en.technical_approach: SPIRAL stands for Sequential-Parallel-Aggregative Reinforcement Learning. It exposes the model to three forms of inference compute during training: sequential compute inside one trace, parallel compute across independently sampled traces, and aggregative compute that synthesizes a set of traces into a final output. Aggregation traces can be optimized with standard RL algorithms such as GRPO because they generate a final answer that receives a reward. Parallel traces require a different credit assignment scheme: an individual trace may be wrong, but still contain an idea that helps the aggregator solve the problem. SPIRAL uses set reinforcement learning, where a set of generations from the same prompt receives a joint learning signal. A low-variance marginal advantage is then used to assign credit to individual traces under the set-level objective. This differs from standard GRPO, which optimizes the relative advantage of individual responses rather than the utility of a candidate set plus an aggregator.
summary_en.experiments: The paper fine-tunes Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 on mathematical reasoning and compares SPIRAL against GRPO under an equal training compute budget. At test time, it scales different axes of inference compute. The reported results include up to 11x higher scaling efficiency for pass@k under parallel compute scaling, and up to 15% higher performance when both parallel and aggregative compute are scaled. The main empirical claim is that SPIRAL improves the model’s ability to use multiple samples and aggregation, rather than only improving single-trace reasoning. The most important details to inspect are the compute accounting, the number of sampled traces, the aggregation budget, and whether gains are concentrated on problems that genuinely require search.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30 to 45 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the definitions of sequential, parallel, and aggregative compute in the introduction. Then read the set RL preliminaries and the SPIRAL objective carefully, especially why the set-level reward cannot be reduced to a single-sample reward and how marginal advantage handles credit assignment. In the experiments, focus on the test-time compute scaling curves, the definition of pass@k scaling efficiency, compute-matched GRPO comparisons, and ablations over aggregation and parallel sampling.

recommendation.zh: 训练-测试推理范式对齐的新思路，集合RL的目标设计值得在内部后训练ablation中参考，重点看§3的损失定义。
recommendation.en: Novel alignment between training and test-time reasoning paradigms; the set RL objective design in §3 is worth referencing in internal post-training ablations.

paper.title: Specialize Roles, Mix Deployments: Pushing the Cost-Accuracy Frontier of LLM Agent Teams
paper.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly deployed as multi-role teams, where tasks are divided across specialized roles such as planner, executor, and verifier. In these systems, cost and accuracy are no longer properties of a single model: they depend on which model fills each role and where it is hosted, including API, self-hosted, and hybrid deployment. Existing agentic benchmarks typically evaluate fixed models or fixed agent configurations, and therefore offer limited guidance for cost-accuracy-optimal

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是多角色 LLM agent team 的评测与部署选择问题：在 planner、executor、verifier 等角色被不同模型承担时，准确率和成本不再属于单个模型，而属于角色分配、部署方式和任务域的组合。现有固定模型或固定 agent 配置的 benchmark 很难回答哪个模型该放在哪个角色、用 API 还是自托管。
summary.importance: 这篇是 agent 评测与部署 benchmark，和预训练关系较远，但对 post-train 后的模型能力分析有参考价值。它把 agent 系统的成本-准确率问题拆成角色级贡献，有助于判断模型能力瓶颈来自规划、执行还是验证。对基座研究的间接价值在于：同一个模型在不同 agent role 中的边际收益不同，这比单一任务分数更接近实际使用中的能力画像。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 AgentCARD，围绕 Cost、Accuracy、Role assignment、Deployment mode 做 role-aware evaluation。它不是新增一个静态任务集，而是把已有 agentic benchmarks 改造成角色分解评测。系统包含四部分：planner-executor 或 planner-verifier-executor 的评测 harness；统一 API、自托管、混合部署的 per-task cost model；基于 Pareto frontier 的成本-准确率分析；基于 Shapley value 的 role-criticality diagnostic，用来估计哪个角色是瓶颈，从而减少模型组合搜索。这个设计的关键区别在于，它评估的是 team configuration，而不是单模型能力。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖五类已有任务域：开放域工具使用、金融、医学推理、代码和数学。论文评估四个 API 模型之间的 16 种 planner-executor 分配，并加入自托管与混合部署配置。主要结果包括：异构 team 在合适角色分配下准确率最高可提升 44%；同一对模型反向分配可能降低 36%；Pareto frontier 经常由异构 team 占据；合适的异构配置可以用 1.4x 到 12x 更低的 per-task cost 匹配最强同构 team；planner 与 executor 的能力回报在不同领域最多相差 40%；三角色 plan-verify-execute pilot 在相近成本下比最强两角色 baseline 高 9.4%。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 15–25 分钟。重点看 benchmark 设计、cost model、Pareto frontier 分析和 Shapley role-criticality diagnostic。实验表格里应优先看角色互换导致的性能变化，以及不同 domain 中 planner/executor 哪个更关键。对预训练研究员，主要价值不是 agent 框架本身，而是它提供了一种更细粒度的能力诊断方式：模型的规划、执行、验证能力可能不能用一个总分概括。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses evaluation and deployment selection for multi-role LLM agent teams. Once roles such as planner, executor, and verifier are assigned to different models, accuracy and cost are no longer properties of a single model; they depend on the role assignment, deployment mode, and task domain. Standard fixed-model or fixed-agent benchmarks do not answer which model should fill which role under a given cost budget.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent evaluation and deployment benchmark, not a pretraining paper. Its value for foundation-model research is diagnostic: it separates model capability by role and shows that the same model can have different marginal value as a planner, executor, or verifier. That is a more deployment-relevant capability profile than a single aggregate benchmark score, and it can inform post-training evaluation and model selection.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces AgentCARD, a role-aware benchmark framework covering Cost, Accuracy, Role assignment, and Deployment mode. Rather than creating a new static task suite, it converts existing agentic benchmarks into role-decomposed evaluations. The framework includes a planner-executor and planner-verifier-executor harness, a unified per-task cost model for API, self-hosted, and hybrid serving, Pareto-frontier analysis for cost-accuracy tradeoffs, and a Shapley-based role-criticality diagnostic to identify the bottleneck role. The key design choice is to evaluate team configurations rather than individual models.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans five domains: open-domain tool use, finance, medical reasoning, coding, and mathematics. It tests all 16 planner-executor assignments among four API models, along with self-hosted and hybrid variants. The main findings are that heterogeneous teams can improve accuracy by up to 44% when models are assigned to suitable roles, while reversing the same pair can reduce accuracy by 36%. Heterogeneous teams often occupy the Pareto frontier and can match the strongest homogeneous team at 1.4x to 12x lower per-task cost. Planner and executor upgrade returns differ by up to 40% across domains. A three-role plan-verify-execute pilot adds up to 9.4% accuracy over the strongest two-agent baseline at comparable cost.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15–25 minutes. Focus on the benchmark construction, cost model, Pareto analysis, and the Shapley role-criticality diagnostic. In the results, prioritize the role-swap comparisons and the domain-specific planner-versus-executor bottleneck analysis. For foundation-model researchers, the useful point is not the agent framework itself, but the finer capability decomposition: planning, execution, and verification may need separate measurement rather than a single aggregate score.

recommendation.zh: 关注点在异构 agent team 的算力/成本分配而非建模范式，Shapley 瓶颈诊断和 Pareto 图值得 serving/agent 团队看图即可。
recommendation.en: The value is in heterogeneous agent-team cost allocation rather than modeling; read the Shapley bottleneck diagnostic and Pareto plots if you work on agent serving.

paper.title: How LLMs Fail and Generalize in RTL Coding for Hardware Design?
paper.abstract: Translating sequential programming priors into the parallel temporal logic of hardware design remains a crucial bottleneck for large language models(LLM). To investigate this, we introduce a new error taxonomy grounded in problem solvability, inspired by cognitive theory. Our taxonomy categorizes failures into syntactic, semantic, solvable functional, and unsolvable functional types. Evaluations reveal a strict empirical ceiling on the VerilogEval benchmark, as frontier models plateau at a 90.8%

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 LLM 在 RTL/Verilog 硬件设计代码生成中为什么失败，以及 SFT、RL 和 test-time scaling 能解决哪些错误、不能解决哪些错误。核心问题不是单纯提高 VerilogEval 分数，而是把错误分解成可训练修复的表层错误和反映知识缺口的功能错误。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 研究的价值在于，它给出了一个比较清楚的失败分层：模型可以通过优化快速学会“写出能编译的代码”，但这不等于具备硬件时序、并行信号流和电路语义理解。RL/SFT 降低语法和静态语义错误的同时，可能把错误推到更深的功能层。这个结论对代码模型预训练数据覆盖、领域知识注入、RL 训练信号设计都有启发。它也说明 test-time compute 只对可采样恢复的错误有效，对模型从未掌握的领域知识缺口帮助有限。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出一个四级错误分类框架，对齐 HDL 工具链的实际流程。L1 是 syntactic error，即代码不满足 Verilog/SystemVerilog 语法。L2 是 semantic error，即能解析但违反静态语义约束，例如 wire/reg 使用、过程赋值、连续赋值、端口声明等规则。L3 是能通过编译和静态检查但不能通过 testbench 的功能错误。L3 又分为 L3S 和 L3U：L3S 表示该问题在采样或其他模型输出中可以找到正确解，属于可恢复功能错误；L3U 表示该模型在当前条件下无法产生正确功能实现，更接近模型知识缺口。这个切分的好处是把“多采样能不能救回来”和“是否需要提升模型本身”区分开。作者还在 K2-Think 模型上做 GRPO 训练，用非 RTL 预训练/指令模型迁移到 RTL 任务，观察 RL 过程中错误类型如何转移。
summary.experiments: 实验评估 17 个开源和闭源模型在 VerilogEval-Human 上的表现。一个主要发现是性能存在明显天花板：最好的 frontier 模型 initial pass rate 为 90.8%，仍有 4.2% 的 L3U floor。不同训练范式下 L3U 大约维持在 4–17% 区间，说明这类错误不容易靠更多采样或表层优化消除。SFT 和 RL 会减少 L1+L2 错误，但同时增加 L3 类错误，说明模型从“不会写合法 Verilog”转向“能写合法但功能不对的电路”。RTL 专门模型的 L3S 比例较高，约 11–12%，因此更容易从 best-of-N 采样中获益。另一个有意思的结果是，多模型互补性很强：所有 17 个模型的并集能解出 150/156 个问题，约 96.2%，但没有单个模型超过 148 个。这说明不少 L3U 是模型特定的，而不是任务本身不可解。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30 分钟。先看 Section 3 的 taxonomy 定义和 Figure 1，确认 L1/L2/L3S/L3U 的边界。然后看 Table 1 和 Table 2，重点是不同模型的错误分布，而不是只看 pass rate。Figure 2 和 Figure 5 展示 SFT/RL 后错误如何从语法语义层迁移到功能层，是这篇论文最有信息量的部分。Section 4 的 GRPO 分析适合关注 RL post-train 的读者。Appendix B.9 的 best-of-N 结果可以用来理解 L3S 为什么是 test-time scaling 的有效目标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why LLMs fail at RTL and Verilog code generation, and which failures can be reduced by SFT, RL, or test-time sampling. The focus is not only benchmark accuracy, but a decomposition of failures into syntax, static semantics, recoverable functional mistakes, and deeper model-specific knowledge gaps.
