summary_en.importance: The useful lesson for pretraining and post-training research is that optimization can make a model produce code that compiles, while still failing to model hardware behavior. RTL requires parallel signal-flow reasoning and temporal circuit semantics, which are weakly represented in general programming data. The paper shows that SFT and RL can reduce surface errors but may expose or increase deeper functional failures. This has direct implications for code pretraining data coverage, domain-specific corpus construction, verifier design, and the limits of RL when the base model lacks the relevant domain knowledge.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose a four-level fault taxonomy aligned with the HDL compilation and verification pipeline. L1 covers syntactic errors, where the generated code is outside the Verilog/SystemVerilog grammar. L2 covers static semantic errors, where the code parses but violates constraints enforced by elaboration, linting, or synthesis, such as invalid procedural assignments, net/register misuse, or port declaration issues. L3 covers code that passes compilation but fails functional testbenches. L3 is further divided into L3S and L3U. L3S errors are functionally wrong but recoverable through sampling or alternative outputs. L3U errors are unsolved by the model under the tested setup and are treated as evidence of a model-specific knowledge gap. The paper also trains K2-Think models with GRPO on RTL tasks to analyze whether RL transfers general coding priors into hardware design.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 17 proprietary and open-source models on VerilogEval-Human. The reported ceiling is 90.8% initial pass rate for the best frontier model, with a remaining 4.2% L3U floor. Across training paradigms, L3U errors remain in the 4–17% range, suggesting that these errors are not removed by simple sampling or surface-level optimization. SFT and RL reduce L1 and L2 errors but shift more failures into L3, meaning the models learn to generate compilable Verilog before they learn correct circuit behavior. RTL-specialized models show relatively high L3S rates, around 11–12%, which makes them more responsive to best-of-N sampling. The union of all 17 evaluated models solves 150 out of 156 tasks, or 96.2%, while no single model solves more than 148, indicating substantial complementarity across model families.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 minutes. Start with Section 3 and Figure 1 for the L1/L2/L3S/L3U taxonomy. Then read Table 1 and Table 2 for the error distribution across models; these are more informative than the pass-rate ranking alone. Figure 2 and Figure 5 are the key parts for understanding how SFT and RL change the failure profile. Section 4 is useful for readers interested in GRPO and cross-domain transfer from general code to RTL. Appendix B.9 is worth checking for the best-of-N analysis and the practical meaning of the L3S category.

recommendation.zh: RTL 是窄域，但“对齐只教会编译”这个错误分解值得看；重点读 taxonomy 和 90.8% ceiling。
recommendation.en: RTL is niche, but the error decomposition is useful; read the taxonomy and the 90.8% ceiling analysis.

paper.title: PreAct: Computer-Using Agents that Get Faster on Repeated Tasks
paper.abstract: Computer-using agents drive real software through the screen -- clicking and typing -- but they solve every task from scratch: asked to repeat a task, an agent re-reads the screen, re-reasons every tap, and pays the full cost again. We present PreAct, which lets such an agent get faster on tasks it has done before. The first time it succeeds, PreAct compiles the run into a small state-machine program-states that check the screen, transitions that act-and on later runs replays it directly instead

summary.core_problem: 现有基于屏幕交互的计算机操作Agent每次执行重复任务时都从零启动完整的视觉-推理-行动循环，没有对历史成功经验的可验证复用能力，重复任务执行冗余成本高、效率低。
summary.importance: 为Agent在使用过程中的效率自提升提供了轻量可落地的范式，核心的"先校验再执行、入库前先验证"设计思路对大模型调用缓存、技能复用类工作有直接参考价值，同时点出了当前Agent评测普遍忽略重复任务效率维度的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 1. Agent首次成功完成任务后，将完整执行轨迹编译为小型状态机：每个状态存储屏幕校验规则，每个迁移对应具体可执行操作；2. 后续遇到同类任务时优先执行状态机，每步操作前先校验当前屏幕是否符合状态机预期，完全匹配则无需调用大模型直接执行，出现不匹配立刻交回原始Agent接管；3. 新编译的程序入库前额外做一次独立完整重放，只有通过任务本身的判定器确认确实能完成目标的状态机才会存入技能库，避免错误程序累积导致性能随使用衰减。
summary.experiments: 在AndroidWorld（移动端）、OSWorld（桌面端）、WebArena（网页端）三个跨平台基准上测试，成功复用状态机的重复任务执行速度比全量调用Agent快8.5-13倍，全程无逐步骤大模型调用；屏幕校验机制相比无校验的盲目重放，在冷启动到热启动的过渡阶段任务成功率提升1.75-2.6个点；检索环节用简单嵌入检索替代大模型选程序，检索准确率仅从100%降到75.6%但成本大幅降低，对最终效果影响极小；提示词措辞、手写运行护栏等因素对结果无显著影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看引言部分对现有复用方案缺陷的对比、核心的两层校验设计，以及消融实验中区分高影响设计与无关设计的结论，不需要深入推导状态机构建的实现细节，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing screen-interfacing computer-using agents solve every task from scratch even for recurring routines, running full vision-language reasoning cycles for every action without verifiable reuse of past successful trajectories, leading to high redundant cost on repeated tasks.
summary_en.importance: This work presents a lightweight, production-ready paradigm for agent efficiency improvement over extended use. Its core design principles of 'check before acting, verify before storing' provide direct reference for LLM call caching and skill reuse systems, and highlights the missing repeated-task efficiency dimension in most current agent evaluation protocols.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. After an agent successfully completes a task for the first time, PreAct compiles the full trajectory into a lightweight finite state machine, where each state stores a screen state validation rule, and each transition stores a concrete executable action. 2. For subsequent matches to the same task, PreAct runs the state machine directly: it validates screen alignment with expected state before every action, invokes no LLM calls during successful replay, and immediately returns control to the base agent when a screen mismatch is detected. 3. Newly compiled state machines are only added to the skill library after a full independent replay that passes the benchmark's native task verifier, preventing accumulation of buggy programs that cause performance degradation over time.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across three platforms: AndroidWorld (mobile), OSWorld (desktop), WebArena (web). Warm replays of matched tasks run 8.5-13x faster than full agent inference with zero per-step LLM calls. The screen check mechanism improves success rate by 1.75-2.6 tasks across the cold-to-warm transition compared to blind replay without validation. Replacing LLM-based skill retrieval with a simple embedding retriever drops retrieval accuracy from 100% to 75.6% but has negligible impact on end performance at significantly lower cost. Factors including prompt wording and hand-written runtime guardrails show no measurable effect on results.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper. Focus on the comparison of limitations of prior skill reuse approaches in the introduction, the two-layer verification design, and the ablation results separating high-impact design choices from irrelevant ones. There is no need to dig into low-level implementation details of state machine construction. Expected reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和验证门槛即可；它把 agent 记忆做成可检查程序，比向量记忆更像工程上能落地的重复任务缓存。
recommendation.en: Read the method and validation gate; programmatic replay is a cleaner repeated-task cache than vector-memory reuse.

paper.title: Entropy-Gated Latent Recursion
paper.abstract: Inference-time scaling has become the dominant lever for improving language-model reasoning, but existing methods derive rollout diversity from a single source: stochastic token-level sampling. We argue that this single-axis sampling space is fundamentally limiting, and identify a second, fully deterministic and complementary axis: the layer span $L$ at which a frozen model's top decoder layers are recursively re-applied at high-uncertainty tokens. Different choices of $L$ produce distinct rollo

summary.core_problem: 推理时 scaling 当前仅依赖随机 token 采样单一维度，限制了 rollout 多样性；现有方法无法利用确定性机制产生互补的不同推理路径
summary.importance: 方法创新/范式扩展：首次将推理时 compute 扩展为 L×T 二维采样空间（确定性层跨度递归 × 随机温度采样），无需额外训练即可提升推理能力
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Entropy-Gated Latent Recursion (EGLR)：在高不确定性 token 处重新应用模型顶层 L 层解码器，最多 K_max 次迭代直到下一词分布收敛；与 T 个温度样本组合形成笛卡尔采样空间；不同 L 选择自然产生不同 rollout，解决不同子集问题
summary.experiments: 在8个推理 benchmark 上进行评估；每层递归额外成本极小（仅顶层），每 rollout 成本几乎不变；不同 L 选择解决互不重叠的问题子集，显示互补性
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Martin Takac（Lehigh University，ML优化理论知名）和 Nils Lukas，机构信息从论文本身不易确定

summary_en.core_problem: Inference-time scaling currently relies on only one axis — stochastic token sampling — fundamentally limiting rollout diversity; no existing method exploits deterministic mechanisms for complementary rollouts
summary_en.importance: Method innovation / paradigm extension: first to expand inference-time compute into an L×T 2D sampling space (deterministic layer-span recursion × stochastic temperature sampling), requiring no additional training
summary_en.technical_approach: Entropy-Gated Latent Recursion (EGLR): at high-uncertainty tokens, re-apply the top-L decoder layers for at most K_max iterations until next-token distribution converges; combined with T temperature samples to form a Cartesian sampling space; different L choices naturally produce distinct rollouts solving different problem subsets
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across 8 reasoning benchmarks; minimal extra cost per recursion (top layers only), near-constant per-rollout cost; different L values solve disjoint problem subsets, demonstrating complementarity
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Martin Takac (Lehigh University, known for ML optimization theory) and Nils Lukas; institutional affiliations not immediately clear from abstract alone

recommendation.zh: 推理时 scaling 的真正新维度——不依赖随机性的确定性层递归，设计空间干净，值得在内部 decoding 实验中复现
recommendation.en: A genuinely new dimension for inference-time scaling — deterministic layer recursion independent of stochasticity; clean design space, worth reproducing in internal decoding experiments.

paper.title: Tyler: Typed Latent Reasoning for Language Models -- When to Think, What to Compute, and How Much to Allocate
paper.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting improves reasoning in large language models (LLMs) by externalizing intermediate computation as discrete text tokens, but this textual interface also introduces redundancy and inference overhead. Latent reasoning offers a promising alternative by carrying part of the computation in continuous representations. However, existing methods typically predefine when latent computation is invoked and how it is allocated during decoding, leaving a key problem unresolved:

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 latent reasoning 里一个一直没有被真正解决的问题：模型不只是“能不能插入 latent token”，而是要在自回归解码过程中，在线决定三件事——什么时候进入 latent computation、进入后做哪一类计算、以及分配多少计算预算。已有方法大多把 latent reasoning 当成一种固定接口：要么预先规定 latent step 出现的位置，要么只做二元决策，判断是否触发 latent mode。这样做的问题是，latent computation 与当前推理状态耦合不够，也无法表达不同推理阶段需要不同内部计算的事实。Tyler 把这个问题重新表述为 typed and budgeted computation：把隐式推理看成若干具有明确功能角色的算子，由模型在生成时按需调用，而不是把所有隐式推理都压进一种统一的连续表示里。
summary.importance: 对预训练和基座建模的启发主要有两层。第一，它把“latent reasoning 是否有用”推进到“latent reasoning 应该如何被组织和调度”。这比单纯压缩 CoT 更接近一种新的语言建模接口：visible token 负责对外通信，latent operator 负责内部计算。第二，它强调 latent computation 的功能分化，而不是把 latent token 当成无类型的软提示或隐藏状态补丁。这一点对未来把 reasoning 作为模型内生计算资源来训练很关键，因为它涉及计算分配、推理阶段结构、以及跨任务迁移时哪些内部操作可以复用。就量级看，这还不是替代 AR 预训练范式的工作，但它给出了一个比较完整的 online latent reasoning 框架，尤其对“test-time compute 如何由模型自己调度”这个方向有方法论价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由两部分组成。第一部分是 typed latent operator。作者定义了三类操作：Og 对应 global orientation，用来在较早阶段建立整体解题方向；Os 对应 state update，用来更新当前推理状态；Op 对应 procedural abstraction，用来调用更偏程序化、模式化的求解过程。每个 operator 都不是输出离散 token，而是根据当前 decoding context 生成一段 operator-conditioned latent tokens，再把这些连续向量拼接回上下文，继续后续可见 token 的自回归生成。这里的关键不是“插入 latent token”本身，而是给 latent computation 加上功能标签，使不同 operator 学到不同的计算角色。

第二部分是 operator invocation policy。模型在每个解码步不再只在词表上做 next-token 预测，而是在“生成可见 token”与“调用某个 latent operator 并指定预算”之间做选择。也就是说，动作空间包含 visible decoding 和若干 latent actions，latent action 还带 budget 维度，决定插入多少 latent tokens。这样模型可以在简单位置直接输出文本，在困难位置先做内部计算，再回到显式生成。

训练分两阶段。Stage 1 先冻结主 LLM，只训练 latent operators 和 latent synthesis module，让每个 operator 对齐到预设的功能角色。这里作者引入 Latent Synthesis Model，把 operator identity 与当前状态映射成一段可被主模型消费的 latent token 序列。先冻结 backbone 的目的很明确：避免在早期把“operator 学什么”和“主模型如何适配 latent interface”纠缠在一起，降低训练不稳定性。Stage 2 再固定 Stage 1 学到的 latent interface，只训练调用策略，使用 GRPO 做策略优化。奖励来自最终任务表现，因此 policy 学的是何时调用、调用哪种 operator、预算给多少。由于 operator invocation 是稀疏事件，作者还加了 operator-anchored auxiliary objective 来稳定训练，避免 policy 在少量触发位置上梯度过弱或塌缩到单一动作。

和已有 latent reasoning 方法相比，区别主要有三点。其一，不是 fixed-position latent insertion，而是 online decision。其二，不是单一 latent mode，而是 typed operators。其三，不是只决定“要不要想”，而是连“想什么”和“想多久”一起学。这使它更像一个可调度的内部计算系统，而不是一个附加的 soft-thought 通道。
summary.experiments:
全文给出的实验重点是三类：多骨干、多任务泛化，以及连续适应。摘要和正文可确认的结论是，Tyler 在多个 backbone 和多个 reasoning benchmark 上都优于强基线，而且提升能迁移到训练域之外。作者特别强调两点分析结果。

第一，policy 学到了与任务难度和推理阶段相关的 operator 使用模式。较容易样本或较直接的生成阶段，更倾向于继续 visible decoding；难度上升时，latent operator 调用频率增加。不同 operator 的触发位置也不同：Og 更像前期的全局定向，Os 更像中间过程中的状态修正，Op 更偏向需要复用程序化解题模板的阶段。这说明 typed design 不是纯粹的人为命名，至少在行为上形成了可分化的功能角色。

第二，在 sequential adaptation 设置里，作者按 code、science、math、theorem reasoning 这样的顺序做连续适应，Tyler 的最终性能更高，同时遗忘更低。这个结果对基座研究更有意思，因为它暗示 typed latent operators 可能提供了一种比纯显式 CoT 更稳的内部计算接口：新领域适应时，不必完全改写外显推理分布，而是部分复用已有 operator 的内部功能。

从你给出的全文片段里，具体参数量、数据规模、各 benchmark 的绝对分数和提升幅度没有完整展开，因此不适合编造数字。阅读时应重点去正文实验表确认：1）用了哪些 backbone；2）训练域与测试域是否严格分离；3）相对 fixed latent、untyped latent、纯 CoT baseline 的提升幅度；4）budget 分配的消融是否证明“typed + adaptive budget”同时必要，而不是只靠更多 test-time compute 获益。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合泛读后挑重点深看，预计 35 到 50 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 2，确认作者到底把 latent reasoning 重新定义成了什么问题。很多类似工作只是换一种 soft token 接口，这篇的关键在于 online typed scheduling。

方法部分重点看三处。第一，三类 operator 的形式化定义，以及 latent synthesis module 如何把 operator 与当前状态映射成 latent token 序列。这里决定了 typed latent 是否真的有独立参数化和独立功能。第二，policy 的动作空间设计，尤其 budget 是离散选择还是连续参数化，奖励如何构造，GRPO 在这里优化的对象到底是单独 policy head 还是与主模型共享部分参数。第三，operator-anchored auxiliary objective 的具体形式，因为这关系到稀疏调用场景下 RL 是否稳定。

实验部分优先看：主结果表、operator ablation、budget ablation、跨域泛化、sequential adaptation。若时间有限，可以跳过常规 benchmark 描述，直接看能否回答三个问题：typed operator 是否比 untyped latent 更好；adaptive invocation 是否比 fixed schedule 更好；continual adaptation 的收益是否来自更少遗忘而不只是更高初始分数。

如果要深挖，最值得追的是两个点。一个是 typed operator 是否真的学到可迁移的“计算原语”，还是仍然高度依赖训练任务分布。另一个是这种框架能否前移到 pretraining 或 mid-training，而不只是 reasoning finetune 阶段使用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a missing piece in latent reasoning: not merely how to insert latent tokens, but how to let an autoregressive LM decide online when to invoke latent computation, what kind of internal computation to run, and how much budget to spend. Prior latent-reasoning methods usually hard-code the invocation pattern or reduce the decision to a binary trigger. That leaves the model with little control over how latent computation should interact with the evolving reasoning state. Tyler reframes the problem as typed, budgeted computation during decoding, where latent reasoning is treated as an internal compute interface rather than a compressed form of chain-of-thought.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is conceptual. It moves the discussion from “can latent reasoning help” to “how should latent reasoning be structured and scheduled.” That matters for foundation-model research because it points toward a richer generation interface: visible tokens for communication, latent operators for internal computation. The typed design is also important. Instead of treating all latent tokens as one undifferentiated soft channel, the paper argues that different reasoning stages require different internal functions. This is relevant to future work on test-time compute allocation, reasoning-aware pretraining, and reusable internal computation across domains. It is not yet a replacement for standard AR pretraining, but it is a serious step toward making latent computation a first-class modeling primitive.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Tyler has two core components.

First, it introduces typed latent operators. The model can invoke three operator types: Og for global orientation, Os for state update, and Op for procedural abstraction. Each operator takes the current decoding state and produces a sequence of operator-conditioned latent tokens, which are appended to the context and consumed by the same autoregressive backbone. The key idea is not latent-token insertion by itself, but functional specialization: latent computation is decomposed into reusable roles rather than collapsed into a single generic latent mode.

Second, Tyler learns an operator-invocation policy. At each decoding step, the model chooses between emitting a visible token and invoking one of the latent operators with a certain budget. The budget controls how much latent computation is inserted, typically via the number of latent tokens or latent steps. This turns decoding into a mixed action process: direct visible generation for easy steps, internal computation for harder ones.

Training is split into two stages. In Stage 1, the backbone LM is frozen while the latent operators and the latent synthesis module are trained. This isolates the problem of learning a usable latent interface from the problem of policy learning. The latent synthesis module maps the current state plus operator identity into latent-token sequences that the frozen LM can consume. In Stage 2, the learned latent interface is fixed and only the invocation policy is optimized with GRPO. The policy learns when to call an operator, which operator to call, and how much budget to allocate, using task-level reward. Because operator calls are sparse events, the paper adds an operator-anchored auxiliary objective to stabilize learning and prevent collapse or weak gradients at invocation positions.

Relative to prior work, the differences are clear: online invocation instead of fixed insertion points, typed operators instead of a single latent mode, and joint learning of whether, what, and how much to compute instead of a simple trigger mechanism.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental story centers on three claims: gains across multiple backbones and reasoning benchmarks, transfer beyond the training domain, and better sequential adaptation. From the provided full-text excerpt, the paper reports consistent improvements over strong baselines across several model families and tasks.

The most interesting analysis is behavioral specialization of the learned policy. Operator usage varies with task difficulty and decoding stage. Easier steps rely more on direct visible decoding, while harder steps trigger more latent computation. The three operators are used differently: Og appears earlier as a planning or orientation mechanism, Os is used more for intermediate state refinement, and Op is associated with more procedural or template-like reasoning segments. This supports the claim that the typed operators acquire differentiated functional roles rather than acting as arbitrary labels.

The second notable result is in sequential adaptation across domains such as code, science, math, and theorem reasoning. Tyler reaches higher final performance with lower forgetting than baselines. That is especially relevant for foundation-model researchers, because it suggests that typed latent computation may provide a more reusable internal interface under domain shift.

The excerpt does not expose the full numeric tables, so it would be unsafe to invent exact gains, model sizes, or dataset scales. When reading the paper, the main things to verify are: which backbones were used, how training and transfer domains were separated, how much Tyler improves over fixed latent and untyped latent baselines, and whether the budget ablations show that the benefit comes from adaptive allocation rather than simply spending more test-time compute.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, but it deserves a careful skim. A good pass takes about 35 to 50 minutes. Start with the introduction and the main framework figure to pin down the paper’s actual claim. The important shift is not “latent tokens exist,” but “latent computation is typed and scheduled online.”

In the method section, focus on three pieces. First, how the three operators are parameterized and how the latent synthesis module turns operator identity plus current state into latent-token sequences. Second, the action space of the invocation policy: whether budget is discrete or continuous, how policy decisions are integrated with token decoding, and what exactly GRPO is optimizing. Third, the operator-anchored auxiliary loss, since sparse invocation is where many RL-style control schemes become unstable.

In the experiments, prioritize the main comparison table, operator ablations, budget ablations, transfer results, and sequential adaptation. If time is limited, skip benchmark boilerplate and read only enough to answer three questions: does typed latent reasoning beat untyped latent reasoning, does adaptive invocation beat fixed schedules, and does the continual-adaptation gain come from reduced forgetting rather than a stronger starting point.

The two deeper follow-up questions are whether these operators really become transferable computational primitives, and whether the same framework could be moved earlier into pretraining or mid-training instead of being used only at reasoning fine-tuning time.

recommendation.zh: 读方法图和预算策略即可；想法切中 latent CoT 的硬问题，但没有规模实验前先当架构假设。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and budget policy; it targets a real latent-CoT bottleneck, but treat it as an architectural hypothesis until scaled evidence appears.

paper.title: Latent Thought Flow: Efficient Latent Reasoning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on intermediate reasoning, yet explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) suffers from a linguistic space bottleneck: each thought must be decoded into tokens, causing high inference overhead. Latent reasoning moves deliberation into continuous space, but existing methods mostly learn deterministic or reward-maximizing paths, lacking a principled way to allocate probability across trajectories with different correctness and costs. We propose Latent Thought Flo

summary.core_problem: 把 LLM 的中间推理从显式 CoT token 序列迁移到连续潜变量轨迹中，以降低推理开销并更好分配计算。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练/推理范式创新：它不是继续优化文本 CoT，而是把 latent reasoning 建模为带质量-成本权衡的随机轨迹采样问题，对 test-time compute 和 reasoning supervision 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Latent Thought Flow，将推理过程表示为可变长度连续轨迹，并训练 sampler 去匹配由答案质量和计算成本共同诱导的 posterior；具体用 continuous GFlowNet 和随机 latent transition 实现。为缓解答案级监督稀疏，加入 Entropy-Weighted Subtrajectory Balance 作为中间奖励训练目标，并用 reference-prior regularizer 约束探索，避免 latent path 漂移过大。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明在 finetuning 和 transfer learning setting 下实验，但未披露模型参数量、训练数据规模、baseline 列表或具体提升幅度。需要重点检查实验是否控制了解码 token 数、latent steps、wall-clock latency 和最终正确率之间的 trade-off。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper moves intermediate reasoning from explicit Chain-of-Thought tokens into continuous latent trajectories to reduce inference overhead and allocate computation more flexibly.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training and reasoning-paradigm method: instead of optimizing textual CoT, it formulates latent reasoning as stochastic trajectory sampling under answer-quality and computation-cost rewards.
summary_en.technical_approach: Latent Thought Flow represents reasoning as variable-length continuous trajectories and trains a sampler to match a reward-induced posterior over correctness and cost. The implementation uses a continuous GFlowNet with stochastic latent transitions, an Entropy-Weighted Subtrajectory Balance objective for sparse answer supervision, and a reference-prior regularizer to keep exploration anchored.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments in fine-tuning and transfer-learning settings, but gives no model sizes, data scale, baseline list, or quantitative gains. The key checks are whether the paper controls for decoded token count, latent-step count, latency, and final accuracy under the same compute budget.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法目标和 compute-cost posterior 设定；若实验 latency 口径干净，可作为 latent reasoning 内部消融候选。
recommendation.en: Read the objective and the compute-cost posterior setup; if the latency accounting is clean, it is worth adding to internal latent-reasoning ablations.

paper.title: AdaSR: Adaptive Streaming Reasoning with Hierarchical Relative Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: Large reasoning models typically follow a read-then-think paradigm: they observe the complete input, reason over a static context, and then produce the answer. Yet many real-world scenarios are inherently dynamic, such as audio and video stream, where information arrives as a continuous stream and models must reason, update, and respond under partial observations. Recent streaming reasoning methods allow models to think while reading, but they largely rely on supervised imitation of pre-construc

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是：在流式输入场景中，模型不能等全部上下文到齐再推理，而需要边接收信息边决定何时思考、思考多久、最后如何整合。
summary.importance: 重要性主要在后训练范式而不是基座预训练本身。它把传统 read-then-think 推理改成 streaming + final deliberation 的分层决策问题，并用强化学习而非监督模仿去学计算分配策略。对关心 test-time compute、在线推理和 RL 信号设计的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上提出 AdaSR 框架和 Hierarchical Relative Policy Optimization（HRPO）。核心思路是把策略优化拆成两个层级：一层负责流式阶段的中间推理与计算预算分配，另一层负责流结束后的最终审议；模型不再只模仿预构造轨迹，而是通过相对策略优化学习在部分观测下何时推理、何时等待更多信息。
summary.experiments: 从摘要可见，论文评测的是动态输入任务，如音频/视频流式推理场景，并与依赖监督轨迹的 streaming reasoning 方法比较。摘要没有给出模型规模、训练 token 数、具体 benchmark 名称和精确增益，因此目前更像方法信号而不是可直接迁移到预训练 recipe 的强证据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets reasoning under streaming inputs, where a model cannot wait for the full context and must decide when to think, how much to compute, and how to revise its beliefs as information arrives.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mostly on the post-training side rather than core pretraining. It reframes read-then-think reasoning into a hierarchical decision problem with streaming reasoning plus final deliberation, optimized by RL instead of supervised trajectory imitation. This is relevant if you care about test-time compute allocation and online reasoning policies.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes AdaSR together with Hierarchical Relative Policy Optimization (HRPO). The key idea is to decompose policy optimization into two levels: one for intermediate reasoning and compute allocation during the stream, and another for final deliberation after the stream ends. Instead of imitating fixed trajectories, the model learns when to reason and when to wait under partial observations.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, experiments are on dynamic-input settings such as audio/video streaming reasoning, compared against prior supervised streaming-reasoning methods. The abstract does not expose model sizes, training data scale, benchmark names, or exact gains, so this currently reads more like a method signal than a directly actionable pretraining result.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练不直接相连，但如果你在看 test-time compute 或 RL 版动态推理，先读方法定义和奖励分解；没有 clean scaling 证据前别急着改 prior。
recommendation.en: Not directly a pretraining paper, but worth a quick read if you care about test-time compute allocation or RL for streaming reasoning; read the policy decomposition first and treat the claims cautiously until the scaling setup is cleaner.

paper.title: ARMOR-MAD: Adaptive Routing for Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Debate in Large Language Model Reasoning
paper.abstract: Multi-agent debate (MAD) can improve large language model reasoning, but fixed debate pipelines often waste computation and can amplify correlated errors among similar agents. We propose ARMOR-MAD, a training-free heterogeneous MAD framework that treats debate as conditional computation. ARMOR-MAD combines three components: Pre-debate Agreement Routing (PAR) decides whether independently generated Round-0 answers require debate; Early Agreement Stopping Evaluator (EASE) stops debate after conver

summary.core_problem: 固定轮数的多智能体辩论会浪费 test-time compute，并可能放大相似模型之间的相关错误。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个训练-free 的多智能体推理控制方法。它把辩论过程看作条件计算，尝试在准确率和推理成本之间做动态折中；对 test-time scaling 和 agentic reasoning 有参考意义，但不是基座预训练工作。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ARMOR-MAD，由三个模块组成：PAR 在辩论前根据初始答案一致性决定是否需要进入辩论；EASE 在辩论过程中检测收敛并提前停止；SOD 在最终聚合时下调语义离群答案的权重。方法强调异构模型池，而不是同质模型反复采样。
summary.experiments: 在 MATH Level 5、GSM8K、MMLU、MMLU-Pro 上，相比固定轮数异构 debate 提升准确率或效率，报告分数分别为 65.5%、96.5%、90.0%、81.5%。摘要未给出模型池组成、调用成本、统计显著性和每个模块的消融细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Fixed-round multi-agent debate wastes test-time compute and can amplify correlated errors among similar agents.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free control method for multi-agent reasoning. It treats debate as conditional computation and attempts to trade off accuracy and inference cost dynamically. This is relevant to test-time scaling and agentic reasoning, but not directly to foundation pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: ARMOR-MAD has three components: PAR decides before debate whether independent round-0 answers warrant discussion; EASE stops the debate once agreement is reached; SOD down-weights semantic outlier answers during final aggregation. The method emphasizes heterogeneous model pools rather than repeated sampling from homogeneous agents.
summary_en.experiments: On MATH Level 5, GSM8K, MMLU, and MMLU-Pro, it improves over fixed-round heterogeneous debate and reports accuracies of 65.5%, 96.5%, 90.0%, and 81.5%, respectively. The abstract does not specify the model pool, inference cost, statistical significance, or full component ablations.

recommendation.zh: 只看 routing 和 early-stop 消融即可；这是 test-time compute 控制的小信号，不会改变预训练判断。
recommendation.en: Read only the routing and early-stop ablations; this is a small signal on test-time compute control, not a pretraining prior changer.

paper.title: FlowBank: Query-Adaptive Agentic Workflows Optimization through Precompute-and-Reuse
paper.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems are increasingly powerful, but current agentic workflow optimization paradigms make an unsatisfying trade-off. Task-level methods spend substantial offline compute yet deploy only a single workflow, leaving complementary candidates unused, while query-level methods synthesize a new workflow per query at substantial inference cost. Our motivating analysis shows these paradigms are more complementary than competing: workflows discovered during o

summary.core_problem: 解决 agentic workflow 优化中的计算浪费：离线搜索只部署一个 workflow，查询级生成又在每个 query 上付出高推理成本。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是通用 Agent 系统优化。它关注 test-time 计算分配和 workflow 复用，提出把离线发现的多个互补 workflow 组织成可检索的 bank，而不是追求单一最优 workflow 或每次重新生成。
summary.technical_approach: FlowBank 的核心思路是 precompute-and-reuse：离线生成一组互补的候选 workflows，构建紧凑 workflow bank；推理时根据 query 自适应选择合适 workflow。方法重点在 workflow 多样性、互补性和查询级选择之间做联合优化。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整实验细节、任务集、模型规模或提升幅度。可确认的是作者基于 motivating analysis 观察到：离线搜索得到的 workflows 往往覆盖不同 query 子集，而部分昂贵的 query-level generation 可由预计算 workflow 解决。
summary.authors_note: University of Maryland, College Park 与 Amazon 合作；论文方向偏 Agent workflow optimization 与推理时计算复用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses wasted compute in agentic workflow optimization: task-level methods deploy only one workflow after expensive search, while query-level methods regenerate workflows at high inference cost.
summary_en.importance: This is a general agent-systems optimization contribution. It frames workflow optimization as a compute-allocation and reuse problem, arguing for a bank of complementary workflows rather than a single global workflow or per-query synthesis.
summary_en.technical_approach: FlowBank follows a precompute-and-reuse design. It generates complementary workflows offline, stores a compact workflow bank, and selects a suitable workflow adaptively at inference time for each query. The main technical focus is coupling workflow diversity, complementarity, and query-conditioned selection.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not specify the full benchmark suite, model sizes, or quantitative gains. It does report a motivating analysis showing that workflows found during offline search solve different subsets of queries, and that many queries handled by expensive query-level generation can be covered by cheaper precomputed workflows.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from University of Maryland, College Park and Amazon, focusing on agent workflow optimization and inference-time compute reuse.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent test-time compute 的工程模式看一眼即可；核心像 workflow retrieval，若无强消融就别上升成新范式。
recommendation.en: Worth a glance as an agent test-time compute pattern; it looks like workflow retrieval, and without strong ablations it should not be treated as a new paradigm.

paper.title: Intrinsic Selection and Particle Resampling for Inference-Time Scaling Beyond Domain Verifiability
paper.abstract: Inference-Time Scaling (ITS) has largely succeeded in verifiable domains like math and coding, where cheap verification enables scalable output selection. However, extending ITS to tasks prone to systematic failure - driven by faulty initial assumptions or unmet multidimensional constraints - typically relies on costly external solvers or brittle, model-based verifiers. Our key insight is that the intrinsic statistics of parallel sample sets, specifically length-adjusted tail entropy, provide a

summary.core_problem: 推理时缩放（ITS）仅能在数学、代码等可低成本验证的领域生效，无法覆盖无真值或验证成本高的非可验证域任务
summary.importance: 首次提出无需外部验证器、基于样本内在统计的ITS范式，扩展了推理时计算缩放的适用边界，属于方法创新
summary.technical_approach: 提出两类方案：一是内在选择（iS），用长度调整的尾部熵对并行生成的样本排序选优；二是内在粒子滤波（iPF），将该统计信号扩展到步级重采样，实现自适应计算分配
summary.experiments: 摘要内容截断，现有披露结果显示iS在三个领域的效果与共识类选择算法相当，在工程设计选择任务上较pass@1基线提升20%；iPF为步级重采样的扩展方案

summary_en.core_problem: Inference-Time Scaling (ITS) has only been viable in verifiable domains like math and coding with cheap ground truth access, and cannot be applied to tasks without low-cost verification or ground truth labels
summary_en.importance: Proposes the first verification-free ITS paradigm based on intrinsic sample statistics, expanding the applicable scope of test-time compute scaling, representing a methodological innovation
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces two methods: Intrinsic Selection (iS) ranks parallel samples using length-adjusted tail entropy without ground truth; Intrinsic Particle Filtering (iPF) extends this signal to step-level resampling for adaptive compute allocation
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated; available results show iS matches consensus-based selection performance across three domains and improves engineering design selection by 20% over pass@1 baselines, with iPF as a step-level resampling extension

recommendation.zh: 推理时缩放的适用边界被扩展到无验证的领域，长度调整尾部熵这个信号可以直接拿去做内部推理增强预训练的样本筛选 ablation
recommendation.en: This work extends inference-time scaling to unverifiable domains; the length-adjusted tail entropy signal can be directly tested in internal reasoning-enhanced pretraining sample filtering ablations

paper.title: The Routing Plateau: Understanding and Breaking the Accuracy Limits of LLM Routers
paper.abstract: LLM routing has become a popular approach to improve the cost-quality trade-off of LLM services by dynamically selecting a model for each query. Recent work has explored a broad range of routing methods, including clustering-based routers, learned classifiers, pairwise ranking, and confidence-based approaches. Our extensive study of 21 routing methods across five benchmarks reveals a consistent phenomenon that we call the routing plateau: many methods, including kNN, achieve very similar accurac

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 路由器在多模型选择中长期停留在相近精度区间、难以逼近 oracle 的问题，并解释这种上限从何而来。
summary.importance: 价值不在又提一个 router，而在于把“routing plateau”作为可复现现象系统化地测出来，并把瓶颈归因到 query-level 可预测性不足。这对做模型级联、test-time compute allocation、服务层 routing 的研究员有直接参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者系统比较 21 种路由方法在 5 个 benchmark 上的表现，覆盖聚类、kNN、分类器、pairwise ranking、confidence-based 等路线。核心分析是把路由失败拆成：方法学差异很小、都学到全局平均性能趋势、但抓不到实例级细粒度信号，因此在 hard queries 上集体失效。论文进一步研究如何突破 plateau，但摘要未给出完整方法细节。
summary.experiments: 实验规模是 21 个 routing 方法 × 5 个 benchmark 的系统评测。主要结论是大量方法包括 kNN 都收敛到狭窄性能带，且明显低于 oracle router；说明当前提升更多受限于可预测信号本身，而不是路由器头部形式。摘要未给出具体提升数字和所用底座模型名单。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why LLM routers for model selection saturate in a narrow accuracy band and fail to approach oracle routing.
summary_en.importance: Its value is not another router, but a clean empirical diagnosis of a reproducible 'routing plateau' and an attribution of the bottleneck to limited query-level predictability. This matters for cascades, test-time compute allocation, and serving-time routing.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors benchmark 21 routing methods across five benchmarks, spanning clustering, kNN, learned classifiers, pairwise ranking, and confidence-based approaches. The key analysis decomposes routing failure into a shared pattern: routers learn global average model-performance trends but miss fine-grained instance-specific signals, so they all fail on hard queries.
summary_en.experiments: The study is a broad evaluation over 21 routing methods and five benchmarks. The main result is that many methods, including kNN, converge to a narrow performance range far below an oracle router, suggesting the bottleneck lies more in available predictive signal than in the router head design. The abstract does not provide exact gains or the underlying model roster.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是负结果：别再把 router head 当主矛盾，先看 hard-query 可预测性；读实验总表和误差分解部分就够了。
recommendation.en: Read it for the negative result: router-head design is likely not the bottleneck; inspect the benchmark table and the hard-query error analysis.

paper.title: DyCon: Dynamic Reasoning Control via Evolving Difficulty Modeling
paper.abstract: Recent advances in Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) demonstrate remarkable performance improvements by iteratively reflecting, exploring, and executing complex tasks, yet suffer from inefficiencies due to redundant reasoning, known as "overthinking". Existing methods to mitigate this issue either rely on static difficulty estimates or require task-specific training, and thus fail to adapt to the dynamic complexity during reasoning. In this work, we empirically show that the problem difficulty evolv

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 LRM 推理阶段的“过度思考”控制问题，但切入点不是静态题目难度估计，也不是再训练一个停止策略，而是去建模“难度在推理过程中如何变化”。作者的核心观察是：同一道题在不同 reasoning step 上的有效难度并不固定；当推理路径持续朝正确方向分解问题时，后续难度会下降；当中间步骤偏航、引入无关反思或错误分支时，难度会维持高位甚至回升。现有方法大多只在样本级别做一次性难度判断，或者依赖人工阈值、外部判别器、SFT/RL 训练停止策略，因此很难对这种 step-level 的动态变化做出响应。DyCon 试图解决的就是：能否直接从模型自身隐藏表示里读出这种动态难度信号，并据此在推理时实时抑制无效反思、保留必要探索。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响不在于它提出了新的训练 recipe，而在于它提供了一个很具体的证据：大型推理模型的中间表征里，已经编码了可线性读出的“过程难度”信息。这件事有两层启发。第一，模型内部状态不仅携带语义内容，也携带与推理控制相关的元信息，且这种元信息未必需要额外训练就能利用。第二，推理控制未必都要靠 post-training 学一个 policy；有些控制信号可能已经在基座模型或 reasoning model 的表示空间里形成，只差一个轻量读出器和合适的干预接口。对做 pretrain 的人来说，这会引出更值得追问的问题：哪些训练目标、数据配比、推理蒸馏方式，会让这类可读出的控制信号更线性、更稳定、更可迁移。论文本身更偏 inference-time control，但它触到了“训练出的表示里到底隐含了什么可操作结构”这个更基础的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很克制，核心由两步组成。第一步是 difficulty probing。作者从 reasoning trace 的每个 step 提取 step-level embedding，然后在一个小规模 seen dataset 上拟合线性回归器，把 embedding 映射到 step-level difficulty。文中强调两点：一是 difficulty 不是题目初始难度，而是随推理过程演化的局部难度；二是这种信号在线性空间中已经相当可读，因此不需要复杂探针。第二步是 inference-time control。DyCon 不直接截断生成，也不训练停止头，而是动态调整一组 reflection-related keywords 的 logits。若当前估计难度低，说明问题已被充分分解或接近收敛，就下调反思类 token 的概率，减少“再想一步”“重新检查”等延长链路的倾向；若估计难度高，则上调这些 token 的 logits，鼓励继续探索。这个设计和直接 early stop 的区别在于，它保留了生成自由度，只是改变模型进入反思分支的倾向，因此更像软控制而不是硬裁剪。和依赖外部 verifier 的方法相比，它不需要额外大模型参与；和基于 certainty/entropy 的启发式方法相比，它不依赖手工阈值去解释所有任务；和 SFT/RL 学停止策略的方法相比，它避免了专门构造 termination supervision，也绕开了 mode collapse 与数据依赖问题。论文的关键主张不是“线性回归器很强”，而是“难度演化信号已经在 step embedding 里，且足够稳定到可以驱动控制”。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 4B 到 32B 的四个 LRM，并在 12 个 benchmark 上评估，任务类型包括数学推理、通用问答和代码。摘要与引言给出的主结果是：DyCon 能在不牺牲准确率的前提下缩短推理长度，且跨模型、跨任务有较强泛化。全文里最值得看的不是单一平均分，而是三类证据。第一类是表征分析：作者用图 2(a)(b) 展示 difficulty 随 step 演化的轨迹，以及 step embedding 与“真实难度”之间近似线性相关的现象，这是整篇方法成立的前提。第二类是效率—性能权衡：DyCon 相比原始 CoT 推理，应当在 token 数或 reasoning step 数上有明显下降，同时保持接近的 pass@1 / accuracy；如果某些简单任务上还能略升，通常意味着减少了无效反思带来的偏航。第三类是泛化与稳健性：线性回归器只在小规模 seen set 上拟合，但能迁移到未见 benchmark 和不同规模模型，这一点如果数字站得住，说明读出的不是数据集特定模式，而是更通用的内部控制信号。由于给出的全文片段未包含完整结果表，无法在这里可靠复述每个 benchmark 的具体提升幅度；阅读时应重点核对 token reduction、accuracy delta、不同 reflection keyword 集合的敏感性，以及 probe 训练数据规模缩小时性能如何退化。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，重点放在“现象是否可信”和“控制接口是否通用”。建议先看 Introduction 和 Fig. 2，确认作者对动态难度的定义、标注方式以及线性可读性的证据是否扎实。然后看方法部分里 step embedding 的抽取位置、difficulty regressor 的训练目标、reflection keywords 的具体集合与 logit 调整公式。最后看实验中的三组消融：1）如果把动态 difficulty 换成静态 sample-level difficulty，效果掉多少；2）如果不用 embedding probe，只用 entropy、self-consistency 或长度启发式，差距多大；3）不同模型、不同任务上控制强度是否需要重新调参。预计 25 到 35 分钟可以抓住主线；若要判断它对训练研究有没有更深启发，需要额外细看表征分析和失败案例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets overthinking in large reasoning models, but not through static difficulty prediction or a learned stopping policy. Its central claim is that task difficulty evolves during reasoning at the step level. When the chain of thought keeps decomposing the problem correctly, effective difficulty drops; when the model drifts into unhelpful reflection or wrong branches, difficulty stays high or even rises. Existing approaches usually estimate difficulty once per sample, rely on handcrafted confidence signals, or train a termination policy with SFT/RL. Those approaches do not react well to within-trace changes. DyCon asks whether this evolving difficulty is already encoded in the model’s hidden states and can be used online to suppress redundant reasoning while preserving necessary exploration.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining-oriented readers is not a new training recipe, but evidence that reasoning models internally encode a linearly decodable control signal about process difficulty. That matters for two reasons. First, intermediate representations appear to contain not only semantic content but also meta-level information relevant to reasoning control. Second, some inference-time control may not require additional policy training at all; the signal may already exist in the base representation space and only need a lightweight readout plus a suitable intervention interface. This is more of an inference-control paper than a pretraining paper, but it raises a useful upstream question: which pretraining objectives, data mixtures, or reasoning distillation procedures make such control-relevant latent variables more linear, stable, and transferable?
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two parts. First, difficulty probing: for each reasoning step, the authors extract a step-level embedding and fit a linear regressor on a small seen dataset to map that embedding to step-level difficulty. The important distinction is that this is not initial problem difficulty; it is local difficulty as the reasoning trajectory unfolds. The authors argue that this signal is already sufficiently linear in representation space, so a simple probe is enough. Second, inference-time control: instead of hard stopping generation or training a termination head, DyCon dynamically adjusts the logits of reflection-related keywords. If estimated difficulty is low, it downweights tokens associated with further reflection, encouraging convergence. If estimated difficulty is high, it upweights those tokens, encouraging deeper exploration. This is a soft intervention rather than a hard truncation. Compared with verifier-based methods, it avoids an extra model in the loop. Compared with entropy or certainty heuristics, it does not rely on manually chosen generic thresholds. Compared with SFT/RL stopping policies, it avoids specialized supervision and the associated data dependence. The real claim is not that a linear regressor is powerful, but that evolving difficulty is already encoded in step embeddings strongly enough to drive useful control.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans four reasoning models from 4B to 32B and 12 benchmarks covering math reasoning, general QA, and coding. The headline result is that DyCon reduces redundant reasoning without hurting accuracy, and generalizes across models and tasks. The most important evidence is likely in three buckets. First, representation analysis: Figure 2 reportedly shows both the temporal evolution of difficulty and an approximately linear relationship between step embeddings and ground-truth step difficulty. That is the empirical foundation of the method. Second, the efficiency–performance trade-off: DyCon should reduce reasoning tokens or steps relative to standard CoT while keeping pass@1 or accuracy close; gains on easier tasks would suggest that less overthinking also reduces derailment. Third, transfer and robustness: the regressor is fit on a small seen set but is claimed to transfer to unseen benchmarks and different model scales. If that holds numerically, it suggests the probe is reading a fairly general internal signal rather than a dataset-specific artifact. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the detailed result tables, so I would not state exact deltas without checking the paper directly. When reading, verify token reduction, accuracy change, sensitivity to the chosen reflection keyword set, and how performance degrades as probe-training data shrinks.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Focus on whether the phenomenon is real and whether the intervention is broadly usable. Start with the introduction and Figure 2 to understand how dynamic difficulty is defined and why the authors think it is linearly encoded. Then inspect the method details: where the step embeddings are taken from, how the difficulty labels are constructed, how the linear regressor is trained, which reflection keywords are controlled, and the exact logit adjustment rule. In the experiments, prioritize three ablations: replacing dynamic difficulty with static sample-level difficulty, replacing the probe with entropy or confidence heuristics, and checking how much retuning is needed across models and tasks. Around 25–35 minutes should be enough to capture the main idea. If you want the deeper research value, spend extra time on the representation analysis and failure cases.

recommendation.zh: 通过内部 embedding 动态感知难度来 early exit 推理过程，对理解 LRM 的内部状态和优化 test-time compute 有启发，值得关注其 embedding 分析部分。
recommendation.en: Early exiting the reasoning process by dynamically sensing difficulty via internal embeddings offers insights into LRM internal states and test-time compute optimization; the embedding analysis is worth reading.

paper.title: How Language Models Fail: Token-Level Signatures of Committed and Persistent Reasoning Failures
paper.abstract: Failures in language model reasoning emerge through distinct processes that leave identifiable signatures in the reasoning trace. We characterize these failures using token-level uncertainty signals, finding they arise through two empirically distinguishable processes. The first is committed failure, in which a model locks onto an incorrect reasoning path early in its trace. A central diagnostic signature is the commitment point, beyond which considering additional tokens hurt rather than help f

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 LLM 推理失败在生成过程中如何形成。它不只判断一个答案会不会错，而是用 token 级不确定性信号区分两类失败：早期走上错误路径的 committed failure，以及整段推理都保持不确定的 persistent uncertainty。
summary.importance: 对预训练和推理机制研究的价值在于，它提供了一种只依赖输出 log probabilities 的失败过程诊断方法。相比 probing activations 或干预内部表示，这种方法可用于只开放 token 概率的模型。它也解释了为什么 self-consistency 有时有效、有时会误导：如果模型早早锁定错误路径，多采样可能只是在重复同一个错误；如果模型的不确定性贯穿全程，多样采样和聚合才更可能有收益。这对训练 verifier、设计 process reward、选择推理时的采样策略都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把 chain-of-thought trace 看成一条不确定性轨迹。对每个 token 位置，论文使用 token 概率分布构造不确定性特征，例如 top-K 分布熵和 top-1 与 top-2 概率差。然后在不同前缀窗口上聚合这些信号，用它们预测最终答案是否错误。关键概念是 commitment point：某个前缀长度处，token 级不确定性对失败最有预测力；超过这个点后，继续加入后续 token 反而降低失败检测效果。若存在这种峰值，说明模型较早选定了推理路径，后续内容更多是沿既定路径展开。相反，如果预测力随 trace 长度单调增加，完整推理链最有信息量，则归为 persistent uncertainty。这个框架的优点是可证伪：不同失败模式会对“前缀是否优于全文”“self-consistency 是否有效”给出不同预测。
summary.experiments: 论文在 23 个 model-dataset 配置上验证，覆盖 5 个模型家族和 4 类推理任务。框架的可检验预测在 20/23 个配置中成立。实验关注单条 completion 的 token-level log probability，不要求访问模型权重或 hidden states。主要发现是：部分配置呈现 committed failure，早期窗口的失败检测效果强于完整 trace，并能找到 commitment point；另一部分配置呈现 persistent uncertainty，越长的 trace 越有助于区分成功和失败。论文还将该分类与 self-consistency 的效果关联起来：persistent uncertainty 场景更适合通过多样采样聚合缓解错误，而 committed failure 场景中 self-consistency 可能给错误答案更高置信度。作者也指出该方法需要适中的失败率；如果任务过易或过难，分类信号会不稳定。闭源 API 的 log probability 可用性也会限制适用范围。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议约 20 分钟。先看引言中 committed failure 与 persistent uncertainty 的例子，理解两类失败为何需要不同检测策略。方法部分重点看 early window、token uncertainty features 和 commitment point 的定义。实验部分优先看 23 个配置中哪些属于 committed failure，哪些属于 persistent uncertainty，以及这些分类如何预测 self-consistency 的收益。若关注 verifier 或 process reward，可以进一步看他们怎样用单条 trace 的 token 概率做失败检测；这比只用最终答案置信度更接近过程监督需要的信号。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how reasoning failures form during generation, rather than only whether the final answer is wrong. It distinguishes two failure processes: committed failure, where the model locks onto a wrong path early, and persistent uncertainty, where uncertainty remains informative throughout the reasoning trace.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance for pretraining and reasoning research is that the method diagnoses failure dynamics using only token-level log probabilities. It does not require hidden states, probes, or model-weight access, so it can apply to models where only output probabilities are exposed. The distinction also explains why self-consistency is uneven: it helps when uncertainty persists across completions, but can reinforce a wrong answer when the model has already committed to an incorrect path. This is useful for verifier design, process reward modeling, and inference-time decisions about when to sample more.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework treats a chain-of-thought as an uncertainty trajectory. At each token position, it computes uncertainty features from the next-token distribution, including top-K entropy and the margin between the top two token probabilities. These features are aggregated over prefixes of the trace and used to predict whether the final extracted answer is incorrect. The central object is the commitment point: the prefix length at which token-level uncertainty is most predictive of failure. If adding later tokens hurts failure detection, the model is interpreted as having already chosen a reasoning path, with later text mostly downstream of that choice. If predictive power improves monotonically as more of the trace is included, the failure mode is persistent uncertainty. The design is useful because it yields falsifiable predictions about prefix informativeness and the expected value of self-consistency.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates 23 model-dataset configurations across five model families and four reasoning domains. Its predictions hold in 20 of the 23 configurations. The experiments use log probabilities from a single completion, without access to internal activations. Some configurations show committed failure: an early window predicts failure better than the full trace, revealing a measurable commitment point. Others show persistent uncertainty: the full trace is the best signal, and uncertainty accumulates across the reasoning process. The paper also links these modes to self-consistency. Multi-sample aggregation is more useful under persistent uncertainty, while committed failure can make self-consistency confidently repeat the same wrong path. The method is less reliable when failure rates are too low or too high, and closed-API restrictions on log probabilities can limit coverage.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 20 minutes. Start with the examples of committed failure and persistent uncertainty in the introduction. Then read the definitions of early windows, token-level uncertainty features, and the commitment point. In the experiments, focus on which configurations fall into each failure mode and how that classification predicts the behavior of self-consistency. For work on verifiers or process supervision, the most relevant part is the use of a single trace’s token probabilities as a process-level failure signal, rather than relying only on final-answer confidence.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改训练 recipe，但会改你对 test-time scaling 的直觉：有些错是早早锁死，继续采样只是在放大错误；先看 commitment point 定义和 20/23 的复现结果。
recommendation.en: It does not change pretraining directly, but it should update your intuition about test-time scaling: some failures are committed early, so more sampling just amplifies the wrong path; read the commitment-point definition and the 20/23 replication result.

paper.title: Thinking Past the Answer: Evaluating Harmful Overthinking in Large Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) improve performance by generating explicit intermediate reasoning traces through increased test-time compute, yet the assumption that longer reasoning is consistently beneficial remains under-examined. While recent evidence shows that additional reasoning can lead models to overthink, we ask: "Once a model has reached the correct answer, does further reasoning refine the solution, or deviate from it?" To study the dynamics after correctness, we introduce a prefix-le

summary.core_problem: 论文要回答：在大推理模型已经得到正确答案之后，继续增加 reasoning token 究竟是无害冗余，还是会把正确轨迹带偏。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测协议而不是新模型。它把“overthinking”从笼统现象拆成 prefix-level 的轨迹稳定性问题，能更干净地测 test-time compute 何时开始伤害答案质量，这对推理模型评估和后训练信号设计都有价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 prefix-level trajectory evaluation protocol，以 reasoning sufficiency 为锚点，先定义模型首次生成正确答案所需的最小推理预算，再观察后续继续推理时轨迹是否保持正确。由此区分 verbose overthinking（冗长但无害）与 harmful overthinking（继续推理后反而偏离正确答案）。摘要还说明他们从多模态 benchmark 出发做分析。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模，但结论是：许多被视为高推理需求的样本，实际只需很少推理就能首次答对；继续推理并不总是提升，反而会在不少样本上破坏已正确的轨迹。由于给出的主要是评测现象而非训练方法，适合关注 protocol、分桶方式和错误类型统计。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Trento。不是头部实验室的大规模技术报告，但问题设定抓得准：它测的是“正确之后还会不会自我破坏”，这比只看最终 pass@1 更贴近 LRM 的真实 failure mode。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what happens after a large reasoning model has already reached the correct answer: does extra reasoning help, or does it destabilize an otherwise correct trajectory?
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation protocol rather than a new model. By reframing overthinking as a prefix-level trajectory stability problem, it offers a cleaner way to measure when additional test-time compute starts hurting answer quality, which matters for reasoning-model evaluation and post-training signal design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce a prefix-level trajectory evaluation protocol grounded in reasoning sufficiency: they define the minimum reasoning budget needed for the model to first produce the correct answer, then inspect whether continued reasoning preserves or destroys correctness. This separates verbose overthinking (redundant but harmless) from harmful overthinking (continued reasoning causes deviation). The analysis starts from multimodal benchmarks.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, but reports that many instances commonly treated as reasoning-intensive actually require surprisingly little reasoning to first become correct, and that further reasoning often fails to improve and can even corrupt already-correct trajectories. This is primarily an evaluation paper, so the protocol and error breakdown matter more than raw leaderboard numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Trento. This is not a major lab scaling report, but the question is well chosen: it measures whether a reasoning model self-corrupts after becoming correct, which is more informative than final pass@1 alone.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改模型，但会改你看 test-time scaling 的口径；重点读 protocol 定义和错误分桶，别只看最终准确率曲线。
recommendation.en: It does not change the model, but it should change how you read test-time scaling results; focus on the protocol and failure buckets, not just final accuracy curves.

paper.title: Inference-Time Scaling for Joint Audio-Video Generation
paper.abstract: Joint audio-video generation aims to synthesize realistic audio-video pairs that are both semantically aligned with text prompts and precisely synchronized. While existing joint audio-video generation models often require substantial training resources to improve fidelity, Inference-Time Scaling (ITS) has recently emerged as a promising training-free alternative in single-modality domains. However, extending ITS from a single modality to multimodal domains is non-trivial, as it requires balancin

summary.core_problem: 解决联合音视频生成中，如何在不增加训练成本的前提下，通过推理时扩展同时提升语义一致性、视听同步和整体质量。
summary.importance: 这是多模态生成里的推理时扩展研究。价值不在基座预训练本身，而在于把单模态 ITS 扩展到异构多目标场景，并讨论 verifier hacking 与目标冲突，对后续统一生成模型的 test-time compute 分配有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者系统研究 joint audio-video generation 的 inference-time scaling，提出多 verifier 框架而不是单一目标引导；先分析单目标引导会带来的非对称 trade-off 和 verifier hacking，再寻找更平衡的 verifier 组合，并设计有效聚合多 verifier 信号的策略，以在推理时优化多种质量维度。
summary.experiments: 摘要称这是首个针对联合音视频生成 ITS 的系统研究，实验比较单 verifier 与多 verifier 组合，并在多项质量维度上取得更平衡的改进。但未在摘要中给出具体模型规模、数据集和数值提升。整体更像 test-time optimization study，而非训练范式论文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 KAIST。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to improve semantic alignment, audio-video synchronization, and overall quality in joint audio-video generation via inference-time scaling without extra training.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal generation paper on test-time scaling. Its value is not in pretraining itself, but in extending single-modality ITS to heterogeneous multi-objective generation and explicitly discussing verifier hacking and objective conflict, which is relevant to compute allocation in unified generative systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors present a systematic study of inference-time scaling for joint audio-video generation and argue that a multi-verifier framework is necessary instead of single-objective guidance. They analyze asymmetric trade-offs and verifier hacking under single verifiers, identify better verifier combinations, and design an aggregation strategy for multiple verifier signals at inference time.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract positions this as the first comprehensive ITS study for joint audio-video generation. Experiments compare single-verifier and multi-verifier setups and report more balanced gains across quality dimensions, though the abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, or exact margins. Overall this is a test-time optimization study rather than a training-paradigm paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from KAIST.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 不直接相关，但多目标 verifier 冲突这件事讲得对；只看 verifier hacking 分析和组合消融即可。
recommendation.en: Not directly a pretraining paper, but it gets the multi-objective verifier conflict story right; read only the verifier-hacking analysis and ablations.

institutions: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology

paper.title: MOSAIC: Efficient Mixture-of-Agent Scheduling via Adaptive Aggregation and Inference Concurrency
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) systems improve reasoning accuracy by routing each query to multiple expert LLMs and aggregating their outputs. Efficiently executing this workload on limited GPU resources has bottlenecks. Skill-based routing creates skewed expert demand, and combining instruction-tuned LLMs with long-reasoning models results in extreme variability in generation lengths. Consequently, traditional scheduling strategies suffer from significant GPU idling and throughput collapse due to load

summary.core_problem: 解决 Mixture-of-Agents 推理系统在有限 GPU 上因专家负载倾斜和生成长度差异导致的吞吐下降与资源空转问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个面向多模型协同推理系统的工程方法工作，贡献主要在调度与系统优化，而不是基座模型训练本身；对研究员的价值在于理解多专家推理 workload 的真实瓶颈，以及如何把模型异质性显式纳入调度。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由两部分组成：一是基于离线 profile 成本的 ILP 调度器，联合优化专家放置与每个 worker 的 prompt 分配，对重型 reasoning expert 做副本扩展、对轻量 expert 做固定绑定；二是 confidence-aware adaptive aggregation，根据专家间一致性跳过昂贵的最终聚合模型，从而减少不必要的二次推理开销。
summary.experiments: 摘要可见实验在 4-GPU 环境下进行，重点评估吞吐、GPU 利用率和聚合开销，而非模型能力上限。基线应是传统静态或负载均衡调度策略，以及始终调用最终 aggregator 的标准 MoA pipeline。论文主张在资源受限场景下显著缓解 GPU idle 和 throughput collapse，但摘要未给出具体数值，需看正文表格确认收益是否主要来自跳过 aggregator 而非更优调度本身。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 UC Irvine、USC 和 Intel。Intel 参与说明这篇更偏系统与部署视角，而非基础建模。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles throughput collapse and GPU under-utilization in Mixture-of-Agents inference caused by skewed expert demand and highly variable generation lengths under limited GPU budgets.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a systems paper on scheduling for multi-LLM reasoning pipelines rather than a foundation-model training paper. Its value to pretraining researchers is indirect: it exposes the real workload pathologies created by heterogeneous experts and long-reasoning models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two components: an ILP-based scheduler built from offline cost profiles to jointly optimize expert placement and per-worker prompt assignment, and a confidence-aware adaptive aggregation scheme that skips the expensive final aggregator when expert agreement is high.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, experiments are run in a 4-GPU setup and focus on throughput, GPU utilization, and aggregation overhead rather than raw model quality. Baselines are likely conventional scheduling policies and standard MoA pipelines that always invoke the final aggregator. The claimed gains need to be checked in the full paper to see whether they come mostly from better scheduling or simply from bypassing the aggregator.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from UC Irvine, USC, and Intel. The Intel involvement suggests a deployment/systems orientation rather than core modeling.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不深，但如果你在看 MoA 或 test-time compute 系统化落地，只看调度建模和跳过 aggregator 的收益拆解；别把它当成能力方法。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but if you care about MoA or test-time compute systems, read the scheduling formulation and the ablation on skipping the aggregator; this is a systems win, not a capability breakthrough.

paper.title: Economy of Minds: Emerging Multi-Agent Intelligence with Economic Interactions

summary.core_problem: 探索通过经济交互机制组织多个智能体，观察是否能产生更强的多智能体协作或集体智能。
summary.importance: 这是通用 multi-agent 交互机制方向，和预训练的关系是间接的：它可能影响 test-time compute、agent 协作协议和后训练任务设计，但不是基座训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 元数据未提供摘要；从题目看，论文可能构建市场、交易、激励或资源分配式交互，让多个 LLM agent 在经济规则下分工、竞争或协作。需要确认机制是否比普通 debate、role-play 或 committee voting 更干净。
summary.experiments: 未提供摘要，无法确认任务类型、agent 数量、底座模型、交互轮数、成本控制和相对 baseline。关键实验应是同等 token budget 下经济交互是否优于普通多 agent 协作。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息包含 Kempner Institute；无法从给定信息确认作者团队代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper explores whether economic interaction mechanisms among multiple agents can produce stronger collective or collaborative intelligence.
summary_en.importance: This is a general multi-agent interaction paper. Its link to pretraining research is indirect: it may inform test-time compute allocation, collaboration protocols, or post-training task design, but it is not a foundation-model training method.
summary_en.technical_approach: No abstract is available. From the title, the work likely uses market-like incentives, trading, resource allocation, or economic games to structure LLM-agent interaction. The key question is whether this is cleaner than debate, role-play, or committee voting.
summary_en.experiments: The provided metadata does not specify task suites, number of agents, base models, interaction rounds, cost accounting, or baselines. The useful experiment would compare against standard multi-agent collaboration under the same token budget.
summary_en.authors_note: The metadata lists the Kempner Institute; no further team background can be verified.

recommendation.zh: 先看是否做了等 token 预算对照；没有成本归一化，所谓集体智能多半只是多花推理算力。
recommendation.en: Check for equal-token comparisons first; without cost normalization, the claimed collective intelligence may just be extra inference compute.

paper.title: Streaming Communication in Multi-Agent Reasoning
paper.abstract: Multi-agent reasoning systems adopt a "generate-then-transfer" paradigm that forces end-to-end latency to scale linearly with pipeline depth. We introduce StreamMA, a multi-agent reasoning system that streams each reasoning step to downstream agents as soon as it is generated, pipelining adjacent agents and thus reducing latency. Surprisingly, this pipelining also improves effectiveness: because multi-step reasoning quality is non-uniform and early steps are more reliable than later ones, workin

summary.core_problem: 解决多智能体推理系统中“先完整生成再传递”导致的端到端延迟随链路深度线性增长，以及后期低质量推理步骤污染下游决策的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 系统方法加一点理论分析。对基座预训练研究员，直接价值有限，但它提出了一个值得注意的判断：推理链并非越完整越好，早期 token/步骤可能比完整 CoT 更可靠，这对 test-time compute 分配和 verifier 设计有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 StreamMA，让上游 agent 在生成每一步推理时就流式传给下游 agent，形成流水线并行，而不是等完整答案后再交接。论文还给出 stream、serial、single 三种协议的闭式分析，推导效果排序、速度上界和成本比，并在链式、树式、图式三类拓扑上验证。
summary.experiments: 在 8 个涵盖数学、科学和代码的推理基准上，使用 Claude Opus 4.6 和 GPT-5.4 两个前沿模型，比较 streaming、serial 和 single-agent 协议。摘要称 StreamMA 同时提升速度和效果，但未给出具体增益数字；实验覆盖多拓扑是亮点，说明结论不只依赖单一 pipeline 结构。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the latency of multi-agent reasoning systems under the generate-then-transfer paradigm, where end-to-end delay scales with pipeline depth and late low-quality reasoning steps can mislead downstream agents.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent systems paper with some analytical framing. Its direct value to pretraining is limited, but one claim is worth noting: a full reasoning chain is not always better, and early reasoning steps may be more reliable than the complete CoT. That matters for test-time compute allocation and verifier design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes StreamMA, where each agent streams intermediate reasoning steps to downstream agents as soon as they are generated, enabling pipelining instead of waiting for a full response. It also provides a closed-form analysis comparing stream, serial, and single protocols, deriving effectiveness ordering, speedup bounds, and cost ratios, and tests the method on chain, tree, and graph topologies.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments span eight reasoning benchmarks in math, science, and code, using Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-5.4. The paper compares streaming, serial, and single-agent protocols. The abstract claims both speed and effectiveness gains, though exact numbers are not given; the multi-topology setup is a strength because the result is not tied to one pipeline structure.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 不直接，但它在挑战“完整 CoT 一定更好”这个默认前提；只看理论部分和误差随步骤恶化的实证就够了。
recommendation.en: Not directly pretraining-related, but it challenges the default assumption that fuller CoT is always better; read the theory and the evidence that later steps degrade quality.

paper.title: When Parallelism Pays Off: Cohesion-Aware Task Partitioning for Multi-Agent Coding
paper.abstract: Multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) systems offer a way to decompose complex tasks, such as coding, through parallelization and context isolation. However, adding agents in practice introduces inter-agent communication overhead, which incurs extra cost and can sometimes offset the efficiency gains. We formalize multi-agent orchestration as a graph partitioning problem that captures the communication-to-computation trade-off: task decomposition can shorten critical-path computation, but cross-

summary.core_problem: 多智能体 coding 的并行化并不必然带来更快或更便宜：agent 越多，跨 agent 的上下文传输越频繁，prompt 变长、解码变慢、成本上升，还可能因为信息不同步导致质量下降。论文要解决的是：如何在“并行带来的关键路径缩短”和“通信带来的额外开销”之间做可计算的权衡，并据此自动把仓库级软件工程任务划分给多个 agent。
summary.importance: 更偏 agent 系统与推理效率，而不是预训练/训练动态。对基座研究的间接价值在于：它把 token 级通信成本显式纳入目标函数，提供了一种把 LLM inference 成本模型化的方法；如果你在做多 agent 训练数据合成、或想评估并行 orchestration 的真实收益，这套通信-计算权衡的形式化有参考意义。但它不触及 tokenizer、scaling、优化器或预训练目标，因此与核心 pretrain 研究关联度有限。
summary.technical_approach:
把多 agent 编排形式化为图划分问题。
- 用静态分析把代码仓库表示为带权有向依赖图：点权表示每个文件的生成/修改计算成本，边权表示跨分区时需要传递的上下文成本（token 传输带来的推理开销）。
- 目标函数同时考虑关键路径（critical-path）计算成本与跨分区通信成本。
- 由于依赖图有向、异质且存在 hub 文件，作者先隔离 hub，再用 Infomap（基于随机游走描述长度的社区发现）做划分，作为“跨分区信息流”代理；之后做后处理以恢复簇内并行度。
- 执行阶段用 dependency-aware 的 list scheduling，在不引入全局同步屏障的情况下暴露并行性。
summary.experiments:
在两个仓库级 coding benchmark（DevEval、CodeProjectEval）上评测 28 个真实项目。
- DevEval：相对顺序版本，平均 pass rate 56.8%→68.1%，1.81× 加速，成本 -28%。
- CodeProjectEval：pass rate +14.0%，2.10× 加速，成本 -35%。
作者还对比了 file-parallel 系统与 Claude Code 的 Agent Teams，指出在依赖更密的项目上，朴素并行要么增成本不增质，要么提速但掉质量；Co-Coder 的收益在这类项目更明显。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（20–30 分钟）：
- Introduction + Figure 1：看清他们观察到的“加 agent 反而更慢/更贵/更差”的现象与动机。
- Problem Formulation：重点看图的点权/边权如何定义，以及目标函数如何把 critical path 与 communication 合在一起。
- 方法部分关于 hub isolation + Infomap 的段落：这是与常规图划分不同的关键工程选择。
- 结果表：确认 speedup、cost、pass rate 的同时改进是否在同一预算/同一模型设置下成立。

如果你的关注点是 pretrain，这篇更适合作为“推理系统成本建模”的参考，而不是训练方法参考。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-agent coding promises parallel speedups, but in practice additional agents introduce communication overhead: cross-agent dependencies require transferring context tokens, inflating prompts, decoding time, and cost, sometimes hurting quality due to fragmented or stale context. The paper addresses how to partition repository-level tasks across agents by explicitly optimizing the communication-to-computation trade-off rather than assuming more parallelism is always better.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an agent orchestration / inference-systems paper, not a pretraining or optimization paper. Its indirect relevance to foundation-model research is the explicit modeling of token-level communication cost as part of an objective, which can inform how to evaluate multi-agent pipelines used for data generation or tool-augmented workflows. It does not contribute to tokenizer design, scaling laws, training dynamics, or pretraining objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Co-Coder formulates orchestration as weighted directed graph partitioning plus dependency-aware scheduling.
- Build a repository dependency DAG via static analysis.
- Vertex weights approximate per-file generation cost; edge weights approximate cross-agent context transfer cost when dependencies cross partitions.
- Optimize a joint objective combining critical-path compute time and inter-partition communication.
- Because code graphs are directed and hub-dominated, the method isolates hub files, then applies Infomap community detection (minimizing random-walk description length) as a surrogate for cross-partition information flow.
- A post-processing step recovers latent intra-cluster parallelism, and execution uses a dependency-aware list scheduler to avoid global synchronization barriers.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated on 28 real-world projects across DevEval and CodeProjectEval.
- DevEval: pass rate improves from 56.8% to 68.1% vs a sequential baseline, with 1.81× speedup and 28% cost reduction.
- CodeProjectEval: +14.0% pass rate, 2.10× speedup, 35% cost reduction.
Comparisons include file-parallel baselines and Claude Code with Agent Teams, highlighting that naive parallelism can either inflate cost without quality gains or trade quality for speed, especially on dependency-dense projects.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Intro + Figure 1: the empirical motivation—why more agents can be worse.
- Problem formulation: how vertex/edge weights are defined and how the objective combines critical path and communication.
- Method details on hub isolation + Infomap: the main nontrivial design choice.
- Results tables: verify that speed, cost, and pass rate improvements are measured under matched settings.

If your focus is pretraining, treat this as a reference for cost-aware multi-agent inference modeling rather than a training recipe.

recommendation.zh: 多 agent 并行不是免费午餐；看图划分建模和 Pareto 曲线即可，对 test-time compute 编排有旁证。
recommendation.en: Multi-agent parallelism is not free; read the graph-partition model and Pareto curves as evidence for test-time compute orchestration.

paper.title: Diversity Matters: Revisiting Test-Time Compute in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Test-time compute (TTC) strategies have emerged as a lightweight approach to boost reasoning in large language models (LLMs). However, their application and benefits for vision-language models (VLMs) remain underexplored. We present a systematic study of TTC across seven VLMs and six benchmarks, specifically analyzing feature-based scoring and majority voting methods. We find that feature heuristics fail and voting yields only modest gains in single-model settings. We theoretically show that thi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是：LLM 里常见的 test-time compute（TTC）策略，到了视觉语言模型里为什么效果不稳定、提升有限，以及在什么条件下它才真正有用。全文的关键结论不是“多采样+投票能提升 VLM 推理”，而是相反：单模型场景里，TTC 的主要瓶颈是输出之间缺少有效多样性。VLM 的错误往往先出在视觉感知或视觉-语言对齐阶段，这类错误会在多次采样中高度相关，因此仅靠随机采样得到的多条推理链，通常不能像纯文本 LLM 那样带来明显收益。作者进一步把问题从经验现象推进到统计依赖层面：当多个候选答案高度相关时，majority voting 的收益会快速衰减；而真正能带来增益的是跨模型的结构性差异，而不是单模型内部的采样噪声。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接价值不在于提出了一个新的 VLM 推理技巧，而在于它把“test-time scaling 是否有效”这件事拆开了。对预训练研究员来说，最有信息量的点有三个。第一，TTC 的上限受模型输出相关性约束，这提示单模型 test-time scaling 的收益和预训练阶段学到的表征多样性、校准质量、感知误差结构有关。第二，视觉任务里语言表面特征不能可靠代理正确性，这对 reward modeling、verifier 设计、以及基于文本启发式的 reranking 都是个提醒。第三，作者提出的 ETTC 在多模型集成里优于简单投票，说明如果不同模型的能力和置信度分布不一致，聚合规则必须显式利用这种异质性，而不是把所有样本当成同分布独立票源。量级上，这更像一篇把现象讲清楚、给出可操作聚合准则的分析型工作，而不是改变训练范式的论文。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上分三层。第一层是系统性实证。作者在 7 个开源 VLM、6 个 benchmark 上比较两类 TTC：一类是 response selection，也就是基于特征的 best-of-N 选择；另一类是 confidence-based aggregation，也就是 self-consistency / majority voting。实验设置区分了是否使用 CoT，并分别考察单模型多次采样和多模型 ensemble。结果显示，基于语言风格、长度、置信措辞等 feature heuristic 的方法在 VLM 上基本失效，因为这些文本信号并不对应视觉理解是否正确；majority voting 只有在 CoT 条件下才有小幅稳定收益，不带 CoT 时几乎无效。

第二层是理论分析。作者把 voting 的收益写成与预测间依赖性相关的函数，核心结论是：如果多个样本不是近似独立，而是带有较强正相关，那么投票无法像经典 self-consistency 直觉那样显著降低错误率。单模型多次采样时，所有输出共享同一个视觉编码器、同一套对齐误差和相近的解码偏置，所以相关性天然较高。这个分析解释了为什么“多采样”在 VLM 上通常不如在文本推理里有效。

第三层是方法设计。作者提出 ETTC（Entropy-based TTC）。它不是简单统计最终答案频次，而是先在每个模型内部基于多次响应形成答案分布，再用熵衡量该分布的集中程度，选择熵更低、也就是内部更一致的预测。这样做的动机是：在多模型集成里，不同模型能力不同，弱模型数量多时，majority voting 可能让它们凭相关错误压过强模型；而 ETTC 用“分布是否尖锐”来近似模型在当前样本上的可靠性。作者还说明，在单模型场景下 ETTC 会退化为 majority voting，因此它兼容已有 self-consistency 设定；但在多模型场景下，它能利用模型间置信差异。与传统加权投票不同，这里不需要额外训练一个 judge 或 reward model，仍属于 inference-only 策略。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文内容看，实验覆盖 7 个开源 VLM 和 6 个 benchmark，并设计了两种多模型配置：一类是相近规模但不同家族的 cross-family ensemble，包括 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct、LLaMA-3.2-11B-Vision、Gemma-3-12B-it、Pixtral-12B-2409；另一类是同家族不同规模的 same-family ensemble。作者重点报告了几类结果。

第一，feature-based selection 基本不能提升准确率，说明在 VLM 中，文本表面特征不是可靠的正确性信号。第二，单模型 majority voting 只有 modest but consistent gains，而且依赖 CoT；没有 CoT 时，聚合几乎没有收益。第三，作者通过依赖性分析和实证统计表明，模型输出存在弱但非零的相关性，这已经足以显著压缩 voting 的理论收益。第四，在多模型集成中，ETTC 稳定优于标准 majority voting，并且在若干设置下超过 ensemble 中最强的单个模型，这一点是全文最重要的经验结果，因为它说明小模型并非只能拖后腿，只要聚合方式能识别样本级可靠性，小模型可以补足大模型的盲区。

受限于当前提供的全文片段，具体 benchmark 名称、各表格中的精确提升幅度、采样次数 N、以及 ETTC 相对 voting 的逐项数字没有完整展开。如果后续拿到附录，建议重点补齐：单模型 CoT / no-CoT 下的绝对增益，dependency 指标的定义与估计方式，以及 ETTC 在 cross-family 与 same-family 两种 ensemble 上的差异。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不需要逐行推公式。建议先看 Introduction，抓住作者真正想回答的问题：不是“怎么把 VLM 的 TTC 做得更花”，而是“为什么它通常不太灵”。然后看实验设置部分，确认单模型与多模型、CoT 与非 CoT 的区分。接着重点看第 4 节关于 prediction dependency 的理论和实证，这部分是全文最有价值的地方，因为它把经验现象和统计结构连起来了。最后看第 5 节 ETTC：关注它和 majority voting 的关系、何时退化为同一方法、为什么在异质 ensemble 中更合理。

如果时间有限，优先看：1）feature heuristic 失败的表；2）single-model voting 收益很小的主结果；3）dependency 分析图；4）ETTC 超过 best single model 的结果。预计 30 到 45 分钟可以抓住主要信息。若要深挖，建议思考两个延伸问题：一是这种“相关错误限制 TTC”的现象是否也出现在纯文本多样本推理，只是程度更轻；二是能否把 ETTC 的思想前移到训练阶段，做样本级校准或多专家协同训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise question: why do test-time compute (TTC) methods, which often help LLM reasoning, bring only limited gains in vision-language models, and when do they actually work? The main answer is not “sample more and vote.” It is that single-model TTC in VLMs is bottlenecked by insufficient prediction diversity. Many VLM failures originate in visual perception or vision-language alignment, and these errors remain highly correlated across repeated samples from the same model. As a result, stochastic decoding alone does not create the kind of independent evidence that makes self-consistency effective in text-only settings. The paper then formalizes this through prediction dependence: as outputs become more correlated, the benefit of majority voting collapses. Real gains come from structural diversity across models, not from randomness within one model.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining-oriented readers, the value is mostly diagnostic rather than algorithmic. The paper separates the question of test-time scaling into components that matter upstream. First, TTC gains are constrained by output correlation, which suggests a link to representation diversity, calibration, and the structure of perception errors learned during pretraining. Second, textual surface cues are poor proxies for correctness in VLMs, which is relevant for reward modeling, verifier design, and heuristic reranking. Third, the proposed ETTC method shows that once model capabilities are heterogeneous, aggregation must account for that heterogeneity instead of treating all votes as exchangeable. This is a useful lesson for ensemble design, verifier-free reranking, and possibly multi-expert training. The contribution is best read as a careful analysis plus a practical aggregation rule, not as a new training paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has three technical layers. First, it runs a systematic empirical study over seven open-source VLMs and six benchmarks. It compares two TTC families: response selection methods based on handcrafted textual features, and confidence-based aggregation methods such as majority voting. The experiments separate chain-of-thought from non-CoT prompting, and also distinguish repeated sampling from a single model versus multi-model ensembles. The empirical result is clear: feature heuristics fail in VLMs because linguistic style, confidence wording, or response length do not reliably track visual correctness. Majority voting gives only small but consistent gains, and only when CoT is used.

Second, the paper provides a dependence-based analysis of voting. The key point is that voting assumes some degree of diversity across samples. If predictions are positively correlated, repeated samples do not reduce error nearly as much as the independent-vote intuition would suggest. In VLMs, repeated outputs from one model share the same visual encoder, alignment biases, and decoding tendencies, so the resulting dependence is structurally hard to avoid. This explains why single-model TTC is weak.

Third, the paper proposes ETTC, an entropy-based aggregation rule. Instead of simply counting final answers across all models, ETTC first forms an answer distribution within each model from multiple responses, then uses the entropy of that distribution as a confidence signal. Lower entropy means the model is more internally consistent on that example. This matters in heterogeneous ensembles: plain majority voting can let several weaker but correlated models dominate a stronger one, while ETTC uses confidence concentration to prioritize more reliable predictions. In the single-model case, ETTC reduces to majority voting, so it is backward compatible with standard self-consistency. Unlike learned judges or reward models, ETTC remains inference-only.
summary_en.experiments:
