From the provided full text, the evaluation covers seven open-source VLMs and six benchmarks, with two ensemble settings: a cross-family setup using similarly sized but architecturally different models, and a same-family setup with different scales. The cross-family set explicitly includes Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, LLaMA-3.2-11B-Vision, Gemma-3-12B-it, and Pixtral-12B-2409.

The main findings are: feature-based response selection does not improve accuracy; single-model majority voting yields only modest gains and only under CoT prompting; without CoT, aggregation is largely ineffective. The paper also measures nonzero prediction dependence across outputs, which is enough to explain the weak returns from voting. In multi-model ensembles, ETTC consistently beats standard majority voting and in some cases surpasses the best individual model in the ensemble. That last result is the most important empirical point: smaller models can help stronger ones if the aggregation rule can exploit sample-level reliability instead of flattening all votes.

The excerpt does not include the full benchmark list, exact gains, sample counts, or all table values. If reading the full paper, the numbers worth extracting are: absolute gains of voting with and without CoT, the exact dependence metric and how it is estimated, and the margin by which ETTC improves over majority voting in cross-family versus same-family ensembles.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction to get the real question right: the paper is less about making VLM TTC more elaborate, and more about explaining why it is usually weak. Then check the setup section to understand the single-model versus multi-model split, and the role of CoT. After that, go directly to the dependence analysis in Section 4. That is the conceptual center of the paper. Finally, read the ETTC section and focus on when it differs from majority voting, why it collapses to voting in the single-model case, and why it is better suited to heterogeneous ensembles.

If time is limited, prioritize four items: the table showing feature heuristics fail, the main result that single-model voting helps only a little, the dependence analysis figures, and the ensemble result where ETTC beats the best single model. Around 30 to 45 minutes should be enough to capture the main message. A deeper follow-up question is whether the same “correlated error limits TTC” story also applies to text-only reasoning, just less severely, and whether the ETTC idea could be moved into training as a calibration or expert-coordination objective.

recommendation.zh: 测试时计算的多样性瓶颈结论可迁移到LLM推理增强，只看§3的理论分析与Fig 2多样性-增益对应关系即可。
recommendation.en: The diversity bottleneck conclusion for test-time compute can be transferred to LLM inference enhancement, only read §3 theoretical analysis and Fig 2 diversity-gain correlation.

paper.title: Chain-of-Thought and Compressed Looped Transformers: A Memory-Budget Separation
paper.abstract: Chain-of-thought prompting and looped Transformers both give a fixed model more test-time computation, but they differ in what they remember. Chain-of-thought stores intermediate state in generated tokens that remain in the context, whereas a looped Transformer carries state through recurrent hidden activations. We argue that this persistent mutable memory is a central resource for test-time reasoning.   We compare three memory regimes, the compressed latent loop, the full sequence-state loop, a

summary.core_problem: 思维链（CoT）提示与循环Transformer（looped Transformer）是两种为固定模型增加测试时计算量的方法，但现有循环Transformer研究大多默认循环状态为完整序列（内存充足场景），未将「计算量」与「跨步骤持久可变内存」拆分为独立的资源维度，也未明确内存受限场景下压缩状态循环Transformer与CoT的推理能力边界。
summary.importance: 建立了测试时推理的资源度量框架，将持久可变性内存作为独立资源与计算量拆分，为循环类LLM推理架构的设计提供明确约束：压缩潜循环的表达能力上限由持久循环状态的大小决定，单纯增加迭代次数无法提升需要大串行内存的任务的推理能力。
summary.technical_approach: 首先为三类推理范式定义了统一的内存预算计算公式：压缩潜循环的持久内存M = s*d*p（s为循环槽数，d为隐层宽度，p为激活位精度）；全序列状态循环的M = n*d*p（n为输入长度）；CoT草稿板的M = Θ(ℓ log|Σ|)（ℓ为生成的CoT token数）。随后通过计算复杂度理论证明：当压缩循环的持久状态相对于输入长度为polylog量级时，哪怕迭代次数达到准多项式规模，该模型仍属于DSPACE(polylog n)复杂度类。在「P不包含于DSPACE(polylog n)」的标准理论假设下，这类压缩循环无法解决P完全的串行任务，而多项式长度的CoT可以。该边界仅适用于压缩循环，全序列状态循环的内存随输入长度线性增长，属于大内存场景，不受此限制。
summary.experiments: 工作以理论推导为主，仅设计了两个受控的有限规模探测实验验证直觉：指针追赶任务的循环槽数扫描、联想回忆任务的状态大小扫描，同时结合已有数独任务中内存token的相关结果作为外部佐证，未开展大模型端到端任务实验。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读可优先阅读第3章的内存预算定义与三类范式的对比、第4章的核心结论表述（无需啃附录中的复杂度证明）、第5章的探测实验设计思路，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting and looped Transformers both increase test-time computation for fixed models, but prior work on looped Transformers mostly assumes full-sequence recurrent states (memory-rich regimes) and fails to disentangle computation volume and cross-step persistent mutable memory as separate resources. No clear theoretical boundary exists between the reasoning capabilities of compressed-state looped Transformers and CoT under memory constraints.
summary_en.importance: This work establishes a formal resource accounting framework for test-time reasoning, disentangling persistent mutable memory from computation volume as separate resources. It provides explicit constraints for the design of recurrent/looped LLM reasoning architectures: the expressivity upper bound of compressed latent loops is determined by the size of their persistent recurrent state, and simply increasing iteration count cannot improve reasoning performance on tasks requiring large serial memory.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, it formalizes memory budgets for three reasoning paradigms: compressed latent loops (M = s*d*p, where s is the number of recurrent slots, d is hidden width, p is activation bit precision), full sequence-state loops (M = n*d*p, where n is input length), and CoT scratchpads (M = Θ(ℓ log|Σ|), where ℓ is the number of generated CoT tokens). It then proves via computational complexity theory that compressed loops with polylogarithmic persistent state relative to input length fall into the DSPACE(polylog n) complexity class, even when run for quasi-polynomial iterations. Under the standard unproven assumption that P ⊈ DSPACE(polylog n), such compressed loops cannot solve P-complete serial tasks, while polynomial-length CoT can. This separation only applies to compressed loops; full sequence-state loops have linear memory scaling with input length and belong to the memory-rich regime with no such constraint.
summary_en.experiments: This work is primarily theoretical. It only includes two controlled finite-size probes to validate intuition: a pointer-chasing slot sweep and an associative-recall state-size sweep. It also references prior memory-token results on Sudoku as external support, and does not include large-scale end-to-end LLM experiments.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 3 for memory budget definitions and paradigm comparisons, read core conclusion statements in Section 4 (skip formal complexity proofs in appendices), and review probe experiment design in Section 5. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 会修正“latent loop 可直接替代 CoT”的直觉；读主定理和三种 memory regime，别把它当实证结论。
recommendation.en: It weakens the intuition that latent loops can simply replace CoT; read the main theorem and memory regimes, but do not treat it as empirical evidence.

paper.title: Unlocking the Working Memory of Large Language Models for Latent Reasoning
paper.abstract: To improve the reasoning capabilities of large language models, test-time compute is typically scaled by generating intermediate tokens before the final answer. However, this couples reasoning to autoregressive generation and thereby conflates internal computation with external communication. In contrast, human cognition can use working memory to hold and manipulate information internally without the need to externalize intermediate thoughts. Drawing on this principle, we introduce Reasoning in

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决的问题是：推理时的中间计算是否必须以自回归 token 的形式外显出来。RiM 认为 CoT 和不少 latent reasoning 方法仍然把“计算”绑定在逐步生成上，只是把自然语言 token 换成连续表示或隐式 token，推理长度仍然带来串行解码开销。
summary.importance: 对预训练和推理范式的启发在于，它把 latent reasoning 从“生成一串中间状态”推进到“在固定工作区内并行计算”。这不是标准预训练 recipe 的贡献，但对基座模型如何获得可训练的内部 scratchpad 有参考价值。它尤其提示一个方向：如果模型在预训练或中期训练阶段就被教会使用固定 memory slots，推理时可能用更少外显 token 获得类似 CoT 的计算量。
summary.technical_approach: RiM 使用固定长度的特殊 token 序列作为 memory blocks。这些 token 的身份和位置固定，不需要逐步生成；但经过 Transformer 上下文计算后，它们的 hidden states 会随问题变化，因此可以承载中间推理信息。训练分两阶段。第一阶段用逐步监督给 memory blocks 赋予语义：每个 block 后的 readout 需要预测对应的下一步 reasoning step，迫使模型把已见 memory blocks 组织成可读出的中间状态。第二阶段移除严格的 step-level reasoning supervision，改为让每个 block 后的 readout 预测最终答案，使训练信号从“复现文字推理链”转向“逐步改善答案”。一个定制 attention mask 允许所有 readouts 在一次 forward 中同时训练，避免像 CoT 那样逐 token 串行产生中间过程。与普通 CoT 相比，RiM 不生成中间文本；与连续 latent reasoning 相比，它也不自回归生成连续中间表示，而是复用固定 memory workspace。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 GPT-2 和 Llama-3.2 系列规模的模型，在 GSM8K-Aug 上训练，并在 GSM8K 与 GSM-Hard 上评估，分别覆盖同分布和更难的分布外数学推理。正文给出的主要结论是：RiM 在这些设置下可以匹配或超过显式 CoT 和已有 latent reasoning baseline，同时推理阶段的中间计算更容易并行化。给定内容没有暴露完整实验表格中的具体准确率、memory block 长度、训练 token 数和消融数字，因此不应把结果理解为已证明可直接迁移到大规模通用预训练；它更像是一个受控数学推理场景下的机制验证。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。重点看方法部分的 formalization、两阶段 curriculum、custom attention mask，以及附录中关于 single-forward dense supervision 的实现细节。实验部分优先看三类消融：memory block 数量如何影响准确率，Stage 1/Stage 2 各自是否必要，以及与 CoT token budget 对齐后的效率对比。真正值得深挖的是 attention mask 和 readout 设计，因为这决定了 memory blocks 是被模型当作可计算工作区，还是只变成一组无意义的占位 token。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether intermediate reasoning must be externalized as autoregressive tokens. RiM argues that both chain-of-thought and many latent-reasoning methods still couple computation to sequential generation: the model has to emit intermediate states before later computation can condition on them.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is not a new pretraining recipe, but a useful design point for latent reasoning. RiM turns intermediate computation into operations over fixed memory slots, rather than a generated trace. For foundation-model research, the interesting implication is that an internal scratchpad may be trainable through curriculum and dense supervision, and may reduce the need for verbose test-time reasoning tokens.
summary_en.technical_approach: RiM inserts fixed sequences of special tokens called memory blocks. Their token identities and positions are fixed, so they do not need autoregressive decoding. Their contextual hidden states, however, are input-dependent and can store task-specific intermediate information. Training uses a two-stage curriculum. In Stage 1, readouts after each memory block are supervised to predict the corresponding next reasoning step, which gives the otherwise unstructured memory blocks a computational role. In Stage 2, the step-level supervision is relaxed: each readout is trained to predict the final answer, shifting the objective from reproducing written reasoning to refining the answer across memory blocks. A custom attention mask lets all readouts be trained in a single forward pass. Compared with CoT, RiM avoids generating intermediate text. Compared with autoregressive latent-reasoning methods, it avoids generating a sequence of latent states.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated with GPT-2- and Llama-3.2-scale models trained on GSM8K-Aug, and tested on GSM8K and GSM-Hard. The reported conclusion is that RiM matches or exceeds explicit CoT and latent-reasoning baselines while making intermediate computation more parallelizable at inference time. The supplied text does not expose the full numerical tables, exact accuracy gains, memory length settings, or training-scale details, so the result should be read as controlled evidence on math reasoning rather than as a large-scale pretraining result.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Focus on the method formalization, the two-stage curriculum, the attention-mask design, and the appendix details for single-forward dense supervision. In the experiments, look for ablations on the number of memory blocks, the necessity of each curriculum stage, and compute-matched comparisons against CoT. The most important implementation detail is whether the memory slots are forced to carry recoverable intermediate information, rather than becoming inert placeholder tokens.

recommendation.zh: Sepp Hochreiter 团队探索 latent reasoning 的新坑，用 fixed memory blocks 替代 AR CoT，思路很 clean，值得关注其 grounding 策略和实际加速比。
recommendation.en: Sepp Hochreiter's team explores a new path for latent reasoning by replacing AR CoT with fixed memory blocks; the clean setup and grounding strategy are worth checking for actual speedups.

paper.title: Self-Trained Verification for Training- and Test-Time Self-Improvement
paper.abstract: Self-improvement at scale has been a longstanding goal for reasoning models, and there are two natural places to do it: at test time, through verification-refinement (V-R) loops; and at training time, through self-training methods. Both are gated by the same bottleneck: the verifier. V-R loops stall when verifier scores inflate while accuracy stagnates, and when feedback is too generic to act on; self-training fails similarly when bad self-generated data are added to training. summary.core_problem: 基于基模型幂分布的免训练推理采样方法受限于采样效率瓶颈：现有Metropolis-Hastings（MH）采样器均匀随机选择推理轨迹的截断位置，容易在局部计算步骤内截断，导致重采样的后缀仅修改局部token，无法在不同推理策略的模式间有效切换，采样混合速度慢、算力利用率低。
summary.importance: 证实了通过优化采样策略即可更高效地提取基模型中已有的推理能力，无需额外训练、数据或验证器，为测试时间的推理性能提升提供了低成本路径，对理解基模型后训练的作用机理（ sharpening 假说）提供了新的实验支撑。
summary.technical_approach: 提出熵截断MH（Entropy-Cut MH）采样器，保留原有幂分布采样框架不变，仅修改截断位置的选择策略：将截断位置优先选择在下一个token的熵较高的位置，即推理过程的决策点（如证明思路选择、公式转换节点等），而非均匀随机选择。该方法不改变MH算法的目标分布，仅通过更合理的提议分布提升采样混合效率，且完全免训练。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen2.5-Math-7B、Qwen3-8B-Base、Phi-3.5-mini-instruct、Phi-4-mini-instruct等多个模型上测试，覆盖MATH500、HumanEval、GPQA Diamond、AIME26等推理任务。以Qwen2.5-7B为例，熵截断MH在MATH500上准确率达71.9%，HumanEval达68.9%，GPQA达30.2%，优于标准采样、低温采样、SMC、TMC、均匀截断MH等所有基线方法；多轮采样下，单样本性能提升的同时不会出现采样多样性崩溃的问题。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3章熵截断策略的具体实现、第4章推理树模型下的混合效率理论分析，以及图1的方法对比和效果可视化；泛读预计耗时15分钟，可跳过预备知识部分的基础算法回顾。

summary_en.core_problem: Training-free reasoning sampling methods based on the base model's power distribution are limited by sampling efficiency bottlenecks: existing Metropolis-Hastings (MH) samplers select cut positions in reasoning traces uniformly at random, which often cuts inside local calculation steps. This results in resampled suffixes that only modify local tokens, fail to effectively switch between modes of different reasoning strategies, and lead to slow mixing and low compute utilization.
summary_en.importance: It confirms that optimizing sampling strategies can more efficiently extract the inherent reasoning capabilities of base models without additional training, data, or verifiers, providing a low-cost path for test-time reasoning performance improvement. It also provides new experimental support for understanding the mechanism of post-training (the sharpening hypothesis).
summary_en.technical_approach: Entropy-Cut MH sampler is proposed, which retains the original power distribution sampling framework and only modifies the cut position selection strategy: cut positions are prioritized at locations with high next-token entropy, which correspond to decision points in the reasoning process (such as proof strategy selection, formula transformation nodes, etc.), instead of uniform random selection. This method does not change the target distribution of the MH algorithm, only improves sampling mixing efficiency through a more reasonable proposal distribution, and is completely training-free.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on multiple models including Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2.5-Math-7B, Qwen3-8B-Base, Phi-3.5-mini-instruct, and Phi-4-mini-instruct, covering reasoning tasks such as MATH500, HumanEval, GPQA Diamond, and AIME26. For Qwen2.5-7B, Entropy-Cut MH achieves 71.9% accuracy on MATH500, 68.9% on HumanEval, and 30.2% on GPQA, outperforming all baselines including standard sampling, low-temperature sampling, SMC, TMC, and uniform-cut MH. Under multi-sample settings, single-sample performance improvement does not come with sampling diversity collapse.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the specific implementation of the entropy-cut strategy in Chapter 3, the theoretical analysis of mixing efficiency under the reasoning-tree model in Chapter 4, and the method comparison and effect visualization in Figure 1. Skim the basic algorithm review in the preliminaries section; expected reading time is 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: Verifier 训练信号设计比 V-R loop 本身更值得看；读方法和 failure analysis，别只看最终准确率。
recommendation.en: The verifier supervision signal is the useful part, not the V-R loop wrapper; read the method and failure analysis before the headline accuracy.

paper.title: Reasoning with Sampling: Cutting at Decision Points
paper.abstract: Frontier reasoning models are produced by posttraining base language models with reinforcement learning. Recent work has challenged this by showing that sampling from a sharpened version of the base model's distribution, a so-called power distribution, elicits comparable reasoning without additional training, curated datasets, or verifiers. However, making this method practical requires efficiently sampling from the power distribution. A sampler needs to "mix" to the power distribution, which ne

summary.core_problem: 让 base model 通过 power distribution 采样获得更强推理能力时，现有随机 cut-and-resample 采样器混合效率低，常只改局部措辞而不改变关键推理路径。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是测试时推理采样方法。它延续“不额外 RL 后训练，也能从 sharpened base distribution 中激发推理”的方向，重点处理 practical sampling bottleneck。
summary.technical_approach: 论文观察到推理轨迹中只有少数决策点决定全局解法，例如证明策略或算法选择；因此不再均匀随机选择 cut 位置，而是在更可能改变决策路径的位置切断并重采样 suffix，以提高在 power distribution 下跨模式移动的能力。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供模型规模、任务集和具体提升幅度。实验目标是比较 decision-point cutting 与 prior uniform-cut samplers，在 hard reasoning traces 中是否更容易切换推理策略、提升采样效率和最终解题表现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to make power-distribution sampling practical for reasoning, since uniform cut-and-resample samplers often rewrite local details rather than switch to a different reasoning strategy.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a test-time reasoning sampler. It builds on the line of work claiming that sharpened base-model distributions can elicit reasoning without RL post-training, but focuses on the mixing bottleneck.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method cuts reasoning traces at decision points rather than uniformly random positions. These points correspond to choices such as proof strategy or algorithm selection, so resampling the suffix from them is more likely to move between modes of the target power distribution.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not state model sizes, datasets, or numerical gains. The intended comparison is against uniform-cut samplers, measuring whether decision-point cuts improve mode switching, sampling efficiency, and final reasoning accuracy.

recommendation.zh: 只看 sampler 设计和决策点检测；“base model 不训也能推理”那条线仍需警惕 compute 账。
recommendation.en: Read only the sampler and decision-point detection; the no-training reasoning story still needs a careful test-time compute accounting.

paper.title: Beyond Consensus: Trace-Level Synthesis in Mixture of Agents
paper.abstract: When multiple LLM agents solve the same problem, standard practice compresses each agent's reasoning into a majority vote or layered synthesis, treating agreement as the finish line. We show this is unnecessarily lossy: an LLM aggregator that reads complete reasoning traces recovers correct solutions even when agents unanimously agree, with beneficial corrections consistently outweighing harmful ones -- the \emph{aggregation paradox}. Majority voting has a ceiling that perturbation diversity doe

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论多条推理轨迹如何聚合。常见做法把每条 chain-of-thought 压缩成最终答案，再做多数投票或选择；作者指出，这会丢掉中间步骤、局部证明和错误路径中的有效信息。核心问题是：当多个 agent 甚至已经达成一致时，是否仍应读取完整推理轨迹并做合成。
summary.importance: 它不是预训练论文，但对推理时计算、过程监督和合成数据有启发。关键观察是，推理轨迹里存在可组合的信息，最终答案一致并不代表信息已经被充分利用。对基座研究更有用的部分，是把“答案级监督”与“过程级信息”区分开：如果训练或评测只看最终答案，可能低估了轨迹中的可学习信号。这一点会影响 verifier、PRM、self-consistency 数据构造，以及用多样化推理轨迹做 post-train 数据时的过滤策略。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出并验证所谓 aggregation paradox：trace-level synthesis 在多数投票已经给出答案、甚至 unanimous consensus 的情况下仍能提升准确率。实验中固定 N=5 个 agent，使用同一个 gpt-oss-120b，greedy decoding，避免模型异质性和采样温度带来的混杂因素；多样性来自语义保持输入扰动 SPUQ。比较对象是同一组候选轨迹上的多数投票与 LLM synthesis，因而主要变量是聚合方式。方法部分进一步给出 SC-MoA：用语义保持扰动产生轨迹多样性；用 anchored refinement 降低合成时的退化风险，并给出 submartingale 形式的非退化保证；最后不再以 consensus 作为是否合成的门控条件，而是始终执行 trace-level aggregation。与普通 self-consistency 的差别在于，它不把轨迹压成答案；与多模型 MoA 的差别在于，作者强调单模型加输入扰动即可获得足够的 trace complementarity。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 BBH-3、MMLU-ML、GPQA-Diamond、AIME、LCB-Hard。关键数字集中在 consensus 场景：GPQA-Diamond 上，pre-refinement 设置中 n=198，trace synthesis 相对 voting 产生 12 次 beneficial flips 和 5 次 harmful flips，净增 3.5 个百分点，McNemar p=0.09；BBH-3 上 n=296，16 次 beneficial flips 对 5 次 harmful flips，净增 3.7 个百分点，p=0.016。anchored refinement 后，部分 harmful flips 被修正；全文给出的结果中，BBH 和 AIME 在完整流程下 harmful flips 为 0。完整 BBH 2,561 题上，SC-MoA 在 91 个 SC 失败的样本上成功，在 48 个 SC 成功的样本上失败，head-to-head win rate 为 65.5%。作者还报告，扰动多样性并没有显著降低投票错误相关性，说明提升不是来自更好的多数票上界，而是来自轨迹内部信息的互补。单模型加扰动在部分设置下超过异构模型池，这一点对推理系统设计有实际意义。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。重点看第 3 节的 aggregation paradox 实验设计和 beneficial/harmful flip 分解，因为这里决定了结论是否可信。再看第 4 节 SC-MoA 的三个组成部分，尤其是 anchored refinement 为什么能降低合成退化。表 29、表 31、完整 BBH 的 win/loss 分解值得看；如果只关心机制，优先看错误相关性分析和单模型对异构模型池的比较。附录中的个例可选读，主要用于理解 trace-level complementarity 如何发生。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to aggregate multiple reasoning traces. Standard self-consistency collapses each chain into a final answer and then votes. The authors argue that this compression discards useful intermediate evidence, including partial derivations and locally correct steps inside otherwise wrong traces.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining method, but it is relevant to inference-time scaling, process supervision, and reasoning-data construction. The useful lesson is that final-answer supervision can miss signal contained in reasoning traces. That matters for verifier training, PRM design, rejection sampling pipelines, and synthetic reasoning data: filtering only by final answers can discard traces that contain learnable sub-solutions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central claim is the aggregation paradox: an LLM aggregator that reads full reasoning traces can improve over majority voting even when the agents unanimously agree. The controlled setup uses N=5 agents, the same gpt-oss-120b model, greedy decoding, and semantic-preserving input perturbations via SPUQ. The comparison is clean: majority voting and LLM synthesis receive the same proposals, so the main variable is the aggregation rule. The proposed SC-MoA pipeline has three parts: perturbation-based trace diversity, anchored refinement with a submartingale-style non-degradation argument, and universal aggregation without a consensus gate. The distinction from self-consistency is that traces are not reduced to answer tokens; the distinction from heterogeneous MoA is that a single model with input perturbations can already provide useful trace complementarity.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses BBH-3, MMLU-ML, GPQA-Diamond, AIME, and LCB-Hard. In the pre-refinement consensus setting, GPQA-Diamond has n=198 examples; trace synthesis produces 12 beneficial flips versus 5 harmful flips, for a +3.5 percentage point gain, with McNemar p=0.09. On BBH-3 with n=296, it produces 16 beneficial flips versus 5 harmful flips, for +3.7 points, with p=0.016. After anchored refinement, harmful flips are removed in some settings; the full pipeline reports zero harmful flips on BBH and AIME. On the full BBH set of 2,561 problems, SC-MoA wins 91 cases where self-consistency fails and loses 48 cases where self-consistency succeeds, giving a 65.5% head-to-head win rate. The paper also reports that perturbation diversity does not materially reduce error correlation for voting, so the gain is attributed to trace-level complementarity rather than a better voting ceiling.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–35 minutes. Focus on Section 3, especially the beneficial-versus-harmful flip decomposition and the consensus cases; that is where the main claim is tested. Then read Section 4 for SC-MoA, with attention to anchored refinement and why the authors avoid gating on consensus. Tables 29 and 31, the full-BBH win/loss analysis, the error-correlation comparison, and the single-model-versus-heterogeneous-pool result are the most informative parts. The appendix examples are useful if you want to inspect how trace complementarity appears in individual problems.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了多智能体聚合中 trace-level 信息的价值，对设计更鲁棒的推理时 scaling 策略（如 test-time compute）有启发，值得关注其 aggregation paradox 的分析。
recommendation.en: Highlights the value of trace-level information in multi-agent aggregation, offering insights for designing more robust test-time compute strategies; the analysis of the 'aggregation paradox' is worth noting.

paper.title: Self-Consistency via Marginal Sharpening
paper.abstract: Inference-time sampling can elicit strong reasoning abilities from language models without additional training. Existing power-sampling methods do so by sharpening the distribution over full generated outputs, favoring completions that are individually likely under the model. We argue that this is the wrong object to target for reasoning: a completion entangles a reasoning trace with a final answer, whereas what matters is whether an answer is supported by many plausible reasoning paths. We ther

summary.core_problem: 推理型 LM 的输出可以拆成“隐式推理轨迹 + 最终答案”。现有 inference-time 强化（majority vote 的 self-consistency、以及对整段 completion 做 power sampling）都在“整段字符串”层面聚合或锐化，导致把不同推理轨迹但同一答案的支持度打散，尤其在代码/证明等结构化输出里更严重。论文要解决的是：如何把 test-time compute 用在“答案边缘分布（answer marginal）”上，而不是用在“完整轨迹分布（trajectory / completion）”上，从而更贴近‘一个答案被多少条合理推理路径支持’这一目标。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是 recipe 级贡献，但对“推理作为潜变量”的建模视角很清晰：把 self-consistency 从事后投票提升为一个显式的 inference-time 目标（sharpened answer marginal）。这对两类方向有直接启发：1）post-train / RL 里做 process vs outcome 信号设计时，应该更明确地区分‘轨迹似然’与‘答案支持度’；2）若未来在预训练或中期训练里引入 any-order / latent-variable 目标，这个分解提供了可操作的近似路径（用标准 AR 模型近似采样一个“答案级”目标分布）。
summary.technical_approach:
核心做法是把推理轨迹 z 视为潜变量、答案 y 为观测目标，定义基础模型给出的答案边缘分布 p(y|x)=\sum_z p(z,y|x)。然后定义“边缘锐化”目标：q_\alpha(y|x) \propto p(y|x)^\alpha（\alpha>1），即放大那些在边缘分布上概率更高的答案——这对应‘被更多潜在推理路径支持’的答案。

关键推导在于：当 \alpha 为整数时，p(y|x)^\alpha 可以写成多条独立轨迹样本的乘积形式，从而把“对边缘分布做幂次锐化”的目标，转成“从多条轨迹中提取 token 级共识信号”的可计算对象。基于这个分解，论文给出一个轻量的并行 AR 解码近似：
1）先从模型采样 K 条完整 completion（包含推理轨迹 + 答案段），把它们视为潜变量样本；
2）在生成最终答案时，不再选某一条 completion 的答案段，而是对答案段逐 token 聚合来自 K 条轨迹的支持（直观上类似 product-of-experts / vote-at-token-level，但目标来自边缘锐化的推导，而不是拍脑袋的启发式）；
3）用这个聚合后的 token 分布解码出单个答案。

论文还讨论了一个可选的 sequential importance sampling（SIS）校正版本，用重要性权重更贴近真实的 q_\alpha，但主实验以并行近似为主，强调实现简单、可并行、对长推理更省时。

与 power sampling 的区别：power sampling 锐化的是 p(z,y|x)（整段序列），会偏向‘某一条最像训练分布的完整推理稿’，而不是偏向‘答案层面有广泛支持’；边缘锐化则显式把不同轨迹对同一答案的支持累加后再锐化。
summary.experiments:
论文在数学推理与代码生成基准上比较 temperature sampling、majority voting self-consistency、sequence-level power sampling、以及 marginal sharpening。文中给出的定性结论是：
- 数学推理：marginal sharpening 的最终答案准确率接近 majority voting（因为数学答案往往短且易 canonicalize，字符串投票本身就很强），但优于 power sampling。
- 代码生成：marginal sharpening 明显更占优，并给出“代码基准上最好结果”的表述，原因是代码的‘同解多形’更严重，字符串级投票与序列级锐化都会碎片化支持度。
- 计算效率：在长推理问题上，相比需要对完整序列做更重采样/重打分的 power sampling，marginal sharpening 在相同或更好的效果下可达到最高约 38× 的速度优势（论文表述为 up to 38× faster）。

消融方向包括：锐化强度 \alpha、轨迹样本数 K、并行近似 vs SIS 校正、固定 compute 分配策略等；附录 B 给全表，附录 C 评估 SIS 版本。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 重点看 §2（把 completion 切成 latent trace + answer，并定义 answer marginal），这是全文的“对象选择”转折点。
- 重点看 §3 的整数 \alpha 分解：它解释了为什么可以用多轨迹的 token 级聚合来近似采样 sharpened marginal，而不是停留在‘更聪明的投票’。
- 直接翻 §5 的代码基准结果与 runtime 对比，再回看方法细节理解为什么代码场景收益更大。
- 如果关心严格性与偏差来源，读附录 C（SIS 校正）了解近似误差与代价。

summary_en.core_problem: Reasoning-oriented LMs produce outputs that mix a latent reasoning trace with a final answer. Common inference-time methods either (a) vote over full strings (self-consistency) or (b) sharpen the distribution over full completions (power sampling). Both operate at the trajectory/string level, so they fragment support when many different traces correspond to the same underlying answer—especially in structured domains like code and proofs. The paper targets a more appropriate object: the answer marginal aggregated over latent traces, and asks how to sharpen and sample from that marginal efficiently using standard autoregressive models.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining recipe paper, but it sharpens the latent-variable view of reasoning in a way that matters for foundation-model work: it turns self-consistency from a post-hoc voting heuristic into an explicit inference-time objective (a sharpened answer marginal). This clarifies the mismatch between “likely transcript” and “well-supported answer,” which is relevant when designing process/outcome signals in post-training and when considering latent-variable or any-order objectives that might later feed back into mid-training or continual pretraining.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluations cover math reasoning and code generation, comparing temperature sampling, majority-vote self-consistency, sequence-level power sampling, and marginal sharpening. Reported takeaways:
- Math: marginal sharpening stays close to majority voting (string-level voting is strong when answers are short/canonicalizable) while improving over power sampling.
- Code: marginal sharpening performs best among compared inference-time methods, consistent with higher “same-solution/different-surface-form” variability.
- Efficiency: on long-reasoning problems, the proposed approach can be up to ~38× faster than power-sampling-style methods while improving final-answer performance.
Ablations vary sharpening strength \alpha, number of traces K, approximation choices, and compute allocation; full tables are in Appendix B, SIS details in Appendix C.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 min):
- §2 for the modeling choice (trace vs answer) and the definition of the answer marginal.
- §3 for the integer-\alpha decomposition; this is where the method becomes more than “smarter voting.”
- Jump to §5 for code-generation results and runtime comparisons, then backtrack to connect gains to the marginal-vs-sequence distinction.
- Appendix C if you care about approximation bias and what SIS correction buys you.

recommendation.zh: 只看目标分布推导和采样算法即可；它修正了 power sampling 的对象，但对预训练侧只是 test-time compute 的弱信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the target-distribution derivation and sampler; it fixes what power sampling sharpens, but remains a weak pretraining-side signal.

paper.title: Do Language Models Need Sleep? Offline Recurrence for Improved Online Inference
paper.abstract: Transformer-based large language models are increasingly used for long-horizon tasks; however, their attention mechanism scales poorly with context length. To handle this, we study a sleep-like consolidation mechanism in which a model periodically converts recent context into persistent fast weights before clearing its key-value cache. During sleep, the model performs $N$ offline recurrent passes over the accumulated context and updates the fast weights in its state-space model (SSM) blocks thro

summary.core_problem: SSM-attention 混合模型在上下文被驱逐出 KV cache 后，无法对已驱逐上下文进行深度推理。单纯的 fast weight 记忆容量不是瓶颈，将瞬时上下文转化为有用内部状态所需的计算量才是瓶颈——推理深度增加时，vanilla SSM 即使 fast weight 容量足够也会性能下降。
summary.importance: 提出了一种类睡眠（sleep-like）的离线循环巩固机制，将额外计算从推理时刻转移到离线巩固阶段，为长程推理场景下的记忆-计算权衡提供了新思路。对持续学习和长上下文 LLM 推理有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 当模型上下文窗口填满时，进入"睡眠"阶段：对累积上下文进行多次前向传播（离线循环），通过学到的局部规则递归更新 SSM 模块中的 fast weights。睡眠期间不接收外部输入。巩固后清空上下文窗口，模型以更新后的 fast weights 恢复工作。训练时通过完整过程端到端反向传播优化。核心区别于先前循环/loop 模型：循环计算不在预测时执行，而是在离线巩固阶段完成，预测时仍为单次前向。
summary.experiments: 实验包含三部分：(1) 元胞自动机等受控合成任务，展示 vanilla GDN（SSM）随推理深度增加性能显著下降，而 sleep 架构通过增加循环深度（N=8）可恢复性能；(2) 多跳图检索任务，sleep 架构在深推理跳数下相比 GDN 有最大幅度提升；(3) GSM-Infinite 数学推理任务，使用预训练 LLM 初始化验证了方法有效性。具体数字未在正文完整体现，主要以定性趋势展示。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 Introduction 部分对 SSM-attention 混合模型推理瓶颈的诊断（第3-4段），这是最有价值的观察。Method 部分看 sleep 机制与普通 SSM fast weight 更新的区别。实验部分关注合成任务的推理深度控制实验。预计阅读时间 20-25 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构和作者信息未在提供的全文片段中明确给出。

summary_en.core_problem: SSM-attention hybrid models cannot perform deep reasoning over context that has been evicted from the KV cache. The bottleneck is not fast weight memory capacity but the amount of computation needed to transform transient context into a useful internal state — vanilla SSMs degrade with increasing reasoning depth even when fast weight capacity is sufficient.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a sleep-like offline recurrent consolidation mechanism that shifts extra computation from inference time to an offline consolidation phase, offering a new perspective on memory-compute tradeoffs for long-horizon reasoning. Some relevance to continual learning and long-context LLM inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: When the context window fills up, the model enters a 'sleep' phase: performing multiple offline recurrent forward passes over accumulated context to recursively update fast weights in SSM blocks via a learned local rule. No external tokens are received during sleep. After consolidation, the context window is cleared and the model resumes with updated fast weights. Training is end-to-end backprop through the entire process. Key distinction from prior looped models: recurrent computation is spent offline during consolidation rather than at prediction time, enabling single-pass prediction after sleep.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover three settings: (1) Controlled synthetic tasks (cellular automata) showing vanilla GDNs degrade with increasing reasoning depth, while the sleep architecture recovers performance via deeper recurrence (N=8); (2) Multi-hop graph retrieval, where the sleep architecture shows largest gains on the deepest reasoning instances; (3) GSM-Infinite math reasoning with pretrained LLM initializations. Specific numerical results are not fully elaborated in the provided text fragments, shown primarily as qualitative trends.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the diagnosis of the reasoning bottleneck in SSM-attention hybrids in the Introduction (paragraphs 3-4) — this is the most valuable observation. In the Method section, understand how sleep differs from standard SSM fast weight updates. In experiments, focus on the reasoning depth control experiments in synthetic tasks. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and author information not explicitly provided in the available text fragments.

recommendation.zh: 只看 sleep-duration scaling 和 fast-weight 更新；结果早期，但离线测试时计算写入状态这件事值得小模型复现。
recommendation.en: Read the sleep-duration scaling and fast-weight update; the results are early, but writing offline test-time compute into state deserves a small-model replication.

paper.title: Anticipate and Learn: Unleashing Idle-Time Compute in Proactive Agents
paper.abstract: While AI agents demonstrate remarkable capabilities in reasoning and tool use, they remain fundamentally reactive: they compute responses only after explicit user prompts. This paradigm ignores a critical opportunity: the idle time between interactions is largely wasted, leaving agents unable to prepare for future user needs. To bridge this gap, we introduce ProAct, a proactive agent architecture that leverages idle-time compute to anticipate and fulfill likely upcoming user needs. By analyzing

summary.core_problem: 解决现有 agent 只在用户发问后被动计算、无法利用交互空闲时间提前准备的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献一半在 agent 架构，一半在评测资产。对基座预训练本身不直接，但对 test-time compute 分配、长期记忆和主动式系统设计有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ProAct：在 idle time 内结合对话历史与持久记忆预测用户下一步需求，主动补齐知识缺口、检索证据并预先准备答案；同时构建 ProActEval，覆盖 40 个领域、200 个场景，用于评估 proactive capability。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多种场景下显著优于被动式基线，但未给出底座模型、工具配置、成本开销、成功率提升幅度等关键细节。若看论文，重点应放在 benchmark 设计和 idle-time compute 的收益/成本曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the limitation that current agents are reactive: they only compute after a user prompt and waste idle time between interactions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is split between an agent architecture and an evaluation asset. It is not directly about pretraining, but it is relevant to test-time compute allocation, persistent memory, and proactive system design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes ProAct, which uses dialogue history plus persistent memory during idle time to predict likely future user needs, gather missing information, and prepare evidence in advance. It also introduces ProActEval with 200 scenarios across 40 domains for proactive-agent evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims significant gains over reactive baselines, but does not provide key details such as the base model, tool stack, cost overhead, or exact improvement margins. If reading, focus on the benchmark design and the benefit-vs-cost curve of idle-time compute.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不深；若关心 test-time scaling，就只看 benchmark 设计与空闲算力收益曲线，方法本身偏系统工程。
recommendation.en: Not very close to pretraining; if you care about test-time scaling, read the benchmark design and the idle-compute tradeoff, since the method itself is mostly systems work.

paper.title: Boosting Inference with Guided Reasoning: Stochastic Exploration for Recursive Models
paper.abstract: Recent work on recursive architectures has shown that tiny neural networks can be surprisingly powerful on structured reasoning tasks. The trick is to model reasoning trajectories with a latent dynamical system. We argue that the inference-time behaviour of these architectures is best understood as approximate inference over latent reasoning trajectories, with deterministic recursion as the one-particle, zero-noise limit. We make this view operational through guided stochastic exploration: stoch

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是递归推理模型的测试时计算分配问题：给定一个已经训练好的 TRM-style 小模型，如何在不重新训练的情况下，用额外推理计算探索多个潜在推理轨迹，并判断这种探索什么时候会有效。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在数据或 scaling，而在“latent reasoning trajectory”这一建模视角。它把递归推理模型的确定性迭代解释为潜变量轨迹上的近似推断，并给出可执行的测试时采样与重加权方法。这个视角对小型递归架构、latent reasoning、test-time compute allocation 有启发：模型内部的早停 Q-head 不只是控制计算深度，也可以作为轨迹选择的 learned guide。贡献量级属于清晰的机制化改造，而不是通用 LLM 训练 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是在冻结的递归模型上做 guided stochastic exploration。原始 TRM 通过共享 backbone 反复更新 latent state z 和 answer state y，并用 Q-head 判断当前输出是否已经正确。作者把确定性递归看成一个粒子、零噪声的特例；扩展后，在内层递归中加入随机扰动，形成一组相邻的 latent trajectories。每条轨迹产生候选答案，再用原模型已有的 Q-head 作为 guide，对粒子权重做在线重加权，形式上对应 Feynman–Kac tilt。关键不是简单多采样，而是要求两个条件同时成立：一是局部稳定性，噪声扰动后的轨迹仍能回到可恢复区域；二是 guide alignment，Q-head 分数必须能区分成功轨迹和失败轨迹。论文还提出三个诊断量：local stability、guide alignment、cloud-token entropy。前两个判断方法是否有操作空间，第三个用于 token-level 风险排序和选择性拒答。
summary.experiments: 主要结果集中在结构化推理任务。Sudoku-Extreme 上，冻结模型的确定性基线 exact-solve accuracy 为 85.9±0.6%，guided stochastic exploration 提升到 98.0±0.3%，并且能在更低递归深度恢复接近基线的性能。作者报告随机探索会显著增加 particle cloud 中成功轨迹的数量，而 Q-head 在 Sudoku-Extreme 上能够把权重集中到这些成功轨迹，因此接近 oracle-particle 上限。Maze-Hard 是反例：探索本身稳定，但 Q-head guide 过平，in-cloud guide-spread bound 在无标签条件下提前提示无法有效重加权，实际评测也确认没有明显改进。选择性拒答实验中，final-step token entropy 和 path-integrated token entropy 能排序 token error risk，在常规测试集和 deterministic-failure split 上都能提供可靠性信号。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对确定性递归“一粒子零噪声极限”的解释，以及方法部分的 stochastic proposal kernel 和 Q-head reweighting。理论部分重点看 Proposition 5.1 的稳定性条件、Lemma 5.4 的 guide alignment 解释，以及公式 (19) 的无标签 spread bound；这三个点决定方法什么时候能用。实验部分重点看 Sudoku-Extreme 与 Maze-Hard 的对照，因为它们分别展示了“有轨迹 headroom 且 guide 对齐”和“有轨迹 headroom 但 guide 不对齐”的差别。对预训练方向读者，最值得深挖的是 Q-head 这类训练期辅助头如何在推理期转化为 latent trajectory selector。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies test-time compute allocation for recursive reasoning models: given a frozen TRM-style network, how can extra inference compute be used to explore multiple latent reasoning trajectories, and how can one tell in advance whether that exploration will help.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is not a new pretraining recipe, but a useful view of latent reasoning. Deterministic recursion is treated as approximate inference with a single particle and zero noise. The existing early-stopping Q-head is repurposed as a trajectory-level guide, rather than only a halting controller. This is relevant to compact recursive architectures, latent reasoning, and test-time compute allocation. The contribution is a principled inference-time mechanism with diagnostics, not a general LLM scaling result.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, guided stochastic exploration, operates on a frozen recursive model. A TRM-style model repeatedly updates a latent state z and an answer state y with a shared backbone, and carries a learned Q-head trained to estimate whether the current decoded answer is correct. The paper injects stochastic perturbations into the inner recursion to propose a cloud of nearby latent trajectories. Candidate trajectories are then reweighted online using the Q-head through a Feynman–Kac-style tilt. The deterministic baseline is recovered as the one-particle, zero-noise limit. The key distinction from naive sampling is the diagnostic structure: exploration must be locally stable, and the guide must be aligned with success. The paper defines local stability, guide alignment, and cloud-token entropy as computable diagnostics for performance and reliability.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical result is on structured reasoning. On Sudoku-Extreme, exact-solve accuracy improves from 85.9±0.6% to 98.0±0.3% without retraining, and the method recovers strong performance at lower recursion depths. The particle cloud contains many more successful trajectories than the deterministic path, and the Q-head is sufficiently aligned to select them, closing most of the oracle-particle gap. Maze-Hard serves as a failure case. Exploration is stable, but the Q-head scores are too flat; a label-free in-cloud guide-spread bound flags this before using labels, and evaluation confirms the lack of improvement. Entropy statistics over final-step and path-integrated token marginals rank token-level error risk and support selective abstention on both the standard test split and a harder deterministic-failure split.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25–35 minutes. Start with the introduction’s interpretation of deterministic recursion as the one-particle, zero-noise limit. Then read the method section for the stochastic proposal kernel and Q-head reweighting. In the theory section, focus on Proposition 5.1 for stability, Lemma 5.4 for guide alignment, and the label-free spread bound in equation (19). In the experiments, compare Sudoku-Extreme and Maze-Hard carefully: the contrast explains why trajectory headroom alone is insufficient. For pretraining-oriented readers, the most interesting point is how an auxiliary head trained for halting can become an inference-time selector over latent reasoning trajectories.

recommendation.zh: 将递归模型的推理视为潜在轨迹的近似推断，并通过随机探索提升性能，对探索 test-time compute 和 latent reasoning 有启发，值得一读。
recommendation.en: Views recursive model inference as approximate inference over latent trajectories and improves performance via stochastic exploration; inspiring for exploring test-time compute and latent reasoning. Worth a skim.

paper.title: Language Models Need Sleep
paper.abstract: Transformer-based large language models are increasingly used for long-horizon tasks; however, their attention mechanism scales poorly with context length. To handle this, we study a sleep-like consolidation mechanism in which a model periodically converts recent context into persistent fast weights before clearing its key-value cache. During sleep, the model performs N offline recurrent passes over the accumulated context and updates the fast weights in its state-space model (SSM) blocks throug

summary.core_problem: 在“有限 KV cache + 固定大小快权重（fast weights）”的混合注意力/SSM 架构里，长上下文问题不只来自存储容量，还来自“被逐出上下文窗口的 token 需要多少计算才能被压缩成可用于后续推理的内部状态”。论文要解决的是：当问题需要更深的推理链路（reasoning depth）时，传统一次前向的快权重写入不足以把已见上下文转化为可用的长期状态，导致即便快权重容量足够，模型在窗口清空后仍无法正确推理。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发不在于数据/优化器，而在于“计算-记忆”接口：把额外计算从逐 token 的 wake-time 预测阶段，转移到离线的 consolidation 阶段，从而在不增加在线延迟的前提下提升跨窗口推理能力。它把“循环/迭代计算”引入到记忆写入过程，而不是推理输出过程，提供了一种不同于长上下文注意力、RAG、或单步快权重更新的路径。对做混合架构（attention+SSM/fast weights）和长程推理的团队，价值在于：给出了一个可控的诊断结论（深推理时 GDN 失败并非容量不足）以及一个可端到端训练的机制（sleep recurrence）来补足写入计算。
summary.technical_approach:
核心设计是“sleep-like consolidation”。模型在推理时维持一个有限上下文窗口（KV cache）用于高保真近期访问，同时在 SSM/快权重块里维护固定大小的权重态（如 GDN/Mamba2 风格的外积/Delta-rule 更新）。当窗口满了，模型进入 sleep：
1) 冻结外部输入（不再接收新 token），对累积的上下文做 N 次离线循环前向（offline recurrent passes）。
2) 在每次 pass 中，通过一个学习到的局部更新规则（learned local rule）递归更新快权重状态，使其逐步吸收上下文信息。这里的关键不是换一种快权重公式，而是允许“多步迭代写入”，把写入过程变成一个可学习的计算过程。
3) consolidation 完成后清空 KV cache，回到 wake-time：后续 token 预测保持单次前向、低延迟；跨窗口信息主要依赖已被写入的快权重。
训练上，作者强调端到端反传穿过 sleep 过程，直接优化“sleep 之后的任务表现”。这点把 sleep 视作模型计算图的一部分，而不是推理时的启发式缓存压缩。
与已有 looped/depth-recurrent 模型的区别：以往循环多用于提升每步预测的计算量（loop at prediction time）；这里循环主要用于提升记忆写入/巩固的计算量（loop at consolidation time），从而把额外 compute 从在线推理延迟中剥离出来。
summary.experiments:
实验主线是用可控合成任务把“记忆负载”和“推理深度”解耦：在保持需要存储的信息量不变时，逐步提高需要的推理深度，观察 vanilla SSM-attention hybrid（以 GDN 为代表）在相同 token 预算下性能随深度恶化。作者报告的关键现象是：GDN 类快权重即使容量足够，也会在深推理设置下失败，指向写入计算不足而非存储不足。
方法对比上，sleep recurrence 的递归次数/睡眠时长越大，sleep 后的推理表现越好，且增益在“最深推理”的实例上最大。
除合成任务外，作者在 GSM-Infinite（长程数学推理）上用预训练 LLM 初始化做验证，结论是 sleep 机制在更真实的语言推理场景也能带来提升。给定你提供的全文片段未包含具体表格数字（参数量、N 的取值、提升幅度等），这里无法可靠复述精确数值；精读时需要直接查主结果表与消融表。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对“scalable memory ≠ scalable reasoning”的诊断设定：他们如何控制 memory load、只拉高 reasoning depth。
- 看方法部分对 sleep 的计算图：sleep 期间做几次 pass、快权重如何在 pass 间递归更新、训练时如何反传穿过 sleep。
- 重点看合成任务的构造与曲线图：是否真的把容量因素排除掉；以及“递归次数/睡眠时长”与性能的关系是否呈现清晰的 compute-accuracy tradeoff。
- 再看 GSM-Infinite 的设置：窗口大小、sleep 触发频率、与 baseline 的公平性（同 token/同在线延迟还是同总 FLOPs）。
深挖点：
1) sleep 的额外计算预算如何计入总成本（训练/推理）；
2) learned local rule 的形式与稳定性（是否易发散、是否需要截断反传）；
3) 清空 KV cache 后，模型在多轮 sleep 后是否出现灾难性遗忘或状态漂移。

summary_en.core_problem: Hybrid attention+SSM models use a finite KV cache for recent tokens and fixed-size fast weights for longer-term storage. This paper argues that long-horizon failure is not only a memory-capacity issue: when the required reasoning depth increases, a one-pass fast-weight write is often computationally insufficient to transform evicted context into a state that supports later inference. The problem is to enable deep computation over context that is no longer in the KV cache, while keeping wake-time (token-by-token) latency low.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a compute reallocation mechanism: move extra computation from online prediction to an offline consolidation phase (“sleep”), so the model can perform deeper processing of past context without increasing per-token inference latency. For pretraining-oriented researchers working on long-context modeling, attention/SSM hybrids, or fast-weight memory, the key value is the diagnosis (reasoning-depth bottleneck under fixed memory load) and an end-to-end trainable consolidation procedure that targets that bottleneck rather than merely expanding context length or memory size.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method introduces a sleep-like consolidation step triggered when the context window fills up.
- Wake phase: the model runs normally with a limited KV cache plus SSM-style fast weights (e.g., GDN / Mamba-like outer-product or delta-rule updates).
- Sleep phase: the model stops consuming new tokens and performs N offline recurrent forward passes over the accumulated context. Across these passes, fast weights inside SSM blocks are updated recursively via a learned local update rule, effectively turning “memory writing” into an iterative computation.
- After consolidation, the KV cache is cleared and the model resumes wake-time prediction with updated fast weights; crucially, prediction remains single-pass (no looping at inference time).
Training is end-to-end: gradients are backpropagated through the sleep procedure to optimize post-sleep task performance. The conceptual distinction from prior looped/depth-recurrent models is that recurrence is used for consolidation (writing/organizing memory), not for increasing compute at each prediction step.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental design uses controlled synthetic tasks to decouple memory load from reasoning depth: keep the amount of information to store fixed while increasing the depth of computation needed to answer queries after eviction. Under the same token budget, vanilla SSM-attention hybrids (with GDN-style fast weights) degrade as reasoning depth grows, despite having enough fast-weight capacity—supporting the “insufficient write-compute” hypothesis.
Adding sleep recurrence improves post-sleep reasoning, and performance increases with longer sleep / more recursions, with the largest gains on the deepest instances.
They also validate on GSM-Infinite (long-horizon math reasoning) using pretrained LLM initializations. The provided excerpt does not include the main tables/figures, so exact parameter sizes, recursion counts, and numeric deltas should be taken directly from the results section.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
1) Introduction: focus on the claim “scalable memory ≠ scalable reasoning” and how they operationalize reasoning depth vs memory load.
2) Method: trace the sleep computation graph—what is recurrently applied, what state is updated, and how gradients flow through sleep.
3) Synthetic task section: verify the control variables and inspect the scaling curves vs reasoning depth and vs number of sleep recursions.
4) GSM-Infinite: check fairness (same online latency vs same total compute) and how often sleep is triggered.
Follow-up questions worth digging into: compute accounting (total FLOPs), stability of the learned local rule, and whether repeated sleep cycles cause drift/forgetting in fast-weight state.

recommendation.zh: 只看 fast-weight consolidation 的机制和 N-scaling 曲线；它给长上下文记忆提供了比加 KV 更像训练问题的路径。
recommendation.en: Focus on the fast-weight consolidation mechanism and the N-scaling curves; it reframes long-context memory as state learning rather than larger KV caches.

paper.title: Equilibrium Reasoners: Learning Attractors Enables Scalable Reasoning
paper.abstract: Scaling test-time compute by iteratively updating a latent state has emerged as a powerful paradigm for reasoning. Yet the internal mechanisms that enable these iterative models to generalize beyond memorized patterns remain unclear. We hypothesize that generalizable reasoning arises from learning task-conditioned attractors: latent dynamical systems whose stable fixed points correspond to valid solutions.   We formalize this process through Equilibrium Reasoners (EqR), which enable test-time sc

summary.core_problem: 解释并改进“迭代式潜变量推理模型”为何能随 test-time compute（多迭代、多重启）稳定变强：哪些训练/推理设计会让潜空间动力系统形成与任务误差对齐的吸引子（attractor）地形，从而实现可泛化的收敛式求解，而不是靠记忆或外部 verifier。
summary.importance: 对预训练主线（数据配比、scaling、优化器）不是直接贡献，但对“推理即动力系统/固定点求解”的建模范式有方法论价值：给出可操作的诊断量（fixed-point residual 与预测误差的相关性）和可扩展推理的必要条件（吸引子与任务度量对齐、深度-广度交互）。如果你在做 latent reasoning、any-order/iterative LM、或把推理当作可扩展的内部搜索，这篇能提供一套更工程化的分析框架与训练小改动。
summary.technical_approach:
把 HRM/TRM 一类“权重共享的迭代更新”统一写成潜状态更新 z_{k+1}=f_θ(z_k;x)，将推理视为潜空间动力系统。核心主张是：test-time scaling 之所以有效，是因为训练塑造了 task-conditioned attractor landscape，使得稳定固定点对应有效解；并且 fixed-point residual ||f_θ(z;x)-z|| 可以作为与任务误差对齐的代理指标。
方法上做了两件事：
1) 机制与设计选择分析：从 feedforward 到 weight-tied iteration 的转变入手，系统讨论哪些训练/推理选择会影响吸引子可达性与“收敛=更好答案”的相关性，并用 residual-accuracy 的耦合关系做诊断。
2) EqR 训练干预 + 两轴推理扩展：提出两种轻量训练干预来改善吸引子可达性——(a) randomized state initialization（训练时随机化初始潜状态分布 μ0），(b) path stochasticity via noise injection（迭代路径注噪，增加轨迹多样性，降低落入坏吸引子的概率）。推理时显式沿两轴扩展：深度 D（单轨迹迭代步数）与广度 B（不同初始化/噪声的多轨迹重启），并用“收敛度/残差”做轨迹选择或聚合，从而不依赖外部 verifier。
summary.experiments: 主要在可控的结构化推理基准上验证：Sudoku-Extreme 与 Maze-Unique。论文报告 residual 与预测误差强相关（残差越低，解码错误越少），并观察到典型的深度-广度交互：只有当 D 足够大让轨迹能进入并稳定在吸引子附近时，增加 B（更多重启）才显著带来收益。最终在两轴扩展 + 基于收敛的选择下，EqR 达到 Sudoku 99.8% exact accuracy、Maze 93.0%（文中给出的代表性数字）。消融重点围绕：是否权重共享迭代、是否随机初始化、是否注噪、以及 D/B 扩展策略对收敛-准确率曲线的影响。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约30-45分钟）：
- 先看引言里“attractor landscape 与 task-metric alignment”的论点，以及 Fig.1（residual vs error 的耦合）和 Fig.3（深度-广度交互）。这两张图基本决定了论文的机制叙事是否成立。
- 再看方法部分对两种训练干预（随机初始化、路径注噪）的具体实现位置：是加在 z0、还是每步更新、噪声尺度如何设、训练/推理是否一致。
- 最后扫实验消融：重点不是绝对 SOTA，而是哪些设置会破坏“更多迭代=更好”的单调性，以及 residual 作为诊断量是否在不同任务/规模下仍稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: To explain and improve why iterative latent-state reasoners can reliably benefit from more test-time compute (more iterations and more restarts): what training/inference choices shape a task-conditioned attractor landscape in latent dynamics so that stronger convergence corresponds to lower task error, without external verifiers.
summary_en.importance: Not a direct pretraining-recipe paper, but it is useful if you care about alternative reasoning paradigms (latent iterative computation, fixed-point views, any-order/iterative LMs). The paper contributes an engineer-friendly diagnostic (fixed-point residual tracking error) and a concrete prediction (depth–breadth interaction) that can guide how to make test-time scaling behave monotonically rather than degrade.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They model iterative reasoners as a weight-tied dynamical system z_{k+1}=f_θ(z_k;x). The central hypothesis is “metric-aligned attractors”: training should shape the attractor landscape so that stable fixed points decode to valid solutions, and the fixed-point residual ||f_θ(z;x)-z|| becomes a differentiable proxy aligned with task loss.
EqR then adds two lightweight training interventions to improve reachability of good attractors: (1) randomized latent initialization (sampling z0 from a broader distribution conditioned on x), and (2) path stochasticity via noise injection during the iterative updates to diversify trajectories and reduce trapping in spurious attractors.
At inference, compute scales along two explicit axes: depth D (unrolled steps per trajectory) and breadth B (multiple stochastic trajectories from independent initializations). They select/aggregate trajectories using convergence (residual) rather than an external verifier, framing inference as an internal search over basins of attraction.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on controlled algorithmic reasoning benchmarks (Sudoku-Extreme, Maze-Unique) where memorization vs generalization can be separated. Key empirical claims: (i) lower fixed-point residual tightly correlates with lower prediction error; (ii) breadth helps only after sufficient depth enables trajectories to meaningfully settle into attractors (a depth–breadth interaction). With two-axis scaling and convergence-based selection, they report 99.8% exact accuracy on Sudoku and 93.0% on Maze. Ablations focus on weight-tied iteration vs feedforward, randomized initialization, noise injection, and how D/B scaling changes convergence–accuracy curves.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 min):
- Start with the attractor/metric-alignment argument and the main diagnostic plots (residual vs error; depth–breadth interaction).
- Check the exact implementation details of randomized z0 and per-step noise (where injected, schedule, train–test mismatch).
- Scan ablations for cases where more iterations stop helping; those are the most actionable signals if you want monotonic test-time scaling.

recommendation.zh: Zico Kolter 团队将 test-time scaling 解释为动力系统中的吸引子收敛，视角非常新颖，为理解 O1 范式提供了理论框架，值得一读。
recommendation.en: Zico Kolter's team explains test-time scaling as attractor convergence in dynamical systems; a highly novel perspective providing a theoretical framework for understanding the O1 paradigm. Worth reading.

paper.title: Simply Stabilizing the Loop via Fully Looped Transformer
paper.abstract: Scaling model performance typically requires increasing model size. Looped Transformer offers a compelling alternative by iteratively reusing the same Transformer blocks, trading additional computation for improved performance without increasing parameter count or context length. Because the number of loop iterations can be adjusted at inference, it also provides a natural mechanism for balancing performance and test-time compute. However, Looped Transformer still suffers from training instabili

summary.core_problem: Looped Transformer 通过复用相同 Transformer 块进行多轮迭代，在不增加参数量的情况下用额外计算换取性能提升，但当循环迭代数增加时会出现训练不稳定甚至崩溃的问题。此前研究未解释这种不稳定性的根本原因。
summary.importance: Looped Transformer 是应对高质量文本数据耗尽、将过剩算力转化为性能增益的潜在方向之一。本文对其训练不稳定性的诊断和解决方法，为测试时缩放（test-time scaling）范式提供了更稳定的基础方案。
summary.technical_approach: 作者通过分析早期训练动态，识别出两种不稳定机制：(1) 梯度振荡——训练早期梯度剧烈波动；(2) 残差爆炸——残差状态范数随循环迭代数快速增长。据此提出 Fully Looped Transformer（FLT），包含两个无额外参数的修改：(1) 全循环架构（Fully Looped Architecture），将循环信号分配到所有层以缓解残差爆炸；(2) 注意力注入（Attention Injection），复用现有注意力模块以受控方式注入循环信息，抑制梯度振荡。
summary.experiments: 诊断实验对比了 6/9/12 轮循环的 Looped Transformer（LT）和 12 轮 FLT 在 2000 步训练窗口内的表现：12 轮 LT 出现训练崩溃（损失停滞在高平台、残差范数持续增长）；9 轮 LT 未崩溃但损失显著高于 6 轮 LT；12 轮 FLT 全程保持稳定，损失下降更平滑、残差范数更小、梯度更稳定。最终实验显示 FLT 在基线 LT 崩溃的训练设置下仍能稳定训练，下游任务平均性能提升最高达 13.2%。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 3 节（不稳定诊断）的分析逻辑和图 2 的三个监控指标曲线（训练损失、残差状态范数、梯度 L2 范数）；第 4 节两个无参数修改的具体设计；第 5 节的循环缩放和消融实验。预计阅读时间 20-25 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Looped Transformer improves performance by reusing the same Transformer blocks across multiple iterations without increasing parameter count, but suffers from training instability or collapse when the number of loop iterations increases. Prior work did not explain the root cause of this instability.
summary_en.importance: Looped Transformer is one potential paradigm to address the exhaustion of high-quality text data by converting excess compute into performance gains. The paper's diagnosis and resolution of its training instability provide a more stable foundation for test-time scaling approaches.
summary_en.technical_approach: By analyzing early training dynamics, the authors identify two instability mechanisms: (1) gradient oscillation — violent gradient fluctuations during early training; (2) residual explosion — residual-state norms growing rapidly with loop iterations. The proposed Fully Looped Transformer (FLT) introduces two parameter-free modifications: (1) Fully Looped Architecture, which distributes recurrent signals to all layers to mitigate residual explosion; (2) Attention Injection, which reuses the existing attention block to inject recurrent information in a controlled manner to suppress gradient oscillation.
summary_en.experiments: Diagnostic experiments compared 6/9/12-loop LT and 12-loop FLT over a 2000-step window: 12-loop LT collapsed (loss plateaued at high level, residual norm kept growing); 9-loop LT did not collapse but showed significantly higher loss than 6-loop LT; 12-loop FLT remained stable throughout with smoother loss reduction, smaller residual norms, and more stable gradients. Final experiments show FLT trains stably in regimes where baseline LT collapses, improving downstream task average performance by up to 13.2%.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (instability diagnosis) for the analytical logic and Figure 2's three monitoring metrics (training loss, residual-state norm, gradient L2 norm); Section 4 for the two parameter-free modification designs; Section 5 for loop-scaling and ablation experiments. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 针对 Looped Transformer 训练不稳定性的架构改进，对探索 Universal Transformer 变体和 test-time compute 架构的研究员有参考价值，重点看其缓解残差爆炸的机制。
recommendation.en: Architectural improvements for training stability in Looped Transformers; valuable for researchers exploring Universal Transformer variants and test-time compute architectures. Focus on its mechanism for mitigating residual explosion.

paper.title: Probabilistic Tiny Recursive Model
paper.abstract: Tiny Recursive Models (TRM) solve complex reasoning tasks with a fraction of the parameters of modern large language models (LLMs) by iteratively refining a latent state and final answer. While powerful, their deterministic recursion can lead to convergence at suboptimal solutions, without escape mechanism. A common workaround relies on task-specific input perturbations at test time combined with answer aggregation via voting. We introduce Probabilistic TRM (PTRM), a task-agnostic framework for

summary.core_problem: 解决 Tiny Recursive Model 在递归求解时容易陷入次优解、缺少逃逸机制的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 latent reasoning 和 test-time compute 的方法改进：它不依赖重新训练，也不依赖任务特定输入扰动，而是在递归状态空间中做随机探索。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Probabilistic TRM，在每个深层递归步骤向 latent state 注入高斯噪声，并并行运行多条轨迹；最终使用原 TRM 已有的 Q head 选择候选解，同时保留早停机制。方法是对 TRM 推理过程的概率化改造，不改变训练目标。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告在 Sudoku-Extreme 上从 87.4% 提升到 98.75%，并在多个 puzzle benchmark 上取得明显提升。论文声称无需重训、无需任务特定增强；摘要未给出参数量、轨迹数、计算开销或完整 baseline 列表。
summary.authors_note: Mila – Quebec AI Institute。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the tendency of Tiny Recursive Models to converge to suboptimal solutions during deterministic recursive refinement.
summary_en.importance: It is a method contribution for latent reasoning and test-time compute: instead of retraining or crafting task-specific input perturbations, it explores the recursive latent space stochastically.
summary_en.technical_approach: Probabilistic TRM injects Gaussian noise at each deep recursion step, runs multiple trajectories in parallel, and selects among candidates with the existing Q head used by the original TRM for early stopping. The method modifies inference, not the training objective.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a Sudoku-Extreme gain from 87.4% to 98.75% and improvements on several puzzle benchmarks. It claims no retraining and no task-specific augmentation, but the abstract does not specify model size, number of trajectories, compute overhead, or full baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: Mila – Quebec AI Institute.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和消融即可；它给 latent recursion 加了一个干净的探索机制，值得检查收益是否只是采样预算换来的。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; it adds a clean exploration mechanism to latent recursion, but the key question is how much of the gain is just sampling budget.

paper.title: CopT: Contrastive On-Policy Thinking with Continuous Spaces for General and Agentic Reasoning
paper.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) is a standard approach for eliciting reasoning capabilities from large language models (LLMs). However, the common CoT paradigm treats thinking as a prerequisite for answering, which can delay access to plausible answers and incur unnecessary token costs even when the model is able to identify an answer before extended thinking, a behavior known as performative reasoning. In this paper, we introduce CopT, a reformulated reasoning pipeline that reverses the usual order of t

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：传统先思考再作答的 CoT 流程会带来额外 token 开销，而且常出现“表演式推理”，即模型其实已知道答案却仍被迫生成冗长思维链。
summary.importance: 重要性在于它不是单纯改 prompt，而是重排了推理时序：先给草答，再做 on-policy 反思与修正，并引入连续空间对比式 verifier 来判断草答是否可信。这对推理阶段计算分配、test-time scaling 和后训练中的 reasoning policy 设计都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上提出 CopT。第一步先让模型直接生成 draft answer；第二步条件化在该草答上继续“思考”，做自我反省和纠错；第三步不用额外独立 verifier，而是把同一生成 token 在离散 token 输入与连续 embedding 输入下的支持度做对比，构造 inference-time contrastive verification signal，用于判断是否需要继续思考或修正。核心新意是把“答案优先、思考随后”的流程与连续空间校验结合起来。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，论文主打 general and agentic reasoning 场景，但未在给定信息中披露具体模型规模、训练数据量和完整 baseline 列表。可确认的实验重点是比较 CopT 与标准 CoT 在推理质量和 token 成本上的权衡，并验证连续空间 contrastive verifier 对草答可信度判断的作用。由于缺少数字，当前更适合作为方法信号而非定论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a limitation of standard chain-of-thought: forcing models to think before answering can waste tokens and encourage performative reasoning, where the model likely knows the answer early but still emits long reasoning traces.
summary_en.importance: Its value is not just prompt engineering. It changes the reasoning order: answer first, then reflect on-policy, and adds a continuous-space contrastive verifier to decide whether the draft answer should be trusted. This is relevant to inference-time compute allocation, test-time scaling, and post-training reasoning policies.
summary_en.technical_approach: CopT first elicits a draft answer, then triggers reasoning conditioned on that draft for reflection and correction. Instead of using a separate verifier, it contrasts support for the same generated tokens under discrete-token inputs versus continuous-embedding inputs, producing an inference-time contrastive verification signal. The key idea is to combine answer-first reasoning with continuous-space verification.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the paper focuses on general and agentic reasoning, but the provided information does not specify model sizes, training data, or full baselines. The main empirical angle appears to be the quality-vs-token-cost tradeoff against standard CoT, plus validation that the continuous-space verifier can assess draft-answer reliability. Without full numbers, this is better treated as an interesting method signal than a settled result.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是它在挑战“先想后答”这个默认流程；先读方法和消融，若 verifier 收益只在特定 setup 出现，就把它当 test-time policy 小技巧而不是新范式。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it questions the default think-then-answer pipeline; read the method and ablations first, and if the verifier only helps in narrow setups, treat it as a test-time policy trick rather than a new paradigm.

paper.title: Argus: Evidence Assembly for Scalable Deep Research Agents
paper.abstract: Deep research agents have achieved remarkable progress on complex information seeking tasks. Even long ReAct style rollouts explore only a single trajectory, while recent state of the art systems scale inference time compute via parallel search and aggregation. Yet deep research answers are composed of complementary pieces of evidence, which parallel rollouts often duplicate rather than complete, yielding diminishing returns while pushing the aggregation context toward the model's limit. We prop

summary.core_problem: Argus 解决的是 deep research agent 在扩大推理时计算时的冗余问题：并行 ReAct rollout 往往重复检索相同证据，最终聚合器又必须读入大量原始轨迹，导致信息增益很快饱和，并受限于上下文窗口。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 agentic inference 的结构化扩展有参考意义。它把“多条轨迹聚合”改成“证据图装配”，重点不再是采样更多答案，而是维护一个可更新、可审计、可压缩的中间状态。对基座研究员的启发主要在两点：一是复杂推理任务的瓶颈不只在模型能力，也在推理状态的表示；二是强化学习训练 agent 时，训练目标可以作用在中间结构的质量，而不只是最终答案。
summary.technical_approach: 系统由 Searcher 和 Navigator 两个角色组成。Searcher 是无状态 ReAct agent，接收一个查询，执行 search、visit、answer 等工具调用，返回完整轨迹。Navigator 负责改写初始问题、调度 Searcher、解析轨迹，并把证据和暂定 claim 写入一个有向无环图。图中的节点表示 evidence 或 claim，边表示 support 或 contradiction。这样，系统可以显式识别三类缺口：支撑不足的 claim、尚未解决的矛盾、问题中还没有被覆盖的方面。Navigator 随后为这些缺口生成更定向的 follow-up query，而不是重新跑完整任务。最终回答阶段，Navigator 清空构图过程中的工作上下文，只基于原问题和证据图生成答案。这个设计和普通 self-consistency、best-of-N、LLM synthesis 的区别在于：后者先生成多条完整轨迹，再在末端做选择或压缩；Argus 在推理过程中持续维护共享状态，让后续搜索围绕缺失证据展开。
summary.experiments: 论文报告 Argus 在 8 个 deep research benchmark 中有 5 个取得最好结果。系统使用 35B-A3B MoE backbone，同时作为 Searcher 和 Navigator。相对 raw Searcher，单 Searcher 设置平均提升 5.5 分；8 个并行 Searcher 设置平均提升 12.7 分。扩展到 64 个 Searcher 时，Argus 在 BrowseComp 上达到 86.2%。一个关键工程结果是压缩比：累计 Searcher 输出为 25.6M tokens，但通过证据图呈现给 Navigator 的视图只有 21.5K tokens，约为 1200:1。这说明收益主要来自状态表示和调度方式，而不是简单增加聚合上下文。由于给定内容没有展示完整消融表，仍需在全文中确认强化学习训练 Navigator 的具体奖励设计、图构建质量指标、预算控制策略，以及不同 Searcher 数量下的边际收益曲线。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议约 25–35 分钟。优先看系统方法部分，尤其是 evidence graph 的节点/边定义、Navigator 的 gap detection 规则、follow-up query 生成方式，以及最终答案如何只依赖图而不是原始轨迹。实验部分重点看三类图表：Searcher 数量扩展曲线、和 best-of-N/aggregation baselines 的比较、graph compression 与准确率的关系。若关心 RL agent 训练，建议细读 Navigator 的训练目标和奖励构造；这部分决定 Argus 是一个可学习的证据装配器，还是主要依赖 prompt 和规则的 orchestration 系统。

summary_en.core_problem: Argus targets a scaling bottleneck in deep research agents. Parallel ReAct rollouts often retrieve overlapping evidence, while the final aggregator has to consume long raw transcripts. More compute then adds redundant context rather than complementary information.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant for understanding how inference-time computation can be structured. Its main contribution is to replace flat trajectory aggregation with an explicit evidence state. For foundation-model research, the useful lesson is that complex reasoning systems may be limited by the representation of intermediate search state, not only by model size or sampling budget. It also suggests a cleaner interface for RL-trained agents: the training signal can target the quality of intermediate evidence assembly, not just final-answer accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach: Argus uses two cooperating agents. The Searcher is a stateless ReAct-style agent that receives a query, performs tool calls such as search and visit, and returns a full trajectory. The Navigator rewrites the original question, dispatches Searchers, parses returned traces, and incrementally builds a directed acyclic evidence graph. Nodes correspond to evidence pieces and tentative claims; edges encode support and contradiction. After each round, the Navigator inspects the graph for under-supported claims, unresolved contradictions, and uncovered aspects of the question. It then issues targeted follow-up queries instead of rerunning the entire task. At answer time, the Navigator drops the working context and reasons only over the question and the assembled graph. This differs from self-consistency, best-of-N, and LLM-based synthesis, which generate complete trajectories first and only aggregate at the end.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports best results on five of eight deep research benchmarks. Both Searcher and Navigator use a 35B-A3B MoE backbone. Compared with the raw Searcher, Argus improves average accuracy by 5.5 points with one Searcher and by 12.7 points with eight parallel Searchers. With 64 Searchers, it reaches 86.2% on BrowseComp. The most informative system result is compression: 25.6M tokens of accumulated Searcher output are routed through the graph and exposed to the Navigator as a 21.5K-token view, about a 1200:1 reduction. This supports the claim that the gain comes from structured state and targeted dispatch, rather than simply giving the aggregator more transcripts. The provided excerpt does not include the full ablation details, so the reward design for Navigator training, graph-quality metrics, and compute-budget curves should be checked in the full experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim should take about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the method section: the evidence-graph schema, the Navigator’s gap-detection procedure, follow-up query generation, and the final synthesis step that uses only the graph. In the experiments, look for scaling curves over the number of Searchers, comparisons against best-of-N and learned aggregation baselines, and the relation between graph compression and answer accuracy. If interested in RL for agents, read the Navigator training section carefully; it determines whether Argus is mainly a learned evidence assembler or mostly a prompted orchestration pipeline.

recommendation.zh: 把“扩展test-time compute”从并行采样改成证据图装配是对的方向；只看evidence graph调度与去重策略，评测是否公平要打问号。
recommendation.en: The shift from parallel sampling to evidence-graph assembly is the right idea for scaling test-time compute; focus on the graph scheduling/dedup logic, but scrutinize evaluation cleanliness.

paper.title: TRIAGE: Evaluating Prospective Metacognitive Control in LLMs under Resource Constraints
paper.abstract: Deploying language models as autonomous agents requires more than per-task accuracy: when an agent faces a queue of problems under a finite token budget, it must decide which to attempt, in what order, and how much compute to commit to each, all before any execution feedback is available. This is the prospective form of metacognitive control studied for decades in human cognition, yet whether language models possess it remains untested. We introduce TRIAGE, an evaluation framework in which a mod

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM作为自主Agent部署时，缺乏在有限资源约束下的前瞻元认知控制能力：无法在任务执行前，对任务池中的任务进行优先级排序、资源分配和任务筛选的联合优化，导致资源浪费、推理效率低下，无法适配真实部署中的有限token预算、工具调用限制、延迟窗口等约束。
summary.importance: 首次提出了一套可量化的Agent前瞻元认知控制评估框架，定义了LLM部署中资源高效利用的新能力维度；实验结果揭示了现有模型在跨任务资源规划上的系统性缺陷，为Agent的推理效率优化和资源调度能力训练提供了评测基准与改进方向。
summary.technical_approach: 设计TRIAGE评估框架：1. 输入为任务池、每个任务的分值、针对被测模型自身基线成本校准的token预算；2. 要求模型输出包含任务选择、执行顺序、每个任务token分配的完整前瞻执行计划；3. 以完全知晓模型在每个任务上的求解能力和成本的Oracle计划为上限，计算被测模型计划的得分；4. 覆盖了认知心理学中定义的选择、分配、终止三类元认知控制功能，采用行为输出而非模型自报告的置信度作为评测依据，避免自报告信号不可靠的问题。
summary.experiments: 在4类任务域（竞赛数学、研究生级科学知识、代码生成、多学科专家知识）上评测了20种模型架构，包括4款标准LLM和16款推理增强LLM，分别在启用和禁用思考模式的情况下测试。核心发现：1. 模型的元认知控制能力跨域迁移性差，在一个域的自我评估表现很少能迁移到其他域；2. 推理增强可以提升单任务准确率，但无法提升资源调度质量；3. 推理训练后的模型更难识别任务池中的不可解任务；4. 模型可以初步选择要尝试的任务，但很少能制定出自身可以严格遵守的预算分配计划，预算执行的偏差在所有预算水平下都非常明显。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第2章TRIAGE框架设计部分，理解评测范式的核心逻辑和与传统单任务置信度评测的区别；第3章的实验结果汇总和跨模型对比可以快速浏览，核心结论已经在引言和讨论部分总结；预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: LLMs deployed as autonomous agents lack prospective metacognitive control under finite resource constraints: they cannot jointly optimize task prioritization, resource allocation, and task selection for a task pool before execution, leading to resource waste and low inference efficiency, which fails to adapt to real deployment constraints such as limited token budgets, tool call limits, and latency windows.
summary_en.importance: TRIAGE is the first quantifiable evaluation framework for prospective metacognitive control in agents, defining a new capability dimension for resource-efficient LLM deployment. Experimental results reveal systematic flaws of existing models in cross-task resource planning, providing a benchmark and improvement direction for agent inference efficiency optimization and resource scheduling capability training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The TRIAGE evaluation framework is designed as follows: 1. The input includes a task pool, point value per task, and a token budget calibrated to the tested model's own baseline cost on the task set; 2. The model is required to output a complete prospective execution plan covering task selection, execution order, and token allocation per task; 3. The plan score is calculated against an oracle plan that has full knowledge of the model's solvability and cost on each task; 4. It covers three metacognitive control functions (selection, allocation, termination) defined in cognitive psychology, and evaluates behavioral output instead of the model's self-reported confidence to avoid the unreliability of self-report signals.
summary_en.experiments: 20 model architectures, including 4 standard LLMs and 16 reasoning-augmented LLMs, are evaluated across 4 task domains (competition mathematics, graduate-level science knowledge, code generation, multidisciplinary expert knowledge) with thinking mode both enabled and disabled. Key findings: 1. Metacognitive control capability transfers poorly across domains; 2. Reasoning augmentation improves single-task accuracy but not resource scheduling quality; 3. Reasoning-trained models are less likely to identify unsolvable items in a task pool; 4. Models can preliminarily select tasks to attempt but rarely formulate budget allocation plans that they themselves can strictly adhere to, with large deviations in budget execution across all budget levels.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Chapter 2 for the TRIAGE framework design to understand the core logic of the evaluation paradigm and its difference from traditional single-task confidence evaluation. Chapter 3's experiment results and cross-model comparisons can be skimmed, as key conclusions are already summarized in the introduction and discussion sections. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 scoring 设计和 oracle 构造即可；它测的是推理预算调度，不是能力本身，能校正对 reasoning mode 的直觉。
recommendation.en: Read the scoring and oracle design; it measures budget scheduling rather than raw ability, and can recalibrate intuitions about reasoning modes.

paper.title: LoopUS: Recasting Pretrained LLMs into Looped Latent Refinement Models
paper.abstract: Looped computation shows promise in improving the reasoning-oriented performance of LLMs by scaling test-time compute. However, existing approaches typically require either training recurrent models from scratch or applying disruptive retrofits, which involve substantial computational costs and may compromise pretrained capabilities. To address these limitations, we introduce \textbf{Looped Depth Up-Scaling} (LoopUS), a post-training framework that converts a standard pretrained LLM into a loope

summary.core_problem: 现有将预训练LLM改造为测试时间循环推理架构的方法存在依赖启发式选层、隐状态易漂移、长循环训练成本高且不稳定的问题，从零训练循环LLM则计算成本过高。
summary.importance: 为后训练阶段提升模型推理能力提供了一条不增加参数量、不需要重新预训练的低成本路径，同时验证了隐表示动态分析可直接指导模型结构改造，为测试时间计算的规模化落地提供了可行方案。
summary.technical_approach: 基于预训练LLM的隐状态分层演化规律（早层快速变换token嵌入、中层形成稳定表示平台、末层转向输出空间解码），将模型拆分为编码器、循环推理块、解码器三个功能模块，仅复用中间推理块作为循环主体；引入选择性门控缓解迭代过程中的隐状态漂移，用随机深度监督避免全量时间反向传播的显存占用和梯度异常问题，新增置信度头实现测试时间计算量的自适应分配。
summary.experiments: 在原预训练骨干基础上零样本精度提升3.0%，WikiText和LAMBADA数据集的困惑度分别下降17.4%和21.3%；在TinyLlama上的训练token量比现有循环基线少17-20倍的条件下，取得14.6%的相对性能提升，循环深度增加时训练过程仍保持稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看第1章的隐表示动态观察和核心组件介绍，以及第3章的关键实验结果，预计阅读时间20-30分钟，无需深究具体推导细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing methods to convert pretrained LLMs into looped test-time reasoning architectures either rely on heuristic layer selection, suffer from hidden state drift, or incur high training cost and instability for long loops, while training looped LLMs from scratch has prohibitive compute cost at modern model scales.
summary_en.importance: It provides a low-cost post-training path to improve LLM reasoning capability without increasing parameter count or retraining from scratch, validates that hidden representation dynamics analysis can directly guide architecture retrofitting, and offers a practical solution for scalable test-time compute allocation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Based on the staged hidden state evolution pattern of pretrained LLMs (early layers transform token embeddings rapidly, middle layers form a stable representation plateau, final layers transition to vocabulary space decoding), the model is split into three functional modules: encoder, looped reasoning block, and decoder, with only the middle reasoning block reused as the loop body. It introduces a selective gate to mitigate hidden state drift during iteration, random deep supervision to avoid memory overhead and gradient anomalies of full backpropagation through time, and a confidence head for adaptive test-time compute allocation.
summary_en.experiments: It improves zero-shot accuracy by 3.0% over the original pretrained backbone, reduces perplexity on WikiText and LAMBADA by 17.4% and 21.3% respectively. On TinyLlama, it achieves 14.6% relative performance gain with 17-20× fewer training tokens than existing looped baselines, and training remains stable as loop depth increases.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the hidden representation dynamics observation and core component introduction in Chapter 1, and key experimental results in Chapter 3. Estimated reading time is 20-30 minutes, no need to dive into detailed derivations.

recommendation.zh: 一种将标准 LLM 改造为循环架构以扩展 test-time compute 的后训练方法，关注其如何解决隐藏状态漂移和长递归训练的内存问题，值得一读。
recommendation.en: A post-training method to retrofit standard LLMs into looped architectures for scaling test-time compute. Focus on how it addresses hidden-state drift and memory issues in long recursive training; worth a read.

paper.title: Test-Time Compute for Dense Retrieval: Agentic Program Generation with Frozen Embedding Models
paper.abstract: Test-time compute is widely believed to benefit only large reasoning models. We show it also helps small embedding models.
